title: HARMONIC: Hierarchical Adaptive Resilience via Multi-agent Orchestration in Networked Intelligent Computing for SDN-Enhanced Fog-Edge Systems
affiliations: National University Singapore, University of Tokyo, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) - Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), Students and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)

detail.title: HARMONIC: Hierarchical Adaptive Resilience via Multi-agent Orchestration in Networked Intelligent Computing for SDN-Enhanced Fog-Edge Systems

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Network and Computer Applications, Forthcoming

detail.abstract: The rapid proliferation of ultra-low-latency distributed services-ranging from autonomous driving and industrial metaverse to real-time telemedicine-has exposed critical shortcomings in conventional cloud-centric resource management paradigms. Although the fusion of software-defined networking (SDN) with fog-edge computing offers a compelling blueprint for decentralized intelligence, existing orchestration strategies remain plagued by three systemic deficiencies: (i) centralized decision engines that implode under massive heterogeneity, (ii) shortsighted optimization of latency-energy trade-offs devoid of rigorous quality-of-service (QoS) guarantees, and (iii) inherent fragility against node outages and volatile workload surges. To address these challenges, we introduce HARMONICa hierarchical multi-agent deep reinforcement learning (DRL) framework that delivers scalable, resilient, and QoS-aware resource orchestration in SDN-enabled fog-edge environments. Our contributions are fivefold.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HARMONIC，一个面向SDN使能的雾-边缘计算环境的分层多智能体深度强化学习框架，旨在解决传统云中心化资源管理中存在的三大系统性缺陷（集中决策引擎脆弱、延迟-能耗优化缺乏QoS保障、对节点故障和负载激增缺乏韧性），实现可扩展、有韧性和QoS感知的资源编排。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个可扩展、有韧性且QoS感知的资源编排框架，以应对SDN使能的雾-边缘计算环境中超低延迟分布式服务（如自动驾驶、工业元宇宙、实时远程医疗）的资源管理挑战？
AI.motivation: 超低延迟分布式服务的快速激增暴露了传统云中心化资源管理范式的关键缺陷。尽管SDN与雾-边缘计算的融合提供了去中心化智能的蓝图，现有编排策略仍存在三大系统性缺陷：集中式决策引擎在高度异构环境下崩溃、延迟-能耗权衡优化缺乏严格的QoS保障、对节点故障和负载激增缺乏内在韧性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分层多智能体深度强化学习（Hierarchical Multi-Agent Deep Reinforcement Learning）；软件定义网络（SDN）；雾-边缘计算（Fog-Edge Computing）；QoS感知资源编排理论
AI.method: 提出HARMONIC框架，采用分层多智能体深度强化学习方法，在SDN使能的雾-边缘环境中实现资源编排。具体方法细节需查看论文全文，摘要中提及该框架包含五个方面的贡献。
AI.findings: 该框架能够解决集中决策引擎在异构环境下的崩溃问题、延迟-能耗权衡缺乏QoS保障的问题，以及对节点故障和负载激增的韧性问题。具体实验结果需查看论文全文。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了HARMONIC分层多智能体DRL框架，为雾-边缘计算环境中的去中心化智能资源编排提供了新的理论框架，弥补了现有编排策略在可扩展性、韧性和QoS保障方面的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为自动驾驶、工业元宇宙、实时远程医疗等超低延迟分布式服务提供了可扩展、有韧性且QoS感知的资源编排解决方案，具有实际部署价值。

title: Taxpayer Behavior in the Age of AI: A Field Experiment on Property Tax Appeals
affiliations: University of Michigan, University of California, Los Angeles (UCLA), University of Virginia and The University of Texas at Dallas - Naveen Jindal School of Management

detail.title: Taxpayer Behavior in the Age of AI: A Field Experiment on Property Tax Appeals
detail.abstract: Navigating the tax system often requires information and judgment that taxpayers may lack. Although taxpayers sometimes rely on human experts, AI could provide comparable assistance at substantially lower cost. Yet there is no causal evidence on how taxpayers use AI tax agents or how these tools affect their behavior. We fill this gap with a field experiment in the context of property tax appeals. We recruited a sample of 645 households in Dallas County, Texas. All households received access to a website providing personalized information, filing instructions, and supporting evidence for an appeal. Half were randomly assigned to a version of the website that also included an AI chatbot capable of answering questions and providing guidance tailored to their circumstances. Chatbot take-up was high: 78% initiated a conversation. Access to the chatbot increased the probability of filing an appeal without a human agent by 9.1 pp, from 41.4% to 50.5%. Evidence from clickstream data and conversation transcripts suggests that the chatbot helped households exercise judgment-that is, evaluate and act on the available information. The increase in appeal filing was smaller among less-advantaged households, providing suggestive evidence that the chatbot widened existing disparities. Our results demonstrate the potential of AI tax assistance while highlighting that who benefits depends not only on access, but also on how taxpayers use the technology.

AI.tldr: 本文通过一项在德克萨斯州达拉斯县开展的实地实验（645户家庭），检验了AI税务聊天机器人对居民房产税上诉行为的影响。研究发现，提供AI聊天机器人使无人工代理情况下提出上诉的概率从41.4%提高至50.5%（提高9.1个百分点），聊天机器人采用率高达78%。但该效应在弱势群体中较小，暗示可能扩大了现有差距。
AI.research_question: 纳税人如何使用AI税务代理？这些工具如何影响纳税人的行为？
AI.motivation: 纳税系统往往需要纳税人具备其可能缺乏的信息和判断力，尽管纳税人有时依赖人类专家，但AI可以以更低的成本提供类似的帮助。然而，目前缺乏关于纳税人如何使用AI税务代理或这些工具如何影响其行为的因果证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息不对称和决策辅助的视角，探讨AI工具如何帮助纳税人进行判断（评估和行动于可用信息），以及技术获取与使用差异如何影响行为结果。
AI.method: 实地实验（field experiment），在德克萨斯州达拉斯县招募645户家庭，随机分配是否获得包含AI聊天机器人的网站版本。结合点击流数据和对话记录进行分析，比较实验组与对照组的上诉行为差异。
AI.findings: （1）聊天机器人采用率高，78%的用户发起了对话。（2）访问聊天机器人使无人工代理情况下提出上诉的概率提高了9.1个百分点（从41.4%升至50.5%）。（3）点击流数据和对话记录表明聊天机器人帮助家庭行使判断力，即评估和利用可用信息。（4）上诉增加幅度在弱势家庭中较小，提示聊天机器人可能扩大了现有差距。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提供了AI税务代理对纳税人行为的因果证据，揭示了AI工具如何通过辅助判断而非仅提供信息来影响行为，并指出技术受益并非仅取决于获取机会，还取决于使用方式的异质性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供AI税务辅助工具的实证证据，表明AI能以低成本替代人工专家帮助纳税人，同时警示需关注技术可能加剧而非缩小不同群体之间差距的风险。

title: The Effects of Mandated Floors in PBM-Pharmacy Contracts *
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, University of South Carolina,  and Georgia  Institute  of  Technology

detail.title: The Effects of Mandated Floors in PBM-Pharmacy Contracts *
detail.abstract: Pharmacy benefit managers (PBMs) negotiate reimbursements to pharmacies on behalf of most US health plans. In 2023, West Virginia and Tennessee were the first states with floors on the dispensing fees PBMs pay in the commercial market. Using administrative data on US retail pharmacies and a synthetic difference-indifferences design, we find that the mandates increased independent pharmacy supply by 1.8%. The gains came from reduced exit rather than increased entry, with the exit response concentrated in rural areas. There, exit rates fell 54% and the share of ZIP codes served by an independent pharmacy rose. These results are consistent with dispensing fee floors countervailing PBM buyer power.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国零售药店的行政数据，采用合成双重差分法，研究了西弗吉尼亚州和田纳西州在2023年实施的药房福利管理商(PBM)配药费下限政策的效果。研究发现该政策使独立药店供给增加了1.8%，主要驱动力是退出减少而非进入增加，且退出减少集中在农村地区。在农村地区，退出率下降了54%，由独立药店服务的ZIP码比例上升。这些结果与配药费下限抵消PBM买方力量的理论一致。
AI.research_question: 配药费下限政策（dispensing fee floors）对独立药店供给有何影响？其作用机制是什么？
AI.motivation: PBM代表美国大多数健康计划与药店谈判报销费用，拥有强大的买方力量。西弗吉尼亚和田纳西州是首批在商业市场对PBM支付的配药费设定下限的州，这为评估此类监管政策的效果提供了难得的机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 买方力量理论（Buyer Power Theory）：PBM作为少数买方对众多独立药店拥有议价优势，配药费下限政策通过设定最低价格来抵消PBM的买方力量，从而改善独立药店的生存条件。
AI.method: 使用美国零售药店行政数据，采用合成双重差分法（synthetic difference-in-differences）进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 1) 配药费下限使独立药店供给增加了1.8%；2) 供给增加主要来自独立药店退出率降低而非新进入增加；3) 退出减少集中在农村地区，农村地区退出率下降54%，独立药店服务的ZIP码比例上升。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了配药费下限政策有效抵消PBM买方力量的实证证据，丰富了关于买方力量及政府价格干预有效性方面的理论文献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估配药费下限政策的效果提供了因果证据，表明该政策能有效维持独立药店（尤其是农村地区）的供给，对保障药品可及性具有重要的政策意义。

title: Minimum Wage Exposure, Migration Status, and COVID-19: Evidence on Wage Outcomes from the U.S. Current Population Survey

detail.title: Minimum Wage Exposure, Migration Status, and COVID-19: Evidence on Wage Outcomes from the U.S. Current Population Survey
detail.abstract: This paper examines how the exposure to minimum wages and migration status affect wage outcomes in the United States labour market in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic. Using micro-level data based on the Current Population Survey (CPS) Annual Social and Economic Supplement, the paper will compare the labour market performance in the time before and after the pandemic shock, both focused on workers at the minimum wage level. The empirical model uses the Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) wage regression model with industry effect and state fixed effects to find out the wage adjustment differences between migrant and native workers and between workers who experience the minimum wage adjustment and those who do not. The analysis yields three main findings. First, even when observable worker characteristics and fixed effects are controlled for, a statistically significant wage gap among migrants exists. Second, employees who were close to the minimum wage experienced a relative wage gain during the 2021 recovery compared to higher-wage employees, consistent with tightening at the bottom of the distribution. Third, the migrant wage penalty follows a broadly monotonic enforcement gradient across sectors, ranging from approximately 33 per cent in Agriculture to statistically indistinguishable from zero in Food Services and Accommodation, constituting the central empirical contribution of the paper. The three-way interaction between migration status, minimum wage exposure, and the pandemic period is directionally consistent with compounded disadvantage in weakly enforced sectors but does not reach statistical significance in any model, most plausibly due to limited within-sector sample sizes. In general, the results suggest that minimum wage policy sets a nominal wage floor, but its protective reach depends critically on the intensity of enforcement and does not fully cushion vulnerable workers against labour market shocks in periods of economic turbulence.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国当前人口调查微观数据，通过OLS工资回归模型（含行业和州固定效应），研究最低工资暴露与移民身份在新冠疫情前后对美国劳动力市场工资结果的影响。研究发现：移民存在显著的工资惩罚；接近最低工资的员工在2021年复苏期间获得相对工资收益；移民工资惩罚在不同部门间呈现约33%（农业）到零（餐饮住宿）的梯度差异。
AI.research_question: 在新冠疫情背景下，最低工资暴露和移民身份如何影响美国劳动力市场的工资结果？
AI.motivation: 新冠疫情对劳动力市场造成重大冲击，但移民工人与最低工资工人作为脆弱群体，其工资调整模式在疫情前后是否不同尚不清楚。本文旨在揭示最低工资政策的保护作用在不同群体和部门间的差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最低工资理论的工资地板效应；劳动力市场分割理论；移民工资惩罚与执法强度的关系。
AI.method: 使用当前人口调查（CPS）年度社会与经济补充调查的微观数据，采用带行业效应和州固定效应的OLS工资回归模型，通过三重交互（移民身份、最低工资暴露、疫情时期）进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 第一，控制可观测特征和固定效应后，移民仍存在统计显著的工资差距；第二，接近最低工资的员工在2021年复苏期相对高工资员工获得工资增长，符合工资分布底端收紧的预期；第三，移民工资惩罚随部门执法强度呈现单调梯度，从农业约33%到餐饮住宿业的统计上不显著。三重交互方向与弱势部门复合劣势一致，但未达统计显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 核心贡献在于揭示移民工资惩罚在不同部门间的执法强度梯度，表明最低工资政策的保护作用取决于执法强度，丰富了最低工资理论与移民劳动市场研究的交叉领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供证据：最低工资仅设定名义工资底线，其保护效力依赖于执法强度，在经济动荡期不足以充分缓冲脆弱工人的冲击，提示需要加强部门执法和针对性的保护政策。

title: Development in an Age of Polycrisis: How Climate, Energy, Demographic, and Financial Risks Are Reshaping Economic Convergence

detail.title: Development in an Age of Polycrisis: How Climate, Energy, Demographic, and Financial Risks Are Reshaping Economic Convergence
detail.abstract: Economic convergence did not stall as a uniform slowdown. It became a filter. In a balanced reading of World Bank GDP per capita at PPP, 93 of 123 developing countries closed the gap with the United States between 2000 and 2019 (76 percent of the sample). Between 2019 and 2023, 38 of 125 did (30 percent). Of the countries that had been catching up, only a third continued to. Crosscountry dispersion of log income, which had fallen from 1.18 in 1990 to 1.14 in 2019, rose again to 1.16. That is not a pandemic blip on a still-working catch-up machine. Lowincome GDP per capita was 5.3 percent of the high-income level in 1990 and 4.1 percent in 2023. Sub-Saharan Africa went from 10.8 percent to 8.3 percent. East Asia excluding high-income economies went from 7.2 percent to 33.8 percent. The countries still converging are those that can absorb climate, energy, demographic, and financial shocks at the same time. Among developing economies, 31 percent sit in three or four of those high-risk domains, covering 1.4 billion people; 87 percent of that group is in sub-Saharan Africa. Their mean GDP per capita growth in 2019-23 was-0.25 percent a year, against +1.12 percent for countries with at most one high-risk domain. The four risks are not a list. They are a polycrisis cascade: failure in one domain raises the cost of absorbing the next. Cheap capital, a demographic dividend, and a stable energy bill were the hidden complements of the 2000-19 catch-up. Those complements are no longer jointly available to the countries that still have the furthest to go.

AI.tldr: 经济趋同并未以均匀放缓的方式停滞，而是变成了一种"过滤器"。2000-2019年间，123个发展中国家中93个国家（76%）缩小了与美国的收入差距，但2019-2023年间，125个国家中仅38个（30%）继续这么做。趋同国家的分布呈现高度异质性：东亚（除高收入经济体）从美国水平的7.2%升至33.8%，而撒哈拉以南非洲从10.8%降至8.3%。论文提出"多元危机级联"（polycrisis cascade）概念，认为气候、能源、人口和金融四类风险的叠加而非并列，才是决定趋同能否持续的关键。拥有三个及以上高风险领域的国家（集中在撒哈拉以南非洲，覆盖14亿人）在2019-23年间人均GDP年均增长为-0.25%，而最多面临一个风险的国家为+1.12%。廉价资本、人口红利和稳定能源账单曾是2000-19年趋同的隐性互补条件，但这些条件对最落后国家已不再同时可得。
AI.research_question: 全球经济趋同放缓的本质是什么？为何部分发展中国家能够持续缩小与发达国家的收入差距，而另一部分却在加速掉队？四类结构性风险如何共同决定趋同的可持续性？
AI.motivation: 主流叙事将2008年后全球经济增长趋同的减速视为均匀的、暂时的现象（如"疫情冲击"），但作者观察到2019-2023年间趋同率的急剧下降并非均匀分布，而是呈现出系统性筛选效应。理解这一"趋同过滤器"的机制，对于正确诊断全球发展困境和制定差异化政策至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出"多元危机级联"（polycrisis cascade）理论框架，主张气候、能源、人口和金融四类风险不是简单的并列清单，而是相互耦合的级联系统——某一领域的失败会提高其他领域冲击的吸收成本。该框架整合了传统趋同理论（Barro & Sala-i-Martin）与多重危机理论（multiplex crisis），强调趋同的"隐性互补条件"（廉价资本、人口红利、稳定能源）的联合可得性决定增长可持续性。
AI.method: 基于世界银行购买力平价（PPP）人均GDP数据的实证分析。采用跨国家收入差距比较方法：（1）计算各国相对美国的人均GDP比值及趋同率；（2）分析跨国对数收入的离散度（dispersion）时间序列变化；（3）按四类高风险领域（气候、能源、人口、金融）对国家进行风险分类，比较不同风险组合下的增长率表现。
AI.findings: （1）2000-2019年76%的发展中国家缩小了与美国的收入差距，但2019-2023年这一比例骤降至30%；（2）曾经趋同的国家中仅三分之一继续趋同，表明趋同机制发生了结构性断裂；（3）跨国对数收入离散度从2019年的1.14回升至1.16，低收入国家人均GDP占高收入国家比重从1990年的5.3%降至2023年的4.1%；（4）地区分化加剧：东亚（不含高收入）从美国水平7.2%升至33.8%，而撒哈拉以南非洲从10.8%降至8.3%；（5）31%的发展中国家（覆盖14亿人，其中87%在撒哈拉以南非洲）同时处于三个或四个高风险领域，其2019-23年人均GDP增长为-0.25%/年，而最多一个风险领域的国家为+1.12%/年。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）挑战了"全球趋同放缓是均匀现象"的传统观点，提出"趋同过滤器"概念，揭示趋同并非线性过程而是有选择性的；（2）提出"多元危机级联"理论，将四类风险从并列清单重构为相互强化的级联系统，深化了对增长陷阱（growth trap）机制的理解；（3）识别出趋同的"隐性互补条件"（廉价资本、人口红利、稳定能源）及其联合可得性的关键性，补充了标准趋同理论对初始条件和结构约束的论述。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为国际发展机构提供基于风险叠加而非单一指标的国别识别工具，帮助更精准地筛选需要优先援助的国家；（2）警示"一刀切"的发展政策失效，强调政策设计必须考虑多元危机的级联效应，特别是撒哈拉以南非洲的叠加风险；（3）为气候融资、能源转型和人口政策的一体化设计提供实证依据，指出对这些国家而言，单一领域的干预不足以逆转趋同中断。

title: Staff Perception of Value for Money in IPPIS implementation: Preliminary findings from FNPH ARO

detail.title: Staff Perception of Value for Money in IPPIS implementation: Preliminary findings from FNPH ARO

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available resources and documents
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research

detail.abstract: The specific objectives were to examine staff perceptions of changes in payroll expenditure trends, assess the impact of IPPIS on operational costs, evaluate its effect on payroll processing efficiency, and determine its contribution to financial accountability. The research employed a qualitative research design, drawing on staff surveys and interviews to provide a grounded evaluation of the system. Findings reveal that while IPPIS has achieved notable success in eliminating ghost workers and curbing fraudulent payroll practices, its implementation in specialized healthcare institutions remains problematic. Staff reported persistent delays in salary corrections, arrears, and deductions, alongside bureaucratic rigidity and suspected breaches of data privacy. The system has improved accountability at the macro level but has not fully delivered efficiency or economy at the institutional level. Operational bottlenecks, technical glitches, and doubts from staff/labour unions continue to undermine its legitimacy and effectiveness. The study concludes that IPPIS demonstrates partial value for money. It has strengthened transparency and accountability but has failed to meet expectations of efficiency and economy in the unique context of tertiary healthcare institutions. For IPPIS to achieve its intended outcomes, reforms must prioritize system flexibility, improved operator training, and transparent resolution of payroll anomalies. Recommendations include adapting IPPIS algorithms to accommodate complex healthcare payroll structures such as allowances and other staff one-off entitlements/arrears, establishing independent audit mechanisms to monitor deductions and arrears, investing in continuous training for payroll operators, implementing stronger cyber security protocols to safeguard staff data, and promoting stakeholder engagement to enhance legitimacy and reduce resistance. Comparative research across other federal health institutions is also recommended to provide broader insights and guide policy refinements.This study contributes to international debates on public sector reform by highlighting the challenges of implementing centralized payroll systems in specialized healthcare environments. It underscores the need for context-sensitive approaches that balance fiscal discipline with operational efficiency and staff welfare.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定性方法（员工调查与访谈）评估了尼日利亚综合工资与人事信息系统（IPPIS）在三级医疗机构的实施效果。研究发现，IPPIS虽然在消除幽灵员工和遏制欺诈性工资做法方面取得显著成功，并提升了宏观层面的问责制，但在专业医疗机构中面临延误、官僚僵化、数据隐私担忧等问题，未能充分实现效率和经济效益，仅体现了部分性价比。研究建议改革系统灵活性、加强操作员培训和透明解决工资异常。
AI.research_question: IPPIS系统在三级医疗机构中的实施效果如何？具体包括：员工对工资支出趋势变化的看法、IPPIS对运营成本的影响、对工资处理效率的影响，以及对财务问责制的贡献。
AI.motivation: 集中式工资支付系统（IPPIS）在专业医疗机构的实施效果缺乏深入研究，尤其是其在特殊组织结构（如复杂津贴和一次性福利）中的应用困境尚未被充分探讨，需要实证评估其价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共部门改革理论、财政纪律与运营效率平衡的视角，涉及问责制、效率和经济性（3Es）框架。
AI.method: 采用定性研究设计，通过员工调查和访谈收集数据，对IPPIS系统进行基于实证的评估。
AI.findings: IPPIS在消除幽灵员工和遏制欺诈方面成功，但在专业医疗机构中存在工资更正延误、拖欠款和扣款问题，以及官僚僵化和数据隐私泄露疑虑。系统在宏观层面改善了问责制，但未能在机构层面充分实现效率和经济效益，运营瓶颈、技术故障和员工/工会的质疑损害了其合法性和有效性。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关于集中式工资系统在专业医疗机构实施挑战的国际公共部门改革讨论，强调需要情境敏感的治理方法，平衡财政纪律与运营效率和员工福利。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体改革建议：调整IPPIS算法以适配复杂医疗工资结构，建立独立审计机制监督扣款和拖欠，投资操作员持续培训，强化网络安全协议保护员工数据，促进利益相关者参与以减少阻力，并建议在更多联邦医疗机构开展比较研究以指导政策完善。

title:
AI-Driven Financial Infrastructure 
How LLMs, Deep Learning, and Autonomous Agents Reshape Payments, Credit, and Market Microstructure

detail.title:
AI-Driven Financial Infrastructure 
How LLMs, Deep Learning, and Autonomous Agents Reshape Payments, Credit, and Market Microstructure
detail.abstract: "AI in finance" is treated as a single diffusion. It is three occupations of three different layers, running on three clocks. Deep learning already prices credit and scores fraud. Large language models now read the unstructured remainder-filings, chat, policy, code. Agents want to initiate payments and trades. The IIF-EY survey of 61 institutions in October 2025 finds 90 percent of firms with AI in production and, among those, generative-AI production at 84 percent, up from 48 percent a year earlier. Agentic systems are in production at 23 percent. Primary investment still sits in predictive models: 60 percent of firms, against 34 percent in generative AI. That ranking is the finding, not a lag. Scoring is a probabilistic task that financial firms have been doing with neural nets since the 1990s. Settlement is not. The IMF three-layer map-intent, authorisation, settlement-is the right decomposition. Agents belong in the first layer. The second and third must remain deterministic or the rail stops being a rail. Credit is the intermediate case. FinRegLab shows that XGBoost lifts ROC-AUC by about two points over logistic regression on the same bureau file, and that a cash-flow hybrid on top of that is another few tenths. Machine learning increased simulated approvals by nearly 4 percent and cut approved defaulters by at least 9 percent. That is a better scorecard. It is not a new credit market, and it is not a fair-lending regime. Market microstructure is the layer where the three generations collide. High-frequency systems have been agentic in a narrow sense for fifteen years. What is new is an LLM that can read a headline, write an order, and share a prompt template with every other desk that bought the same model. The Financial Stability Board named the resulting vulnerabilities in 2024: third-party concentration, correlated behaviour, cyber, and model risk. The policy error is to regulate "AI" as a capability. Regulate the layer it is allowed to occupy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"AI in finance"不应被视为单一的扩散过程，而应区分为三个不同职业、三个不同层面、遵循三个不同时钟。深度学习（预测模型）、大语言模型（生成式AI）和智能体系统分别占据金融的不同层级：定价/评分、非结构化数据处理、支付与交易发起。基于IIF-EY 2025年10月对61家机构的调查，预测模型投资仍占60%、生成式AI占34%、智能体系统仅23%在生产中。作者主张按IMF三层映射（意图、授权、结算）进行监管，智能体应停留在意图层，结算层必须保持确定性，监管应针对AI所占据的层级而非将其作为单一能力进行规制。
AI.research_question: 金融领域的AI应用是否应被视为一个单一的扩散过程？还是应分解为不同层级、不同职业、不同时间节奏的多个过程，并据此进行差异化监管？
AI.motivation: 学界和监管界常将"AI in finance"视为单一的整体扩散现象，但深度学习、大语言模型和智能体系统在金融中占据完全不同的职能层级，面临不同的风险特征和采用节奏。现有分析框架将三者混为一谈，导致政策讨论和监管建议缺乏针对性。作者基于IIF-EY 2025年的调查数据，揭示了投资的优先级排序（预测模型60% vs 生成式34%），并指出这种排序不是滞后，而是不同层级任务性质的必然反映。
AI.theoretical_framework: IMF三层映射框架（意图层、授权层、结算层）；金融市场微观结构理论；技术扩散的职业分层理论；确定性系统与概率系统的边界理论。
AI.method: 基于IIF-EY 2025年10月对61家金融机构的调查数据进行实证分析；引用FinRegLab的模型对比研究（XGBoost vs 逻辑回归在信贷评分中的ROC-AUC差异）；结合金融市场微观结构的案例分析（高频交易的智能体特征与大语言模型的新增风险）；引用金融稳定理事会（FSB）2024年的风险识别报告。
AI.findings: 1) 90%的金融机构已有AI投入生产，其中生成式AI生产率为84%（同比增长36个百分点），智能体系统在生产中仅23%；2) 投资仍主要集中于预测模型（60%），而非生成式AI（34%）；3) XGBoost在信贷评分中比逻辑回归提升ROC-AUC约2个百分点，现金流混合模型额外提升零点几个百分点；4) 机器学习使模拟审批率提升近4%，违约审批者减少至少9%；5) 高频交易系统在狭义上已是"智能体"长达15年，新的风险在于大语言模型带来的第三方集中、相关行为、网络和模型风险（FSB 2024）。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 挑战了"AI in finance"作为单一扩散过程的传统认知，提出三层职业、三个时钟的差异化框架；2) 论证了投资优先级排序（预测模型>生成式>智能体）不是滞后现象，而是金融任务本质属性（概率性vs确定性）的理性映射；3) 为监管提供了理论锚点：应基于AI所占据的金融层级（意图/授权/结算）进行规制，而非将AI视为一种同质化的"能力"。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为金融机构提供AI投资优先级的技术合理性论证；2) 为监管机构提供分层监管的政策建议，避免对"AI"进行一刀切规制；3) 揭示了信贷AI的真实边界——它带来更好的评分卡，但不是新的信贷市场或公平贷款机制；4) 提示监管者关注大语言模型在交易场景中可能引发的系统性风险（第三方集中、关联行为、网络和模型风险）。

title: Polycrisis Modeling for Development Planning: Multi-Shock Interactions Across Climate, Supply Chains, and Digital Fragility

detail.title: Polycrisis Modeling for Development Planning: Multi-Shock Interactions Across Climate, Supply Chains, and Digital Fragility
detail.abstract:
Development planning still evaluates shocks in isolation, but the world delivers them in combinations. The report demonstrates—using climate extremes, supply‑chain disruptions, and digital fragility—that modern crises are structurally coupled through shared conduits such as energy, food, transport, payments, and information. As the document states, “The losses lived in the interaction, not in any one system.”

The analysis shows that each shock system is escalating, regressive, and already intertwined: climate disasters impose GDP‑scale losses on low‑income economies; supply‑chain failures propagate through fertilizer, food, and energy markets; and digital shutdowns increasingly disable early warning, payments, and logistics. These interactions are asymmetric and superadditive—compound events consistently produce losses larger than the sum of single shocks. As the report notes, “Joint events are worse than the sum of their parts, yet standard planning tools assume independence.”

The report argues that the modeling gap is architectural rather than computational. Existing tools—network models, input‑output production networks, agent‑based models, integrated assessment models, and scenario stress tests—each capture fragments of compound risk but fail to price cross‑system coupling. To fix this, it proposes a four‑layer polycrisis modeling stack:

  1. Hazard layer — joint event catalogs capturing co‑occurrence.

  2. Transmission layer — network and IO models mapping directional shock propagation.

  3. Macro layer — coupled stress tests quantifying compound losses.

  4. Policy layer — trigger‑based adaptive plans replacing point forecasts.

The report concludes that development institutions must treat polycrisis as a modeling problem before treating it as a financing problem. Pricing interactions enables credible stress tests, actionable triggers, and risk‑financing instruments designed for compound shocks. The core message: development plans must shift from single‑shock arithmetic to interaction‑based planning, because the defining risks of the coming decade live in the coupling between systems, not in the systems themselves.

AI.tldr: 该报告论证现代危机是结构性耦合的"多重危机"（polycrisis），而非孤立冲击。通过气候极端事件、供应链中断和数字脆弱性三个案例，展示复合事件的损失大于单一冲击之和，指出现有规划工具因假设冲击独立而系统性低估风险，并提出一个四层多重危机建模框架——包括灾害层、传导层、宏观层和政策层——以将交叉系统耦合纳入发展规划。
AI.research_question: 发展机构应如何从模型层面将多重危机的系统间耦合纳入发展规划，以替代传统的单一冲击分析方式？
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的冲击并非孤立发生，而是通过能源、食品、交通、支付和信息等共享通道在结构上耦合。然而，现有发展规划工具仍假设冲击相互独立，导致系统性低估复合事件带来的损失。这种建模缺口本质上是架构性的，而非计算性的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多重危机（polycrisis）理论；系统耦合与复合事件（compound events）理论；非对称性与超加性（superadditivity）效应；网络模型与投入产出生产网络理论；综合评估模型（IAM）与情景压力测试方法。
AI.method: 提出一个四层多重危机建模堆栈：(1) 灾害层——联合事件目录捕捉共现性；(2) 传导层——网络与投入产出模型映射方向性冲击传播；(3) 宏观层——耦合压力测试量化复合损失；(4) 政策层——基于触发条件的适应性计划替代点预测。
AI.findings: 三个冲击系统（气候、供应链、数字）均在升级、具有回归性且已相互交织：气候灾难对低收入经济体造成GDP级损失；供应链中断通过化肥、粮食和能源市场传播；数字中断日益使预警、支付和物流瘫痪。交互具有非对称性和超加性——复合事件的损失始终大于单一冲击之和。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"损失存在于交互之中"的核心命题，挑战传统单一冲击评估范式；将多元建模方法整合为统一的四层架构；论证建模缺口是架构性的而非计算性的，为复合风险定价提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展机构提供可操作的多重危机建模框架；建议将多重危机首先作为建模问题而非融资问题处理；通过定价交互关系实现可信压力测试、可行触发机制及针对复合冲击设计的风险融资工具。

title: Fiscal Errors within Fiscal Policy Frameworks: A Process-Based Approach
affiliations: Independent Scholar

detail.title: Fiscal Errors within Fiscal Policy Frameworks: A Process-Based Approach
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach to the analysis of national fiscal policy frameworks (FPF) by examining the processes of consultation, formulation, and implementation of fiscal policy (FP) and the interactions among these processes. These processes are referred to as the Fiscal Policy Process (FPP) Stages. New definitions of the processes and structures depicting the national FPF are introduced, providing a robust analytical framework. The approach draws upon the notion that the study of FP should not be restricted only to how much to spend or tax, but should broaden the discourse to look into the structure of FP institutions in order to determine an institutional structure which guarantees an optimal FP stance. Sub-processes referred to as Reviews are introduced and analysed in-depth; these Reviews represent the transition from one FPP Stage to another. The nature of these Reviews is analysed via four Review Analytical Approaches (RAA): Direction-based, Fiscal Error-based, Hegemonybased, and Review Constraints-based. The parameters articulating and delimiting a FPP are examined to define what a FPP is and distinguish between different FPPs. A formal model of fiscal errors is developed, incorporating political distortions such as rent-seeking and time inconsistency. The paper also discusses the role of independent fiscal institutions and fiscal councils in aligning government preferences with optimal fiscal outcomes. The framework is shown to be applicable to both budget processes and broader fiscal policy actions, and its empirical implementation is outlined.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种分析国家财政政策框架（FPF）的新方法，通过考察财政政策（FP）的协商、制定和实施过程及其相互作用（统称为财政政策过程FPP阶段），引入新的过程和结构定义，构建了一个稳健的分析框架。论文还引入了"审查"（Reviews）子过程作为各FPP阶段间的过渡，并通过四种分析途径（方向性、财政错误、霸权、审查约束）加以分析，同时开发了纳入寻租和时间不一致等政治扭曲的财政错误正式模型。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够全面分析国家财政政策框架的分析框架，超越传统"花多少、征多少税"的视角，转向考察财政政策机构的结构，以确定能保障最优财政政策立场的制度结构？
AI.motivation: 传统财政政策研究仅关注支出和税收的规模与水平，忽视了财政政策制定过程中的制度结构。作者认为应将讨论扩展至财政政策机构结构层面，以确定能保证最优财政政策（FP）立场的制度安排。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政政策过程（FPP）阶段理论：将财政政策分解为协商、制定和实施三个过程及其相互作用；审查（Reviews）作为阶段间过渡的子过程；四种审查分析途径（RAA）：方向性、财政错误、霸权、审查约束；基于财政错误的正式模型，纳入政治扭曲（寻租和时间不一致）。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与概念模型开发；引入FPP阶段的新的过程与结构定义；开发包含政治扭曲因素（寻租、时间不一致）的财政错误正式模型；分析独立财政机构和财政委员会在协调政府偏好与最优财政结果中的作用；概述框架的经验实施路径。
AI.findings: 该框架可同时适用于预算过程和更广泛的财政政策行动；独立财政机构和财政委员会在使政府偏好与最优财政结果保持一致方面发挥作用；提出的参数可界定和区分不同的FPP；该框架具有经验可实施性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个全新的、系统的财政政策过程分析框架，将财政政策研究从结果导向扩展到过程导向，引入审查（Reviews）概念及四种分析途径，丰富了财政政策制度分析的理论工具；将寻租和时间不一致等政治扭曲纳入形式化的财政错误模型中，为理解财政政策偏差提供了理论化的分析基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一套分析财政政策框架的工具，可用于评估和设计预算过程及财政政策行动的制度安排；为独立财政机构和财政委员会的角色提供了理论依据，有助于优化财政治理结构，保障最优财政政策立场。

title: Harmonized Nightlights and Local Economic Activity: Better Focus on Levels, not Growth
affiliations: Nagoya University and

detail.title: Harmonized Nightlights and Local Economic Activity: Better Focus on Levels, not Growth
detail.abstract: Nightlights promise a consistent proxy for local economic activity. We test that promise with a newly harmonized dataset of 1,188 subnational regions in 63 countries. We estimate the elasticity of regional GDP with respect to nightlights across places and over time. Across places, the elasticity is close to one, and nightlights explain most of the variation in local GDP. Over time, the elasticity is an order of magnitude smaller, and nightlights explain almost none of that variation. Harmonized nightlights are therefore much better at locating economic activity than at tracking its growth.

AI.tldr: 本文利用新统一的63个国家1188个次区域数据集，检验夜间灯光作为地方经济活动代理变量的有效性。研究发现，横截面上的弹性接近1且解释力强，但时间序列上的弹性小一个数量级且解释力几乎为零，说明统一后的夜间灯光数据更适合定位经济活动而非追踪其增长。
AI.research_question: 夜间灯光数据能否作为地方经济活动的可靠代理变量？其在横截面和时序两个维度上的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 夜间灯光数据被广泛用作经济活动的一致代理指标，但其在不同维度（横截面vs时序）的有效性尚未经过大规模、协调一致的数据检验。现有研究多基于单一国家或小样本数据，缺乏跨国、子区域层面的系统评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 夜间灯光作为经济活动的代理变量理论，基于夜间灯光强度与经济活动水平之间存在系统性关系的基本假设。
AI.method: 利用63个国家1188个次区域的统一化夜间灯光数据集，通过回归分析估计区域GDP对夜间灯光的弹性，分别在横截面（跨地区）和时间序列（跨时间）两个维度上进行估计。
AI.findings: 横截面维度上，夜间灯光对GDP的弹性接近于1，且能解释地区GDP的大部分变异；时间维度上，弹性比横截面小一个数量级，且几乎无法解释GDP的变动。因此，统一的夜间灯光数据在定位经济活动方面远优于追踪其增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地验证了夜间灯光作为经济代理变量在横截面与时序两个维度上的有效性差异，纠正了以往研究中对夜间灯光数据时序预测能力的过度乐观假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究者在使用夜间灯光数据时提供明确的方法论指导：该数据适合用于空间层面的经济分布分析（如区域比较、区位识别），而不适合用于时间维度的经济增长追踪。

title: Time-Varying Market Sensitivity to Macro News and Monetary Policy: The Role of Attention
affiliations: University of California, Irvine, Department of Economics, Students

detail.title: Time-Varying Market Sensitivity to Macro News and Monetary Policy: The Role of Attention
detail.abstract: This paper documents substantial variation in market sensitivity to macroeconomic news over time. Focusing on interest-rate markets, I estimate a time series of this sensitivity using responses to a broad set of scheduled U.S. macroeconomic releases since 1990. I then distinguish between two possible sources of this variation: market attention and perceptions of the monetary policy rule. The distinction is identified through their differing implications for responses to monetary policy shocks. While both channels can generate strong responses to macroeconomic news, only the attention channel predicts stronger transmission of monetary policy shocks when sensitivity is high. Consistent with this prediction, I find that FOMC surprises have larger effects on the yield curve when macro-news sensitivity is high, with the amplification concentrated in revisions to the expected-rate component. Sensitivity is also systematically related to inflation, labor-market deterioration, and the macroeconomic emphasis of Federal Reserve speeches. Taken together, the findings reveal a systematic time-varying dimension of market attention to macroeconomic information that extends beyond individual releases, and identify attention as a distinct source of state dependence in monetary policy transmission.

AI.tldr: 本文记录了利率市场对宏观经济新闻的敏感度随时间存在显著变化，并通过区分"市场关注度"和"货币政策规则认知"两种渠道，发现市场关注度是驱动这种时变敏感性的关键因素。当宏观新闻敏感度较高时，FOMC意外对收益率曲线的影响更大，且这种放大效应集中在预期利率成分的修正上。
AI.research_question: 利率市场对宏观经济新闻的敏感度为何随时间变化？这种变化的来源是市场关注度还是货币政策规则认知的变动？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常假定市场对宏观经济新闻的反应是稳定的，但现实中这种敏感度存在显著时变。识别其来源有助于理解货币政策传导的状态依赖性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场关注度渠道与货币政策规则认知渠道的区别在于两者对货币政策冲击传导的不同预测：只有关注度渠道预测宏观新闻敏感度高时货币政策冲击传导更强。
AI.method: 利用1990年以来美国定期宏观经济数据发布的市场反应，估计市场敏感度的时间序列；通过货币政策和率冲击的反应来识别两种渠道；结合FOMC意外、收益率曲线分解、通胀与劳动力市场数据及美联储演讲文本进行实证分析。
AI.findings: （1）宏观新闻敏感度随时间显著变化；（2）FOMC意外在敏感度较高时对收益率曲线影响更大，放大效应集中于预期利率成分；（3）敏感度与通胀、劳动力市场恶化和美联储演讲的宏观强调程度系统相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了市场对宏观经济信息的关注存在系统性时变维度，且超越了单一数据发布层面；识别出市场关注度是货币政策传导状态依赖性的一个独立来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 有助于政策制定者理解货币政策的传导效果会随市场关注度状态而变化，为政策沟通与前瞻指引的时机选择提供参考。

title: Continuity Discounting: Why Systems Under Threat Underinvest in Knowledge Transmission

detail.title: Continuity Discounting: Why Systems Under Threat Underinvest in Knowledge Transmission
detail.abstract: Organizations and societies invest heavily in storing information but can still lose the ability to reconstruct or use it once the people who held it are gone. This paper proposes continuity discounting: under threat, systems disproportionately discontinue costly, deliberate knowledge-transfer activities relative to matched-cost activities with more immediate operational payoff-not because the value of transfer has been recalculated downward, but because threat systematically narrows behavior away from the effortful, goaldirected mode that transfer requires. The paper defines continuity of understanding-a successor's reconstructive, explanatory, diagnostic, and adaptive command of a practiceagainst four adjacent, better-established constructs (knowledge continuity management, transactive memory systems, procedural imitation, cumulative-culture research), and argues its contribution is a threat-contingent allocation hypothesis linking these literatures rather than a new construct. It draws on convergent evidence from organizational threatrigidity research, stress/habit neuroscience, glucocorticoid-driven reward salience, the history of economic measurement conventions, and recent formal AI models of collectiveknowledge erosion. Four cases-the Human Interference Task Force, the Ise Grand Shrine's Shikinen Sengu, inventor-death patent data, and Norway's sovereign wealth fund-are presented with disciplined evidentiary labeling (illustration, proxy, or analogy, never proof). The paper closes with five testable propositions, named falsifiers with stated measurement criteria, and a source-and-case transparency statement, framing continuity discounting as a hypothesis with a research agenda rather than an established result.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"连续性贴现"（continuity discounting）假说：在威胁情境下，组织系统会不成比例地削减成本高昂、需要刻意努力的知识转移活动，转而投向同等成本但具有即时运营回报的活动。这不是因为知识转移的价值被重新评估为降低，而是因为威胁会系统地收窄行为，使其远离转移所需的费力、目标导向模式。文章通过四个案例和五个可证伪命题，将这一假说定位为一项研究议程而非既定结论。
AI.research_question: 在威胁情境下，组织为何会不成比例地放弃知识转移活动，即使这些活动的长期价值并未下降？
AI.motivation: 组织和社会在信息存储上投入巨大，但当掌握知识的人员离开后，仍可能丧失重建或使用这些信息的能力。现有文献未能解释在威胁条件下，知识转移活动为何被系统性削减——不是因为价值重估，而是因为行为模式被威胁所收窄。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织威胁-僵化研究（threat-rigidity research）、压力/习惯神经科学、糖皮质激素驱动的奖赏显著性与认知模式转换、经济测量惯例史，以及集体知识侵蚀的正式AI模型。
AI.method: 跨学科收敛证据整合加上多重案例研究。提出"连续性"（continuity of understanding）构念并与四个邻近构念（知识连续性管理、交互记忆系统、程序模仿、累积文化研究）进行区分。采用四个案例（人类干扰工作组、伊势神宫式年迁宫、发明者死亡专利数据、挪威主权财富基金），并配以严谨的证据标注（例证、代理指标或类比，而非证明）。
AI.findings: 提出了威胁情境下知识分配威胁-条件性的假说：威胁系统性地将行为从费力、目标导向模式中收窄，导致知识转移活动被不成比例地削减。文中提出五个可检验的命题，并附带具名证伪标准与测量准则。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"连续性贴现"这一威胁条件性分配假说，连接了组织威胁-僵化、神经科学、习惯心理学和AI集体知识侵蚀等多个独立文献，而非仅提出一个新构念。同时精确定义了"连续性"（continuity of understanding）这一构念，与四个既有构念作出清晰区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了一种诊断框架，帮助理解威胁情境下知识转移为何失效，并提出五个可检验的命题，为后续实证研究和政策干预提供方向。文章还包括来源与案例透明性声明，强调严谨的证据标注规范。

title: Has Bitcoin Become More Equity-Like? Structural Change, Stress Dependence, and the Changing Diversification Case

detail.title: Has Bitcoin Become More Equity-Like? Structural Change, Stress Dependence, and the Changing Diversification Case

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available financial-market data and does not involve human participants, human subjects, personal data, or animal subjects. Accordingly, institutional ethics approval was not required.

detail.abstract:
This paper examines whether Bitcoin’s relationship with traditional equity markets has changed sufficiently to challenge its historical characterization as a diversifying asset. Using daily return evidence spanning 2015–2025, the study investigates three related questions: whether Bitcoin’s correlation with U.S. equities has increased structurally, whether this dependence becomes stronger during periods of equity-market stress, and whether increasing co-movement has reduced Bitcoin’s realized diversification benefit within a conventional equity-bond portfolio.

The empirical framework combines rolling Pearson correlations, regime comparisons, structural-break analysis, stress-conditioned regressions, dynamic conditional correlation methods, and rolling portfolio simulations. Benchmark evidence indicates a substantial change in Bitcoin’s equity dependence around the 2020 period. BTC–S&P 500 correlation increased from −0.107 in 2019 to 0.445 in 2020 and 0.564 in 2022, while BTC–Nasdaq correlation reached 0.595 in 2022. The average BTC–S&P 500 correlation increased from approximately −0.032 during 2018–2019 to 0.360 during 2020–2023 and 0.374 during 2024–2025.

The results suggest that Bitcoin’s diversification properties should not be evaluated using a single unconditional correlation coefficient. Instead, its portfolio role appears to depend materially on the prevailing market regime. In particular, the evidence is consistent with a transition from an asset with relatively weak equity dependence in the pre-2020 period toward an increasingly equity-sensitive risk asset thereafter. The January 2024 spot Bitcoin exchange-traded product approval is examined as an institutional milestone, while the analysis avoids treating the event as an exogenous causal experiment.

AI.tldr: 本文考察2015-2025年间比特币与美股市场相关性的结构性变化，发现2020年前后比特币与美股的相关性从接近零（甚至负值）显著上升至0.4-0.6的高水平，这意味着比特币作为分散化资产的传统角色已发生根本性改变。研究强调不应使用单一无条件相关系数评估比特币的多元化属性，而应基于市场制度（regime）进行条件化评估。
AI.research_question: 比特币与美股的关系是否已发生结构性变化，从而挑战其作为分散化资产的传统定位？具体包括三个子问题：（1）比特币与美股的相关性是否结构性上升；（2）在股市压力期这一相关性是否更强；（3）日益增强的联动性是否降低了比特币在传统股票-债券组合中的实际分散化收益。
AI.motivation: 比特币历来被视为与传统金融市场低相关乃至负相关的分散化资产，但近年来其机构化程度和与股市的联动性显著提升。传统上以单一无条件相关系数评估比特币组合角色的做法可能已过时，需要重新审视其投资组合功能。此外，2024年1月现货比特币ETF获批作为制度里程碑，进一步凸显了重新评估的必要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产分散化理论与现代投资组合理论（MPT）；市场制度转换（regime switching）视角下的时变相关性理论；金融传染（contagion）与风险溢出的相关理论框架。
AI.method: 综合使用多种计量方法：滚动Pearson相关性分析、制度（regime）对比、结构断裂检验（structural-break analysis）、压力条件下的回归分析（stress-conditioned regressions）、动态条件相关（DCC）方法，以及滚动组合模拟（rolling portfolio simulations）。
AI.findings: （1）比特币与美股相关性在2020年前后发生显著结构性变化：BTC-S&P 500相关性从2019年的-0.107升至2020年的0.445和2022年的0.564；BTC-Nasdaq相关性在2022年达0.595。（2）平均BTC-S&P 500相关性从2018-2019年的约-0.032上升至2020-2023年的0.360和2024-2025年的0.374。（3）比特币已从2020年前的弱股票依赖性资产，转变为2020年后日益对股市敏感的風險资产，其分散化属性高度依赖市场制度。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文挑战了比特币作为无条件分散化资产的传统理论认知，提出应基于市场制度进行条件化评估的替代框架。这一发现对金融传染理论、资产定价中的多元化理论以及数字资产生态系统的制度演化理论均有重要启示。
AI.practical_contributions: 为机构投资者和资产配置者提供了关于比特币组合角色的实证重估依据，提示投资者不应再将比特币视为静态的分散化工具，而应根据市场制度动态调整配置策略。同时为监管者和政策制定者理解2024年现货ETF获批后数字资产与传统市场的融合程度提供了经验证据。

title: Industrial Production Dynamics in Q2 2026
affiliations: Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy, Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy and Gaidar Institute for Economic Policy

detail.title: Industrial Production Dynamics in Q2 2026

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Authors have no any personal or financial relationship with other people or organizations
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not require ethics approval
declarations.funderStatement: Gaidar Institute funded this research paper

detail.abstract: The trend component of industrial production in the Russian Federation in Q2 2026 shows that it has stabilized in a phase of stagnation. In the extractive sector, there has been a decline in the production of oil, as well as energy coal and anthracite. Trends in the manufacturing sector are characterized by near-zero growth rates. The sharpest decline in the trend component is observed in both the production of coke and petroleum products and in the production of machinery and equipment. In the short term, industrial production is expected to remain stagnant. At the same time, output in the extractive sector is projected to decline further, including the production of coke and petroleum products. Growth is expected in the production of electrical equipment and motor vehicles (from a low base).

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2026年第二季度俄罗斯联邦工业生产趋势成分，显示工业已进入停滞阶段，采掘业和制造业均表现疲软，短期前景继续低迷。
AI.research_question: 俄罗斯联邦2026年第二季度工业生产趋势成分的现状与短期前景如何？
AI.motivation: 监测和评估俄罗斯工业生产中的趋势性变化，为经济政策制定和短期预测提供依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工业生产趋势成分分析（趋势分解方法）
AI.method: 基于工业生产数据的趋势成分分解与短期预测分析
AI.findings: 1) 工业生产趋势已稳定在停滞阶段；2) 采掘业中石油、能源煤和无烟煤产量下降；3) 制造业增长接近零；4) 焦炭和石油产品、机械设备生产降幅最大；5) 短期预期工业停滞延续，采掘业及焦炭/石油产品继续下滑；6) 电气设备和机动车（从低基数）预期增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了俄罗斯工业近期趋势成分变化的实证观测，丰富了关于转轨经济体工业周期与趋势分析的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为俄罗斯经济决策部门、产业规划者和投资者提供关于工业生产短期走向的参考信息，有助于制定产业应对策略。

title: Appropriability Regimes and the Organization of AI Innovation
affiliations: KU Leuven

detail.title: Appropriability Regimes and the Organization of AI Innovation
detail.abstract: Intellectual property enforcement in artificial intelligence acts on two distinct margins. Courts price the acquisition of training inputs, and they protect proprietary assets from imitation. We model firms that build model quality from appropriable information assets (data, licensed corpora) and from capabilities embodied in researchers, where law can fence only the former and organizational retention only the latter, two distinct exclusion technologies for two distinct inputs. Three results follow. The two enforcement margins tilt the equilibrium source of advantage in opposite directions, and do the same to capability investment and what firms spend to retain talent. The industry's configuration is itself an equilibrium object, fully open when legal fences are weak, fully closed when they are strong, and mixed on an intermediate band where open firms out-retain their closed rivals. Because a fully open industry's equilibrium is invariant to output-side enforcement, pooled enforcement-pay estimates mix an exact zero with the positive closed-regime slope and understate the within-closed response. Measured innovation rises with enforcement throughout our benchmark, while welfare peaks in the interior whenever enough of the input bill is real resource cost rather than a transfer to content owners.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个AI知识产权执法模型，分析法院对训练数据定价（输入侧）与保护专有资产免于模仿（输出侧）两种执法机制如何影响企业竞争优势、人才保留、行业结构（开放/封闭均衡）以及创新与福利。
AI.research_question: AI领域的知识产权执法（输入侧定价与输出侧保护）如何影响企业竞争优势来源、能力投资、人才保留、行业结构均衡以及创新与福利？
AI.motivation: AI产业中知识产权执法同时作用于两个截然不同的边际——训练输入的获取定价与专有资产的模仿保护，但现有研究未系统区分析这两种执法机制对企业策略与行业结构的差异化影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 知识产权执法双边际模型：法律可为数据等信息资产设界（输入侧），组织保留可为研究人员设界（输出侧）；两种不同的排他技术对应两种不同的投入。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建企业从可挪用信息资产与研究人员能力中构建模型质量的理论模型，分析两种执法边际的内生均衡。
AI.findings: （1）两种执法边际对均衡优势来源的方向影响相反，对能力投资与人才保留支出也同样反向；（2）行业结构是内生均衡结果：法律围栏弱时完全开放，强时完全封闭，中间地带为混合结构且开放企业更能留才；（3）完全开放行业的均衡对输出侧执法不敏感，混合执法-薪酬估计会低估封闭体制内的真实响应；（4）创新随执法增强而上升，但福利在中间点达到峰值（当足够多的投入成本是真实资源成本而非转移给内容所有者的转移支付时）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次区分AI知识产权执法的输入侧与输出侧两个边际，揭示其对竞争优势来源的相反影响；提出行业开闭结构为内生均衡对象；阐明混合执法-薪酬估计的偏误来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供执法强度与创新、福利之间关系的清晰映射，指出执法在创新与福利间的权衡取决于投入成本的资源属性；为企业理解法律围栏与组织留才两种排他技术的互补与替代关系提供参考。

title: When Coarse Observations Suffice for Interface Interventions: A Characterization under Frozen Wiring

detail.title: When Coarse Observations Suffice for Interface Interventions: A Characterization under Frozen Wiring

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a theoretical and computational study that involves no human participants, animal subjects, or personally identifiable data; ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: When firm–standard interface wiring is frozen over a specified outcome window, I characterize when aggregate output, an edge census, and type-blind firm records suffice to predict standard-retirement and validation responses. On the full feasible-inventory class, which permits repeated interfaces of the same standard, a response-heterogeneous observation fiber exists if and only if there are at least two firms, two standards, and capacity for two edges per firm. Relative to the stated intervention family, every failure is generated by exactly two families of missing statistics: critical exposure to a standard and heterotype redundancy against its retirement. On the simple-type subclass, which also rules out a firm holding active and latent edges under the same standard key, every two-standard economy is response-sufficient even when the observation is noninjective, and heterogeneity appears if and only if there are at least two firms, three standards, and two-edge capacity. If active and pending interfaces may share a standard key, the weaker simple-edge class applies and the two-standard threshold returns. The characterization therefore tells an observation designer when marginal tables suffice and when two targeted linked counts are needed. Closed-form responses, recovery slices, and finite checks accompany the result. Under the positive-probability failure-event contract, event-indexed output reveals critical exposure but not heterotype redundancy within that contract family. Alternate adoption specifications make witness support cost-specification-dependent. The analysis is a one-period reward-side specialization of stochastic bisimulation, not a new lumpability theorem.

AI.tldr: 本文刻画了在企业-标准接口接线固定的产出窗口中，聚合产出、边普查和类型盲企业记录在何种条件下足以预测标准的退役与验证响应。研究在完整可行库存类、简单类型子类和简单边类三种设定下，给出了响应充分性的精确阈值条件，并识别出两类导致信息不足的缺失统计量：对标准的临界暴露和对其退役的异型冗余。
AI.research_question: 在何种条件下，聚合产出、边普查和类型盲企业记录足以预测标准退役与验证响应？当观测不足时，缺失的信息具体是什么？
AI.motivation: 观测设计者需要知道哪些汇总统计量足以预测企业-标准网络的动态响应，以及何时需要更细粒度的链接计数数据。已有文献缺乏对不同库存类别（允许/禁止重复接口、活跃/待定边共存等）的系统性刻画。
AI.theoretical_framework: 随机互模拟（stochastic bisimulation）的单期收益侧特化；观察纤维（observation fiber）与响应异质性（response heterogeneity）的概念；响应充分性（response-sufficiency）与信息充分统计量理论。
AI.method: 理论刻画与构造性证明：系统枚举可行库存类别（完整可行库存类、简单类型子类、简单边类），分别建立响应充分性的充分必要条件，并提供闭式响应、恢复切片和有限检查方法。
AI.findings: （1）完整可行库存类中，响应异质性观测纤维存在当且仅当至少两个企业、两个标准且每个企业有两条边容量；（2）所有失败恰好由两类缺失统计量产生：对标准的临界暴露和异型冗余；（3）简单类型子类中，任意两标准经济均响应充分，异质性出现当且仅当至少两个企业、三个标准、两条边容量；（4）若活跃与待定接口可共享标准键，则回到两标准阈值。
AI.theory_contributions: 为观测设计提供了精确的阈值刻画，区分了边际表何时足够与何时需要两个定向链接计数；明确了响应异质性与观测纤维类别的对应关系；扩展了随机互模拟理论在单期收益侧的特化应用边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为观测设计者提供可操作的判断准则：何种汇总数据足以支撑标准退役与验证决策预测；明确指出需要额外采集的两种关键链接计数数据。

title: From Digital Asset Treasuries to Enterprise Onchain Credit: A Functional Taxonomy, Evidence-Coded Adoption Map, and Modular Lending Evaluation

detail.title: From Digital Asset Treasuries to Enterprise Onchain Credit: A Functional Taxonomy, Evidence-Coded Adoption Map, and Modular Lending Evaluation

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author holds digital assets, including AAVE, and has personally used decentralized-finance lending protocols, including Aave and LENDLE. No protocol, issuer, exchange, asset manager, or other commercial entity commissioned, reviewed, or approved this research. Personal holdings and transaction data were not used as research evidence. The author alone is responsible for the study design, evidence coding, analysis, and conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human participants, human-subject data, clinical research, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding or in-kind support and was conducted independently by the author. No protocol, issuer, exchange, asset manager, or other commercial entity funded this research.

detail.abstract: Corporate digital-asset research commonly treats treasury holdings as a list of token balances. That approach obscures the economically relevant transition from passive ownership to staking, lending supply, collateral encumbrance, and onchain borrowing. This study combines an evidence-coded comparative dataset with two proposed institutional models. The frozen dataset contains 10 corporate portfolio-position observations, 19 enterprise DeFi events, seven function-specific chain observations, ten institutional operator profiles, nine lending-market observations, and 48 configuration-criterion assessments. Fourteen events are coded Live, two Announced, one Pilot, and two Adjacent; native staking alone is not counted as direct DeFi use. BTCS is the only filing-grade full-cycle direct corporate borrowing observation and is treated as a revelatory anchor rather than a representative firm. The evidence does not support a universal enterprise-preferred chain or lending platform. Across base, legal/control, liquidity/execution, and equal-weight ECLS vectors, Aave and Maple exchange first place, while Morpho remains third and Compound fourth; the top rank is therefore explicitly weight-sensitive. The Functional Treasury State Model separates asset-side states-Held, Staked, Supplied, and Encumbered-from the liability-side Borrowed state, traces predecessor and successor claims, and defines state-adjusted executable value. The Institutional DeFi Stack maps asset/legal rights, custody and distribution, curation and underwriting, and protocol settlement to accountable operators, controls, evidence, and recovery paths. Their combined whole-stack executability principle is proposed for later validation through preregistered coding, incident panels, and benchmark tests; it is not an investment rating, legal opinion, or causal adoption estimate.

AI.tldr: 该研究挑战了企业数字资产研究中将财务库持有视为代币余额列表的传统方法，通过构建证据编码的比较数据集和两个制度模型，揭示了从被动持有到质押、借贷供给、抵押品负担和链上借款的经济相关转变。研究发现企业DeFi使用具有高度异质性，不存在普适性的链或平台，Aave和Maple在ECLS向量中并列第一，且排名对权重敏感。作者提出功能型财务库状态模型和制度型DeFi堆栈两个模型，并呼吁通过预注册编码、事件面板和基准测试进行进一步验证。
AI.research_question: 企业财务库（treasury）从被动代币持有转向主动DeFi参与（包括质押、借贷供给、抵押品负担和链上借款）时，其经济结构和制度框架应如何被系统化地建模和理解？
AI.motivation: 现有企业数字资产研究将财务库持有简单视为代币余额清单，忽略了从被动持有到主动DeFi参与的关键经济转变，缺乏对企业DeFi活动的系统性分析和制度建模。
AI.theoretical_framework: 功能型财务库状态模型（区分资产侧状态：持有、质押、供给、负担，与负债侧借款状态）和制度型DeFi堆栈模型（映射资产/法律权利、托管与分发、管理与承销、协议结算至问责运营商、控制、证据和恢复路径）。
AI.method: 构建证据编码的比较数据集（包含10个企业投资组合仓位观察、19个企业DeFi事件、7个功能特定链观察、10个机构运营商档案、9个借贷市场观察和48个配置标准评估），结合跨base、法律/控制、流动性/执行和等权ECLS向量的排名分析，并以BTCS作为揭示性锚点案例。
AI.findings: 14个事件被编码为活跃状态，2个已公告，1个试点，2个相邻；原生质押不计入直接DeFi使用。证据不支持存在普适性的企业首选链或借贷平台。在ECLS向量上，Aave和Maple并列第一，Morpho第三，Compound第四，排名对权重敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出功能型财务库状态模型和制度型DeFi堆栈模型，引入状态调整后的可执行价值概念，建立全栈可执行性原则，为企业数字资产研究提供了超越简单代币余额清单的制度分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业决策者提供评估DeFi参与的制度图谱和风险控制框架，明确各运营环节的问责主体、控制点、证据要求和恢复路径；同时厘清该研究不是投资评级、法律意见或因果采纳估计的边界。

title: CRE Development Potential and the Selection of Opportunity Zones
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Federal Reserve Bank of Cleveland

detail.title: CRE Development Potential and the Selection of Opportunity Zones

publicationDetails.detailsText: Finance and Economics Discussion Series, issue 2026-056, 2026[10.17016/FEDS.2026.056]

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Place-based policies are often caught between two potentially conflicting aims: (i) directing aid to needy communities and (ii) spurring investment. We study this tradeoff in the context of the Opportunity Zones (OZ) program. Leveraging unique phase-level microdata on commercial construction projects, we show that US state governors prioritized designating tracts where construction projects were already being planned. About two-thirds of the greater construction growth in OZs can be attributed to this selection. States prioritizing tracts with greater investment opportunities observed larger construction increases in designated tracts. We calibrate a structural model to quantify the effects of the program and examine counterfactuals under alternative preferences or eligibility criteria.

AI.tldr: 本文研究美国机会区（OZ）计划中"援助贫困社区"与"促进投资"这两个目标之间的权衡。利用分阶段微观数据，作者发现州长倾向于指定已有在建项目的区域，约三分之二的建筑增长可归因于这种选择性指定。作者通过结构模型量化计划效果并评估不同偏好或资格标准下的反事实情景。
AI.research_question: 机会区计划中，政府在选择指定区域时如何在"援助需帮助的社区"与"刺激投资"两个目标之间进行权衡？选择性指定对建筑增长有何影响？
AI.motivation: 基于地方的政策（place-based policies）常常面临两个潜在冲突的目标：将援助导向贫困社区与促进投资。理解这一权衡对于设计有效的地方政策至关重要，而机会区计划提供了一个独特的自然实验情境来研究这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地方政策目标权衡理论（援助贫困 vs. 促进投资）、选择性指定的政策设计理论、结构转型模型的校准分析
AI.method: 利用独特的阶段级商业建筑项目微观数据，分析州长指定OZ区域的选择模式；使用反事实分析归因选择效应；构建并校准结构模型，评估不同政策偏好或资格标准下的反事实情景。
AI.findings: （1）州长倾向于指定已有建筑项目在规划中的区域；（2）约三分之二的OZ建筑增长可归因于这种选择性指定；（3）优先指定投资机会较大区域的州，其指定区域的建筑增长更大。
AI.theory_contributions: 为地方政策中"社区援助"与"投资促进"目标权衡提供了实证证据，深化了对选择性指定对政策效果评估影响的理解，并通过结构模型量化了不同政策目标偏好下的效果差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何设计地方性激励政策的实证依据，揭示了指定区域选择对政策有效性的关键影响，并为优化资格标准和目标优先级提供了量化参考。

title: Assimilation as a Courtesy: Manchu Bureaucrats and Imperial Personnel Strategy in Qing China (1726-1820)
affiliations: New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Assimilation as a Courtesy: Manchu Bureaucrats and Imperial Personnel Strategy in Qing China (1726-1820)
detail.abstract: How do minority rulers govern a culturally distinct majority? I argue that they use two linked personnel instruments: they dispatch and reward co-ethnic officials who acquire the majority's cultural repertoire, and they rotate those officials through both the regular civil administration and institutions tied to the ruling minority. I test this argument in Qing China, where Manchu rulers governed a Han majority through a Chinese-style bureaucracy while maintaining separate hereditary institutions that kept the conquest elite distinct. Using an original panel of approximately 34,000 position-years and 5,200 officials from 1726 to 1820, I proxy Han cultural fluency with Manchu officials' recorded adoption of Chinese courtesy names. Courtesy-name Manchus received more important local posts and more merit grades after position changes. They also moved more often across and within civil, military, banner, and imperial-household sectors, including from military into civil posts and from provincial service back to the center. Among Han bannermen, courtesy names predict neither appointment importance nor sector rotation, although the smaller comparison sample makes some cross-ethnic contrasts imprecise. When political authority and cultural competence are divided across groups, partial assimilation becomes a personnel technology rather than simply a marker of incorporation or cultural convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究少数族群统治者如何治理文化上不同的多数族群，提出通过"派遣和奖励获得多数族群文化能力的同族官员"并"在常规行政与少数族群制度之间轮换"的双重人事机制。利用清代1726-1820年约34,000个职位-年和5,200名官员的面板数据，以满洲官员采用中文表字作为汉文化流利度的代理变量，发现采用表字的满洲官员获得更重要的地方职位和更多考绩等级，并在各领域间更频繁轮换。
AI.research_question: 少数族群统治者如何治理文化上与之不同的多数族群？具体而言，他们如何利用人事工具来调和政治权威与文化能力的跨群体分裂？
AI.motivation: 当政治权威与文化能力分属不同群体时，统治者面临治理困境。已有研究多关注同化或族群隔离，但忽视了"部分同化"作为一种人事治理策略的可能性。清朝满洲统治者治理汉族多数的历史情境为检验这一理论提供了理想案例。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将"部分同化"概念化为一种人事技术（personnel technology），而非简单的族群融合标志。核心机制包括：（1）派遣并奖励获得多数族群文化能力的同族官员；（2）在常规民政与少数族群专属制度之间轮换这些官员。
AI.method: 基于约34,000个职位-年和5,200名官员的原始面板数据（1726-1820年），以满洲官员是否采用中文表字（courtesy name）作为汉文化流利度的代理变量，采用定量回归分析检验表字采用与职位重要性、考绩等级、部门轮换模式之间的关联，并以汉军旗人作为比较样本进行跨族群对比。
AI.findings: （1）采用中文表字的满洲官员获得更重要的地方职位和更多考绩等级；（2）他们更频繁地在文官、军事、旗人、内务府等部门之间以及部门内部轮换，包括从军事转向文职、从地方返回中央；（3）在汉军旗人中，表字采用不能预测职位重要性或部门轮换，但比较样本较小，部分跨族群对比的精度有限。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）提出"部分同化"作为人事治理技术的新理论视角；（2）揭示了当政治权威与文化能力跨群体分裂时，统治者的文化适应能力成为晋升与轮换的关键筛选标准；（3）将文化能力纳入官僚人事管理分析框架，超越了将同化仅视为融合或文化趋同标志的传统理解。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为理解多族群帝国的治理机制提供了历史证据；（2）揭示了人事管理中的文化能力筛选机制如何同时服务于政治控制和有效治理；（3）对当代多元文化社会中的精英选拔与治理实践具有启发意义。

title: When Consumers Delegate Choice to AI: Strategic Adaptation and Information Asymmetry in Agentic Markets

detail.title: When Consumers Delegate Choice to AI: Strategic Adaptation and Information Asymmetry in Agentic Markets
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence is increasingly moving beyond information provision towards delegated economic decision-making. AI agents can search for products, process information, compare alternatives and potentially select or execute transactions on behalf of consumers. While delegation can reduce traditional search costs, it may also alter the strategic incentives of sellers. This paper develops a theoretical model of an agentic market involving a consumer, an AI agent and competing sellers. The consumer chooses the degree of delegation, while sellers strategically adapt to the AI-mediated decision environment. Greater delegation increases the returns to seller adaptation because AI-mediated evaluation becomes increasingly important for access to consumer demand. Seller adaptation, however, can be either productive, by improving the accessibility and machine-readability of information, or distortive, by improving apparent attractiveness without improving underlying consumer value. The resulting welfare effect depends on the net impact of adaptation on effective AI evaluation. When adaptation is net distortive, welfare is concave in delegation and an interior optimum may arise. When adaptation is non-negative in its effect on information quality, welfare is convex or linear in delegation and the optimal choice is a corner solution. The paper therefore argues that AI delegation should not be understood solely as a technological improvement in information acquisition. Delegation changes the strategic environment in which market information is produced, presented and evaluated.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个包含消费者、AI智能体与竞争性卖方的"智能体市场"理论模型，分析消费者将经济决策委托给AI智能体的程度如何影响卖方的策略性行为及总体福利。研究发现，更大程度的委托会提高卖方适应性调整的回报，而卖方调整可能是生产性的（改善信息可及性）或扭曲性的（仅提升表面吸引力而不增加真实价值），福利效果取决于调整对AI评估的净影响，可能导致内部最优解或角点解。
AI.research_question: 当消费者将经济决策委托给AI智能体时，这一委托行为如何影响卖方的策略性激励、市场信息生产以及总体社会福利？
AI.motivation: AI正从信息提供者转变为代表消费者执行经济决策的代理人，但现有研究多关注AI降低搜索成本的技术效应，忽视了委托行为会改变卖方策略性激励这一层面。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于委托-代理理论与市场微观结构理论，构建消费者-智能体-竞争性卖方三方互动的理论模型，将卖方适应性调整区分为生产性调整与扭曲性调整。
AI.method: 理论建模/博弈论分析，构建包含消费者、AI智能体与竞争性卖方的市场均衡模型，分析委托程度的内生选择与卖方策略的均衡互动。
AI.findings: （1）更大程度的委托增加了卖方适应性调整的回报；（2）当卖方调整净扭曲时，福利关于委托程度呈凹性，存在内部最优解；（3）当调整对信息质量有非负影响时，福利关于委托程度呈凸性或线性，最优为角点解。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将AI委托从单纯的技术改进视角拓展为改变市场战略环境的制度性力量；（2）区分了卖方调整的生产性与扭曲性双重维度，揭示其不同福利效应；（3）为AI市场治理提供了非单调福利效应的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为监管机构设计AI中介市场规则提供依据，提示需关注卖方为迎合AI评估而产生的扭曲性行为；（2）为消费者选择委托程度提供决策参考；（3）为平台设计AI推荐系统的评估机制提供指导。

title:
Beyond a Universal Momentum-Reversal Threshold 
Horizon-Dependent Spectral Geometry and Independent Cross-Market Confirmation of a Robust Reversal Tail
affiliations: Independent Quantitative Researcher

detail.title:
Beyond a Universal Momentum-Reversal Threshold 
Horizon-Dependent Spectral Geometry and Independent Cross-Market Confirmation of a Robust Reversal Tail

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available financial market data and does not involve human participants, personal data, clinical research, or animal subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Short-horizon reversal and intermediate-horizon momentum are established empirical regularities, but the geometry of the transition between them is not. This paper studies whether return persistence is organized in a joint spectral-state-horizon space even when it cannot be reduced to one universal numerical threshold. For each asset, date, return definition, and horizon, I construct a causal horizon-matched spectral persistence coordinate inspired by the frequency-domain representation of Sepp and Lucic (2026), together with a continuous past-future phase product. Positive conditional phase products denote persistence; negative values denote reversal. Flexible time-out-of-sample spline models reveal horizon-dependent topology but only weak observationlevel discrimination. In raw returns, the exploratory spectral-state-horizon interaction improves mean datewise out-of-sample AUC by 0.00401 relative to an additive spline, with a moving-blockbootstrap 95% interval of [0.000285, 0.007581]. A stronger discovery claim-a common critical horizon beyond which the full spectral domain becomes reversal-only-fails under a frozen disjointuniverse validation, and a read-only forensic audit classifies the result as statistical non-replication rather than implementation failure. The research program then narrows the transported object. The final v10 protocol prospectively freezes a percentile-normalized upper spectral tail, q Ψ ≥ 0.85, a Huber-clipped phase response, dependent-data inference, and a market-specific critical onset. On a previously unseen, pre-bound Nikkei 225 universe, the endpoint passes in both return modes: h c = 96 sessions for local-market-residual returns and h c = 147 for raw returns. The evidence rejects the tested universal scalar-boundary formulations and independently confirms a robust spectral reversal region whose onset varies by market and return definition. The results are consistent with a low-complexity spectral-horizon geometry, but do not claim a formally identified intrinsic dimension for the global phase surface.

AI.tldr: 本文研究股票收益持续性（短期反转与中期动量）在"频谱-状态-时间跨度"联合空间中的组织规律，发现存在依赖于市场和回报定义的频谱反转区域边界，但拒绝了单一的普遍数值阈值假设。
AI.research_question: 股票收益的持续性（动量/反转）是否在频谱-状态-时间跨度联合空间中具有系统性组织，而非仅由单一数值阈值决定？
AI.motivation: 短期反转和中期动量是已知经验规律，但二者之间的转换几何结构尚不明确。现有研究通常假设存在一个普遍适用的临界时间跨度阈值，本文试图检验这一假设是否成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 频域理论（Sepp & Lucic 2026的频域表征）、频谱状态-时间跨度联合空间框架、条件相位乘积的持续性/反转判定理论
AI.method: 构建因果的水平匹配频谱持续性坐标和连续过去-未来相位乘积；使用灵活的样本外样条模型；采用移动块自助法、冻结不相交宇宙验证和只读法证审计进行多重验证；在日经225指数上进行前瞻性端点测试。
AI.findings: (1) 频谱-状态-时间跨度交互在原始收益中改善了样本外AUC 0.00401；(2) 全局临界阈值假设在严格验证下失败，属于统计非复制；(3) 在日经225预绑定（pre-bound）样本上，市场特定频谱反转区域被确认，局部市场残差收益临界跨度为96个交易日，原始收益为147个交易日。
AI.theory_contributions: 拒绝了通用标量边界（单一临界阈值）假说，提出并验证了频谱反转区域的概念，表明收益持续性的几何结构是市场特异和回报定义依赖的，支持低复杂度频谱-时间跨度几何假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为量化交易策略提供了市场特定的反转/动量转换点估计方法，有助于投资者识别不同市场环境下的收益持续性边界，优化投资组合构建和交易时机选择。

title: Transaction Composition and Equilibrium Housing-Price Exposure under Heterogeneous Demand

detail.title: Transaction Composition and Equilibrium Housing-Price Exposure under Heterogeneous Demand

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: NO
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Housing demand may be supported by purchasing capacity linked to different economic fundamentals. This paper develops a fixed-supply housing-market framework to characterize how a common equilibrium price responds when heterogeneous demand components are exposed to local and external purchasing-capacity fundamentals. We define an origin-specific equilibrium price-exposure vector whose coordinates measure the responsiveness of the market-clearing price to each fundamental. Under multiplicative willingness-to-pay exposure, these elasticities equal the corresponding demand components' normalized slope contributions at the endogenous clearing price and sum to one. The framework then distinguishes equilibrium exposure from observed transaction composition. Transaction shares depend on willingness-to-pay mass above the clearing cutoff, whereas exposure weights depend on local demand density at that cutoff. Transaction shares therefore do not generally identify the exposure vector: identical observed participation can be consistent with different equilibrium price responsiveness. A share-exposure mapping makes the missing information explicit by combining transaction shares with the local density-to-tail geometry of willingness to pay around the clearing threshold. Transaction composition coincides with equilibrium exposure only under additional distributional restrictions. The framework therefore separates observable transaction participation from latent equilibrium price exposure. Interpreting buyer-composition measures structurally requires information about demand geometry at the market-clearing threshold rather than transaction shares alone.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个固定供给住房市场框架，区分了均衡价格暴露（equilibrium price exposure）与可观测的交易构成（transaction composition）。研究发现，交易份额无法直接识别价格暴露向量，必须结合清算价格附近的支付意愿密度与尾部几何信息才能进行结构性解读。
AI.research_question: 在固定供给住房市场中，当异质性需求成分面临本地与外部购买力基本面时，均衡价格对各类基本面的响应（即价格暴露）如何刻画？可观测的交易构成能否识别这一均衡价格暴露？
AI.motivation: 住房需求受多种经济基本面支撑，既有本地因素也有外部购买力因素。已有研究常以交易构成（如买方来源占比）来推断房价对不同基本面的敏感性，但交易份额与价格暴露之间的理论关系尚不清晰，需要严格的理论框架加以区分。
AI.theoretical_framework: 固定供给住房市场均衡模型；起源特定的均衡价格暴露向量；乘性支付意愿暴露结构；需求密度与尾部几何（density-to-tail geometry）分析。
AI.method: 构建固定供给住房市场的理论均衡模型，推导价格暴露弹性与交易份额之间的映射关系，并通过代数比较证明两者在一般条件下的非等价性，给出使两者一致的额外分布约束条件。
AI.findings: （1）在乘性支付意愿暴露下，价格弹性等于各需求成分在清算价格处的归一化斜率贡献，且弹性之和为1；（2）交易份额取决于支付意愿超过清算截断值的质量，而暴露权重取决于清算截断值处的局部需求密度，两者一般不相等；（3）交易份额不能识别暴露向量，相同的可观测参与率可对应不同的均衡价格响应；（4）份额-暴露映射需要结合交易份额与清算阈值附近的密度-尾部几何信息。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在固定供给住房市场框架下严格区分均衡价格暴露与可观测交易构成，明确了交易份额在结构性解读上的信息局限，为住房市场买方构成分析提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场分析者提供指导：在使用买方构成（如本地vs外部买家比例）来推断房价对基本面敏感性时，需要额外的需求几何信息，不能仅依赖交易份额数据。
