title: Returns, Risks, and Legacies: Understanding Farmland as an Investment Asset
affiliations: Iowa State University, Iowa State University, Iowa State University and Iowa State University

detail.title: Returns, Risks, and Legacies: Understanding Farmland as an Investment Asset

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by funding from the North Central Sustainable Agriculture Research and Education program and by the USDA National Institute of Food and Agriculture, Hatch Project No. IOW04009.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of the American Society of Farm Managers and Rural Appraisers (ASFMRA), 2026 issue

detail.abstract: Farmland has long been both an agricultural resource and a financial asset, yet recent decades have seen new actors and investment logics reshape U.S. farmland markets. Drawing on interviews with landowners, appraisers, farm managers, lenders, and brokers in Iowa, this study examines how stakeholders interpret farmland as an investment. Findings highlight five themes: land's stability and tangibility, evolving return expectations, investor diversity, rental market dynamics, and the role of technology. Results reveal heterogeneity in motivations and practices and suggest implications not only for market behavior but also for extension programming that supports diverse landowners and investors.

AI.tldr: 本文基于对爱荷华州土地所有者、评估师、农场经理、贷款机构和经纪人的访谈，探讨了农业用地如何被利益相关者视为投资项目。研究发现五个关键主题：土地的稳定性与有形性、回报预期的演变、投资者多样性、租赁市场动态以及技术的作用，揭示了市场参与者在动机和实践上的异质性。
AI.research_question: 农业用地作为投资品，利益相关者如何解读和参与这一市场？
AI.motivation: 农业用地长期兼具农业生产资源和金融资产双重属性，但近年来新的参与主体和投资逻辑正在重塑美国农田市场，需要深入理解这一变化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 未明确指出的特定理论框架，采用质性研究视角，聚焦于利益相关者对农业用地的投资认知与行为解读。
AI.method: 采用定性研究方法，对爱荷华州的土地所有者、评估师、农场经理、贷款机构和经纪人进行深度访谈。
AI.findings: 提炼出五个主题：①土地的稳定性与有形性；②回报预期的演变；③投资者多样性；④租赁市场动态；⑤技术的作用。结果表明市场参与者在动机和实践上存在显著异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了农业用地市场中利益相关者对投资解读的异质性，丰富了关于农业用地金融化中参与主体认知与行为的研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果不仅对市场行为有启示意义，还为支持多样化土地所有者和投资者的推广服务项目（extension programming）提供了实践指导。

title: Wassily Leontief's Contribution to Development Planning
affiliations: and

detail.title: Wassily Leontief's Contribution to Development Planning
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the historical relationship between Wassily Leontief’s input-output analysis and postwar development planning from the late 1940s to the early 1980s. Based on Leontief’s published writings, archival records from the Rockefeller and Ford foundations, and the proceedings of the first seven international input-output conferences, we analyze input-output as a theoretical framework, an institution-building mechanism, and a policy tool. Throughout this era, Leontief maintained that input-output modeling was an essential quantitative tool to evaluate alternative scenarios for economic development. The history of the Harvard Economic Research Project shows how Leontief successfully framed input-output as a practical policy tool to secure philanthropic and government funding. However, the global diffusion of input-output shows a piecemeal adoption because of data gaps. Ultimately, input-output’s enduring success was its integration in national accounting systems.

AI.tldr: 本文考察了瓦西里·列昂惕夫投入产出分析与二战后（1940年代末至1980年代初）发展计划之间的历史关系，基于列昂惕夫的公开著述、洛克菲勒和福特基金会的档案记录以及前七届国际投入产出会议记录，将投入产出分析视为理论框架、制度建设机制和政策工具进行综合分析。
AI.research_question: 列昂惕夫的投入产出分析在二战后发展计划时代是如何作为一种理论框架、制度建设机制和政策工具被建构、推广和应用的？
AI.motivation: 理解投入产出分析如何从学术工具演变为全球广泛应用的政策工具，以及其扩散过程中的制度与社会因素，揭示经济知识与政策实践之间的历史互动。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投入产出分析理论（列昂惕夫模型）；科学知识社会学的制度建构视角；政策工具理论
AI.method: 历史档案分析法：基于列昂惕夫公开著述、洛克菲勒和福特基金会的档案记录、前七届国际投入产出会议论文集进行历史文献与档案研究
AI.findings: 1）列昂惕夫始终认为投入产出模型是评估经济发展替代方案的关键量化工具；2）哈佛经济研究项目的历史表明列昂惕夫成功地将投入产出定位为实用政策工具以获取慈善和政府的资助；3）投入产出的全球扩散因数据缺口而呈现零散采用的特征；4）投入产出分析的持久成功在于其被整合进国民核算体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 从科学社会学和政策史视角揭示了经济模型如何通过制度建构和框架化策略成为主流政策工具，补充了关于经济知识生产与传播的历史社会学理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解经济分析工具如何获得政策合法性和制度支持提供了历史经验；揭示了数据基础设施对政策分析工具扩散的关键制约作用，对当代经济模型推广具有借鉴意义。

title:
Brand Value Gravity

Stop Reverse-Engineering Consumer Behavior

Opening the Decision Black Box: G = M × VII × Te

detail.title:
Brand Value Gravity

Stop Reverse-Engineering Consumer Behavior

Opening the Decision Black Box: G = M × VII × Te
detail.abstract: For three decades, brand-equity theory (Aaker, Keller, Kapferer) has rested on one assumption that was widely applied but never tested: that brand strength is the sum of its dimensional assets. The root of that assumption is methodological. The black box of consumer decision psychology resists forward disassembly, so analysts settled for the only route open to them and reverse-engineered brand strength from observed behavior. When several variables collapse at once (Nike Greater China, seven consecutive quarters of decline), reverse engineering can produce a diagnosis in which every line is correct and still leave the CEO with nowhere to start. This paper delivers a forward-engineering framework for opening that box: G = M × VII × Te. The equation reasons from the brand side. It measures what a brand, acting as a gravitational body, emits toward the consumer; which deep human instincts that emission activates; and how those instincts drive a consumer to spend willingly and to keep coming back. The three variables (Substance Redundancy, Vividness of Imagined Inhabitation, and the brand’s capacity to heat consumer emotion) each correspond to a separate dopamine reward pathway in the consumer’s brain. Each can bypass reason and act directly on the instinctive brain, releasing dopamine and driving the kind of purchase that ignores price and pulls the buyer back again and again. The multiplicative form means that any single variable falling to zero takes G to zero. The three are also causally asymmetric: M is the base. All repair has to begin at M, and marketing and M stand in a mathematically zero-sum relationship. The paper uses the synchronized collapse of all three variables in Nike Greater China as positive confirmation, and On Running’s countercyclical surge (full-price sales at a 62.8% gross margin) as the reverse anchor. It then sorts a company’s capacity to respond to the multiplicative trap into a four-tier spectrum, ranked by how precisely the company reads its own M: self-revolution (Titleist), instinct-driven escape (Gemini), cliff-edge escape (AMD), and stuck (Nike). Three diagnostic tools are provided for a CEO to use immediately.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了品牌权益理论三十年来的核心假设（品牌强度等于各维度资产之和），提出一个前向工程框架G = M × VII × Te，从品牌端而非消费者端拆解品牌强度。三个变量分别对应大脑中独立的奖赏通路，且具有乘性关系和因果不对称性。论文以耐克大中华区全面溃败为正证、昂跑逆势增长为反锚，并提供了四层公司响应谱系和三个诊断工具。
AI.research_question: 品牌强度能否从前向（品牌端）而非后向（消费者行为反推）进行拆解？品牌维度资产之间究竟是何关系——是加性还是乘性？当品牌全面崩盘时，CEO应从何处着手修复？
AI.motivation: 品牌权益理论（Aaker、Keller、Kapferer）三十年来依赖的核心假设——品牌强度等于各维度资产之和——从未被验证。根因在于方法论局限：消费者决策心理的黑箱难以正向拆解，只得从观测行为反向推导。但反向工程在多个变量同时崩溃时（如耐克大中华区连续七个季度下滑）会产生每一条诊断都正确、但CEO无从下手的困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 品牌权益理论（Aaker、Keller、Kapferer）的批判性重构；神经科学中的多巴胺奖赏通路理论；黑洞/引力场隐喻（品牌作为引力体）；乘性模型与因果不对称性原理。
AI.method: 理论建模（G = M × VII × Te的乘性方程推导）；案例正验证（耐克大中华区三变量同步崩塌）；案例反锚验证（昂跑逆势增长，全价销售毛利率62.8%）；四层公司响应谱系分类（Titleist自我革命、Gemini本能逃逸、AMD悬崖逃逸、耐克困死）；提供三个诊断工具。
AI.findings: 品牌强度不是维度之和而是乘积：G = M × VII × Te。三个变量分别对应三条独立的多巴胺奖赏通路，可绕过理性直接作用于本能脑。乘性形式意味着任一变量归零则整体归零。三个变量具有因果不对称性：M是基础，所有修复必须从M开始，且营销与M存在数学上的零和关系。公司将公司响应能力分为四层：自我革命、本能逃逸、悬崖逃逸、困死。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对品牌权益理论三十二年来未经验证的核心假设提出系统性挑战；将品牌强度模型从加性结构改写为乘性结构；引入多巴胺奖赏通路作为品牌变量的神经科学微观基础；提出品牌变量间的因果不对称性（M为基础变量）这一新原理。
AI.practical_contributions: 为CEO提供即用型三个诊断工具；提供四层公司响应谱系以帮助企业定位自身处境；明确指出修复必须从M开始，且营销投入与M修复存在零和关系，帮助管理者做资源调配决策；以耐克大中华区和昂跑为案例分析提供了正反两面的实践参照。

title: Stablecoins and Monetary Policy: One Label, Three Different Problems
affiliations: Republic of Uzbekistan

detail.title: Stablecoins and Monetary Policy: One Label, Three Different Problems
detail.abstract: Debate about stablecoins and monetary policy usually proceeds as though there were a single question to answer. There are three, and they are not symmetric. For the central bank whose currency is being tokenised, stablecoins are mostly a reshuffling of claims within the dollar system; the interesting effects fall on policy implementation rather than on transmission. For central banks everywhere else, stablecoins are currency substitution delivered through a smartphone, and the threat is to monetary autonomy itself. For the international system, they are a new and concentrated source of demand for safe assets. This paper separates the three and argues that the implementation question has been the most neglected of them. Evidence from the reserve portfolio of the second-largest issuer shows that stablecoin reserves have become an active participant in the sponsored repo market, with repo holdings that reached over 90% of fund assets after the 2023 banking stress and stood at 69% subsequently, and with roughly three quarters of that exposure routed through the Fixed Income Clearing Corporation by late 2025. That places issuers inside the market where the policy rate floor is set. The paper also argues that the ban on interest payments in United States law is carrying more analytical weight than is generally acknowledged, and that the deposit-substitution literature quietly depends on it.

AI.tldr: 本文区分了关于稳定币与货币政策的三个不对称问题：对美元发行国央行而言是美元体系内部债权重组（影响政策实施）；对其余央行而言是货币替代（威胁货币自主权）；对国际体系而言是新而集中的安全资产需求来源。论文认为"政策实施"问题最被忽视，并以第二大发行商储备组合为证据，展示稳定币储备已成为有担保回购市场的活跃参与者。
AI.research_question: 稳定币对货币政策的影响应如何被分解为三个不同且不对称的问题？其中哪个问题最为关键且最被忽视？
AI.motivation: 现有关于稳定币与货币政策的讨论通常假设只有一个问题需要回答，但实际上存在三个不对称的问题；政策实施维度（尤其稳定币储备参与有担保回购市场）长期被忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策实施与传导框架、货币替代理论、国际货币体系中的安全资产需求理论、存款替代理论。
AI.method: 基于第二大稳定币发行商储备组合的实证证据分析，结合政策实施的理论论证，对三个问题分别进行分离与考察。
AI.findings: 稳定币储备已成为有担保回购市场的活跃参与者；2023年银行业压力后回购持有量超过基金资产的90%，此后维持在69%；截至2025年底约四分之三的风险敞口通过固定收益清算公司（FICC）路由。这使发行商进入了设定政策利率下限的市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 论文澄清了稳定币与货币政策讨论中三个不对称问题的分析框架；论证美国法律中禁止利息支付的条款在存款替代文献中承担了超出一般认知的分析权重；指出政策实施问题是最被忽视的维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为央行（尤其是美元发行国央行）理解稳定币储备对政策利率下限实施的影响提供实证依据；为国际监管讨论中区分稳定币对不同类型央行及国际体系的差异化影响提供分析框架。

title: The FIFA Football Agents Regulations and EU Competition Law: Comments on the Rogon and FT & RCC Sports Judgments
affiliations: Tilburg Law and Economics Center (TILEC)

detail.title: The FIFA Football Agents Regulations and EU Competition Law: Comments on the Rogon and FT & RCC Sports Judgments
detail.abstract: The European Court of Justice has ruled on how to apply EU competition law to the FIFA Football Agents Regulation. This paper summarises the case-specific advice given to the referring court in RCC Sports and finds this wanting. Second, the paper discusses the main contributions the judgment makes to EU competition law generally, namely the application of the Wouters/Meca Medina defence, the application of Article 101(3) TFEU, and the concept of abuse of regulatory powers. For each the Court provides incremental developments from earlier case law but some more radical thinking would help yield more coherence.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧洲法院对FIFA足球经纪人条例适用欧盟竞争法的裁决，批评了RCC Sports案中对移送法院的具体建议，并讨论了该判决对欧盟竞争法的一般性贡献，包括Wouters/Meca Medina抗辩、TFEU第101(3)条的适用以及监管权力滥用概念。
AI.research_question: 欧洲法院对FIFA足球经纪人条例适用欧盟竞争法的裁决如何？该判决对欧盟竞争法（Wouters/Meca Medina抗辩、TFEU第101(3)条、监管权力滥用）有何一般性贡献与不足？
AI.motivation: FIFA足球经纪人条例引发了欧盟竞争法适用中的新问题，需要厘清欧洲法院裁决的合理性及其对竞争法理论的增量发展，同时指出其局限性以促进更连贯的法律框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟竞争法框架（TFEU第101条）；Wouters/Meca Medina抗辩（基于规则合法目标与比例性的豁免分析）；TFEU第101(3)条（效率豁免）；监管权力滥用概念。
AI.method: 案例分析法：对欧洲法院在RCC Sports案的裁决进行批判性评述，并与既有判例法进行比较分析。
AI.findings: 欧洲法院在RCC Sports案中对移送法院的具体建议存在不足；判决在Wouters/Meca Medina抗辩、第101(3)条适用及监管权力滥用概念上提供了对既有判例的增量发展，但仍需更激进的思考以实现更大的连贯性。
AI.theory_contributions: 该判决为欧盟竞争法在体育领域（尤其是联合会监管规则）的适用提供了新的判例增量，进一步细化了Wouters/Meca Medina抗辩的分析路径、第101(3)条的适用条件以及监管权力滥用概念的边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为体育联合会、足球经纪人及相关市场主体提供了关于竞争法合规的指引，也为成员国法院在类似案件中如何适用欧盟竞争法提供了参考。

title: Cloud Sovereignty and Contestability: What Role for the EU Digital Markets Act and the Data Act?
affiliations: Maastricht University

detail.title: Cloud Sovereignty and Contestability: What Role for the EU Digital Markets Act and the Data Act?
detail.abstract: Cloud computing, that emerged as an early response to outsourcing by small and mid-sized firms, has over time, emerged as the foundation of the data economy. Cloud computing is no longer merely outsourcing of non-core functions by firms. It is an irreversible trajectory to path dependence and reliance on the digital ecosystem of the global hyperscalers, Amazon, Microsoft and Google. The dependence on cloud will only strengthen further, as AI and quantum computing, that rely on large cloud capabilities, become central to the big data-driven digital economy. What technical (such as complexity of the technology, learning effects and interoperability) and economic considerations (such as ecosystem effects, egress fee and lock-in) can potentially explain the enduring global dominance of the three hyperscalers? Together these economic and technical considerations, also raise non-economic concerns, such as sovereignty and innovation, in cloud computing, that well underline the urgent call by Nation States across the globe for workable competition in the cloud computing industry. This research contribution develops the foregoing considerations, and reasons that in light of the infrastructural and foundational nature of the cloud, it should be seen as part of a digital ecosystem owned and controlled by the hyperscalers, that also qualify as gatekeepers in the EU's Digital Markets Act (DMA), and other equivalent exante regulatory frameworks across the globe. This ecosystem-driven view offers a normative foundation to consider cloud sovereignty as a non-economic consideration in competition, particularly in light of the irreversible structural impact of cloud on functional autonomy and innovation capabilities of firms. This contribution elucidates how a flexible interpretation and qualitative approach may be more suited to qualify cloud under the DMA, and the relevant obligations therein. It then evaluates the portability and interoperability requirements under the Data Act. The discussion critically evaluates the landscape of cloud computing, and discusses whether together, these legal instruments can effectively promote contestability, fairness and sovereignty in cloud computing, the infrastructure layer of Industry 4.0.

AI.tldr: 本文从技术与经济双重维度分析全球三大超大规模云服务商（亚马逊、微软、谷歌）持久主导地位的原因，并提出将云计算视为由超大规模企业拥有和控制的数字生态系统一部分，基于此生态系统视角为欧盟《数字市场法》（DMA）及其他前瞻性监管框架下的云主权问题提供规范性基础。
AI.research_question: 哪些技术因素（技术复杂性、学习效应、互操作性）和经济因素（生态系统效应、出口费、锁定效应）可以解释三大超大规模云服务商的持久全球主导地位？这些因素引发的非经济关切（主权和创新）如何通过DMA和《数据法》等监管工具得以解决？
AI.motivation: 云计算已从中小企业外包的早期应对演变为数据经济的基础设施，各国对云计算的依赖不可逆转。随着AI和量子计算对大规模云能力的依赖加深，三大超大规模企业的全球主导地位日益强化，这引发了全球各国对云计算行业有效竞争的迫切呼吁，需要从理论和监管层面系统分析这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生态系统视角（ecosystem-driven view）、路径依赖理论、锁定效应理论、数字生态系统理论、事前监管框架（DMA）理论
AI.method: 规范性理论分析（normative analysis）与定性研究方法，结合对DMA和《数据法》等法律文本的批判性解读与评估
AI.findings: 云计算应被视为由超大规模企业拥有和控制的数字生态系统的一部分，超大规模企业符合欧盟DMA中的守门人（gatekeeper）资格；灵活的定性解释方法比僵化标准更适合将云服务纳入DMA监管范围；DMA的便携性和互操作性义务与《数据法》的相关要求能否有效促进云计算领域的可竞争性、公平性和主权仍存疑问。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出生态系统驱动的云监管视角，将云主权确立为竞争监管中的非经济考量因素，为理解云计算的不可逆结构性影响对企业功能自主性和创新能力的作用提供了新的规范性理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构如何灵活适用DMA中的守门人认定和云相关义务提供指导，评估《数据法》中便携性和互操作性要求对云计算可竞争性的实际效果，为各国制定云计算竞争政策提供参考。

title: Does the CPI Reflect the True Inflation? Rethinking Inflation for Financially Constrained Households
affiliations: University of Colorado at Denver - Department of Finance

detail.title: Does the CPI Reflect the True Inflation? Rethinking Inflation for Financially Constrained Households
detail.abstract: The Consumer Price Index (CPI) measures changes in the prices of a representative basket of consumer goods and services, but financially constrained households experience economic pressure through a broader monthly budget constraint. This paper develops a complementary Household Financial Burden Index (HFBI) that combines consumer-price inflation, debt-service burden, housing cash-flow burden, and employment-income risk. Using a quarterly U.S. framework, the index is designed to capture the changing difficulty of financing everyday life rather than to replace the CPI. Illustrative empirical results suggest that HFBI can remain elevated even when CPI inflation moderates and can provide incremental information about household financial distress. The framework also permits distribution-specific indexes for liquidity-and income-constrained households. The paper therefore distinguishes price stability from household financial stability.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个家庭财务负担指数（HFBI），将消费价格通胀、债务偿还负担、住房现金流负担和就业收入风险相结合，以衡量家庭日常生活的融资困难程度，补充而非取代CPI。实证结果表明，即使CPI通胀放缓，HFBI仍可能保持高位，并能提供关于家庭财务困境的增量信息。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够捕捉家庭财务压力的综合指数，以补充CPI在衡量家庭经济压力方面的不足？
AI.motivation: CPI仅衡量代表性消费品和服务的价格变化，但财务受限的家庭通过更广泛的月度预算约束经历经济压力，因此需要一个更全面的家庭财务负担衡量指标。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭预算约束理论、家庭财务压力概念框架
AI.method: 构建了包含四个维度的综合指数框架（CPI通胀、债务偿还负担、住房现金流负担、就业收入风险），使用美国季度数据框架，并允许针对不同流动性约束和收入约束的家庭生成分布特定指数。
AI.findings: HFBI在CPI通胀放缓时仍可能保持高位；HFBI能提供关于家庭财务困境的增量信息；该框架可生成针对流动性约束和收入约束家庭的分组指数。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了价格稳定与家庭财务稳定两个概念，提出了一种超越传统通胀衡量框架的、更全面的家庭财务负担衡量理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了一个补充性工具，以更全面地监测家庭财务稳定性，尤其有助于识别CPI掩盖下的家庭财务困境，并支持针对特定约束群体的差异化政策分析。

title: Rigor ex Machina: Academic Engagement, Deep Learning, and Assessment in an AI-First University
affiliations: University of Kentucky - J. David Rosenberg College of Law

detail.title: Rigor ex Machina: Academic Engagement, Deep Learning, and Assessment in an AI-First University
detail.abstract:
Generative and agentic artificial intelligence can now produce, with extraordinary speed and competence, many of the artifacts universities have traditionally used to teach and assess students: essays, problem sets, reflections, literature reviews, analyses, and research products. This chapter argues that the resulting challenge is deeper than academic integrity. Many traditional assignments were valuable not primarily because of the artifacts they produced, but because producing those artifacts compelled students to retrieve, organize, analyze, compose, revise, reflect, and judge. AI can now sever that connection, producing the artifact while allowing the learner to bypass much of the cognition through which knowledge and expertise are formed.

Drawing on research in cognitive psychology, learning science, assessment, writing studies, motivation, expertise, and human interaction with automation, the chapter examines how universities can preserve rigor without retreating into prohibition. It considers AI tutoring and cognitive offloading; writing as a mode of thinking; AI-resistant and AI-resilient assessment; authentic and motivating assignment design; oral defenses and secured assessments; evaluative judgment and critique of AI output; and the danger that students may acquire “borrowed competence”—the ability to produce expert-looking work with AI without developing the expertise needed to recognize when the machine is wrong.

The chapter ultimately proposes a sequencing principle for the AI-First university: formation first, amplification after. Students need protected stages in which they perform the effortful cognitive work required to build knowledge, judgment, schemas, and tacit expertise, followed by stages in which they learn to use AI to extend those capabilities. The proper goal is neither an AI-free university nor one that measures students by the quality of AI-assisted outputs alone, but an institution designed so that artificial intelligence amplifies capabilities students have genuinely acquired rather than substituting for their formation.

AI.tldr: 本文认为生成式AI对大学教育的挑战远超学术诚信层面——传统作业的价值在于通过产出过程强迫学生进行认知劳动（检索、组织、分析、写作、反思与判断），而AI可以绕过这些认知过程直接产出结果。文章基于认知心理学、学习科学等多领域研究，探讨大学如何在禁止之外保持学术严谨性，最终提出"先形成能力、后使用AI放大"的排序原则，主张大学应设计为让AI放大学生已真正习得的能力，而非替代能力的形成。
AI.research_question: 在大学面临生成式AI和智能体AI挑战的背景下，大学应如何保持学术严谨性而不退回到简单禁止的策略？也就是说，如何设计教学与评估体系，使AI能够放大而非替代学生的认知能力形成过程？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI能够以前所未有的速度和能力产出大学传统上用于教学和评估的几乎所有成果物（论文、问题集、文献综述、研究报告等），这使得传统作业的核心价值面临根本性挑战——因为许多传统作业的价值不在于产出物本身，而在于产出过程所强迫的认知劳动（检索、组织、分析、撰写、修订、反思与判断）。AI切断了这一连接，导致学生能够绕过认知过程而直接获得成果，从而无法形成真正的知识与专业知识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知心理学、学习科学、教育评估理论、写作研究（写作即思维方式）、动机理论、专业知识与专长发展理论、人机交互与自动化研究。
AI.method: 本章为概念性/理论性综述与论证论文，综合多学科研究成果，系统检视AI对大学教学评估的影响维度（包括AI辅导与认知卸载、写作作为思维方式、抗AI与AI弹性评估、真实性与动机性作业设计、口头答辩与安全评估、评估判断与AI输出批判、以及"借用能力"风险），并在此基础上提出规范性建议。
AI.findings: 本文提出"先形成后放大"（formation first, amplification after）的排序原则：学生需要受保护的阶段来执行费力的认知工作，以建立知识、判断力、心智图式和默会专长；之后才能学习使用AI来扩展这些能力。大学的目标既不是无AI的环境，也不是仅以AI辅助产出质量来衡量学生的环境，而应设计为使AI放大学生真实获得的能力，而非替代其能力形成的过程。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"借用能力"（borrowed competence）概念引入教育研究——即学生能借助AI生产专家外观的成果，但缺乏识别机器错误所需的专长。对"写作即思维方式"这一经典理论在AI时代的重新审视，提出认知卸载与认知形成之间的张力。为AI时代的高等教育提供了从"禁止/允许"二元对立转向"形成/放大"时序框架的理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学教育工作者和政策制定者提供了具体的教学设计方向：包括抗AI与AI弹性评估策略、口头答辩与安全评估方法、真实性与激励性作业设计原则，以及如何识别和防范"借用能力"风险。提出了"AI优先大学"的可操作排序原则，指导大学在课程设计中如何安排学生先完成费力的认知形成阶段，再进入AI放大阶段。

title: The Distributional-Agent New Keynesian (DANK) Model: Distributionally Weighted Investment in a HANK Economy

detail.title: The Distributional-Agent New Keynesian (DANK) Model: Distributionally Weighted Investment in a HANK Economy
detail.abstract: Heterogeneous-agent New Keynesian (HANK) models establish that the distribution of household pur chasing power matters for aggregate consumption because households differ in their marginal propensities to consume. But aggregate consumption need not exhaust the macroeconomic information contained in that distribution. Equal amounts of household consumption can reach different firms, and firms differ in how strongly expected demand induces investment. Aggregating heterogeneous household expenditure into total consumption can therefore discard information relevant to investment, capital accumulation, and productive capacity. As a result, a model can correctly characterize aggregate household consump tion while still incompletely characterizing the investment consequences of the underlying distribution of purchasing power, thereby limiting its predictive and explanatory power. To solve this problem, I develop the Distributional-Agent New Keynesian (DANK) model to retain this missing distributional dimension. DANK preserves the HANK household structure and adds a distribution-sensitive firm-investment channel. Household groups differ in their marginal propensities to consume, their expenditure reaches different firms, and firms differ in how strongly investment responds to expected demand. These interactions generate distributionally weighted marginal propensities to consume that measure the investment consequences of income received by different household groups. I derive a net distributionally weighted investment state that removes the portion of the investment response already captured by the conventional HANK aggregate-consumption channel and characterize the exact aggregation conditions under which household distribution contains no additional investment relevant information. Aggregate consumption is sufficient only when cross-household investment effects can be fully represented by conventional marginal-propensity-to-consume differences and a common in come component. When this condition fails, I show that there exist distributional changes that preserve both aggregate disposable income and aggregate consumption while changing investment. Two economies can therefore have identical aggregate income and consumption but follow different investment, capital accumulation, and productive-capacity paths. The model also implies an additional transmission channel for monetary and fiscal policy. Policies that generate similar aggregate-consumption responses can produce different investment and capital responses when their incidence differs across household groups with different investment exposure. The central implication is that household heterogeneity need not stop at consumption: who receives purchasing power affects how much is spent, where that expenditure goes, whether the firms receiving it expand productive capacity, and therefore how the economy evolves over time.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分布异质性主体新凯恩斯（DANK）模型，在HANK模型基础上引入对分布敏感的企业投资渠道，揭示家庭购买力分布不仅影响总消费，还通过不同企业投资反应影响资本积累与生产能力，拓展了异质性主体宏观模型的解释力。
AI.research_question: 家庭购买力分布中除总消费之外，是否还包含影响投资、资本积累和生产能力的重要宏观经济信息？哪些条件下总消费足以充分刻画家庭分布的宏观经济含义？
AI.motivation: HANK模型虽然认识到家庭异质性边际消费倾向影响总消费，但将所有家庭支出汇总为总消费会丢失分布信息——相同的总消费可能流向不同企业，而企业对预期需求的投资反应不同，从而影响投资与生产能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质性主体新凯恩斯（HANK）框架；分布加权边际消费倾向；企业投资的需求驱动理论
AI.method: 构建DANK模型，保留HANK家庭结构并新增分布敏感的企业投资渠道；推导分布加权边际消费倾向和净分布加权投资状态变量；刻画总消费充分性的精确聚合条件，并利用反事实分析展示分布变化对投资的影响。
AI.findings: （1）总消费充分性仅在特定聚合条件下成立；（2）存在保持总可支配收入和总消费不变但改变投资的分布变化；（3）具有相同总量收入和消费的两经济体可走上不同投资与生产能力路径；（4）货币与财政政策在家庭群体间分配效应不同时，即使总消费响应相似，投资和资本响应也可能不同。
AI.theory_contributions: 将异质性分析的视野从家庭消费扩展至企业投资渠道，提出"分布加权边际消费倾向"概念，并给出总消费充分性的精确聚合条件，拓展了异质性主体宏观经济学理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币与财政政策设计提供新视角：政策制定者需关注政策在不同家庭群体间的分配效应及其对企业投资的影响，而非仅关注总消费响应。

title:
Framing the Tigray War: 
Convergence and Divergence between U.S. Media and the State Department

detail.title:
Framing the Tigray War: 
Convergence and Divergence between U.S. Media and the State Department

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is an independent political analyst and the founder of the digital media platform Horn Affairs. The author declares no competing financial interests that influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: A central debate in the political economy of media questions whether the press independently frames foreign policy or merely echoes state cues. This study addresses the empirical gap in this discourse by analyzing the media-state nexus during the Tigray War. Specifically, the mixed-methods media framing analysis examines how three major U.S. news networks (CBS News, CNN, Fox News) and the U.S. State Department framed the conflict between November 2020 and December 2021. Deductively applying Entman’s four framing functions while inductively developing a 26-variable codebook, the research utilized a computer-assisted manual coding procedure on a chronologically stratified sample. The findings reveal a dynamic, phase-dependent alignment. Initially, the State Department diverged from the humanitarian-focused framing of CNN and CBS, aligning instead with Fox News' exclusive condemnation of the Tigray People's Liberation Front (TPLF). Following a brief period of institutional convergence regarding the humanitarian crisis, significant divergence returned during late 2021 counteroffensives. CNN and CBS maintained intense moral outrage at the Government of Ethiopia for famine and systemic disruptions, whereas the State Department retreated to moral equivalency. Furthermore, coverage systematically emphasized immediate political actors while omitting broader regional historical context. Ultimately, this trajectory challenges overly deterministic models of media-state relations, such as strict indexing or the uniform "manufacturing of consent." While the media's failure to prompt substantive executive policy action provides evidence against the "CNN effect"–resonating instead with an elite-driven model–the framing alignment remained highly contingent. The study concludes that modern media-foreign policy interactions operate within a highly dynamic, dual-track information environment. Rather than reflecting a rigid, top-down diplomatic consensus, this relationship is shaped by a complex interplay of changing conflict conditions, competing institutional values, and severe informational constraints, mirroring elements of the cascading activation model.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对提格雷战争期间（2020年11月至2021年12月）美国三大新闻网络（CBS、CNN、福克斯新闻）与美国国务院的媒体框架进行混合方法分析，发现媒体与国家框架之间呈现出动态的、阶段性对齐关系，挑战了严格的索引理论和统一的"制造共识"模型，支持了精英驱动模型和级联激活模型的要素。
AI.research_question: 在政治经济学的媒体研究中，新闻媒体是独立构建外交政策框架，还是仅仅回应国家信号？具体而言，在提格雷战争期间，美国主要新闻网络与国务院之间的框架对齐关系如何动态演变？
AI.motivation: 关于媒体与国家关系的核心辩论长期存在（媒体独立构框 vs. 国家信号回声），但已有研究在这一话语中存在实证空白，尤其是缺乏对具体冲突案例中媒体-国家互动动态过程的系统性分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: Entman的四项框架功能（问题定义、因果归因、道德评价、处理建议）；索引理论（indexing）；制造共识模型（manufacturing of consent）；CNN效应；精英驱动模型；级联激活模型（cascading activation model）。
AI.method: 混合方法媒体框架分析。演绎应用Entman四项框架功能，同时归纳开发26变量编码手册；采用计算机辅助人工编码程序，对按时间分层抽样的样本进行分析，覆盖三大美国新闻网络及美国国务院在2020年11月至2021年12月期间的报道。
AI.findings: （1）媒体与国务院的框架对齐呈阶段性动态变化：初期国务院与CNN/CBS的人道主义框架分歧，而与福克斯新闻对TPLF的独家谴责一致；中期出现短暂制度性趋同；2021年末反攻期间又出现显著分歧。（2）CNN和CBS对埃塞俄比亚政府保持强烈道德愤怒，而国务院退回到道德对等立场。（3）报道系统性地强调即时政治行动者，忽略更广泛的地区历史背景。（4）媒体未能促使实质性的行政政策行动，不支持CNN效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了过于决定论的媒体-国家关系模型（如严格的索引理论或统一的"制造共识"）；支持精英驱动模型；提出并支持现代媒体-外交政策互动运行于高度动态的双轨信息环境中，体现了级联激活模型的要素。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了媒体与外交政策机构之间关系的复杂性，表明框架对齐高度依赖于不断变化的冲突条件、机构价值观竞争和严重的信息约束，为理解媒体在具体国际冲突报道中的实际角色提供了经验依据。

title: Towards a Theory of Institutionally Embedded Preferences
affiliations: , Forman Christian College and Forman Christian College

detail.title: Towards a Theory of Institutionally Embedded Preferences

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no known conflict of interest to disclose.

detail.abstract: This paper develops a decision-theoretic formalization of how informal institutions affect economic decision-making. Standard behavioral and institutional models widely recognize that social institutions influence economic choice. However, they frequently represent this influence through a single analytical channel, typically modeling institutions either as preference shifters within the utility function or as exogenous constraints on choice. The contribution of this paper is not to introduce a new utility function, but to distinguish two ways institutions affect economic choice: (1) informal institutions generate preference states, and (2) informal institutions determine institutionally admissible actions. We formalize a minimal dual-mechanism architecture in which institutions generate agents' preference states while simultaneously determining the institutionally admissible action set. The agent then maximizes utility over this admissible set. The admissibility mechanism represents circumstances in which particular actions expose individuals to severe relational, reputational, or material consequences. Distinguishing these mechanisms allows identical observed behaviors to arise through either internalized valuation or institutionally enforced admissibility. Motivated by qualitative findings from highly collectivist contexts, this framework provides a parsimonious decision-theoretic architecture for representing informal institutions without modifying the underlying principles of rational choice.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个决策理论框架，将非正式制度对经济决策的影响形式化为双重机制：一方面制度塑造偏好状态，另一方面制度决定"制度可容许的行动集"。该框架不修改理性选择的基本原理，而是区分了内部化价值与制度性强制两个通道。
AI.research_question: 非正式制度如何通过双重机制（偏好塑造与行动容许性约束）影响经济决策？
AI.motivation: 现有行为与制度模型通常将制度影响简化为单一分析通道（偏好改变或外生约束），无法解释高度集体主义情境中相同的外显行为可能源于内部化价值或制度性强制这一现象。
AI.theoretical_framework: 决策理论（decision theory）、理性选择理论、非正式制度理论
AI.method: 理论建模：构建一个最小化的双重机制决策框架，在制度生成偏好状态的同时确定制度容许的行动集，代理人在此容许集内最大化效用。
AI.findings: 相同的可观察行为可以通过两种截然不同的机制产生：内部化的价值认同或制度性强制执行的可容许性约束，这为理解非正式制度的作用提供了更精细的分析工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并形式化了制度影响决策的双重机制架构，在不修改理性选择基本原理的前提下，区分了偏好状态生成与行动可容许性两个通道，丰富了制度经济学与行为经济学的交叉理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为在高度集体主义情境下理解和预测经济行为提供更精确的分析框架，有助于政策制定者区分行为改变的内生动力与制度强制因素。

title: One-Step Pathwise Realized LASSO: High-Dimensional Beta Estimation with High-Frequency Data
affiliations: Nankai University, Southeast University and Nankai University

detail.title: One-Step Pathwise Realized LASSO: High-Dimensional Beta Estimation with High-Frequency Data
detail.abstract: We study high-dimensional beta estimation in continuous-time regression models using high-frequency data. We develop an OLS-anchored one-step pathwise regularization framework that retains the local realized-regression representation while selecting variables over their entire loading trajectories. The one-step Realized LASSO and Adaptive Realized LASSO are explicit KKT-screened quadratic-surrogate updates to blockwise realized OLS paths, so the main theory directly concerns computable estimators. We establish exact path support recovery and max-norm error bounds uniformly over local blocks and coordinates, allowing both the regressor dimension and the active support to increase slowly. For integrated estimation, the common Realized LASSO penalty leaves a non-negligible shrinkage term at the √ n scale, whereas adaptive weighting makes this term asymptotically negligible and yields feasible centered mixed-normal inference for prespecified fixed-dimensional active coordinates. Simulations support these theoretical findings. An application to high-frequency factor prediction for large-cap U.S. technology stocks indicates a favorable out-of-sample prediction-complexity trade-off, particularly during volatile market periods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了高频数据下连续时间回归模型中的高维beta估计问题，提出了一种基于OLS锚定的一步路径正则化框架（一步Realized LASSO和自适应Realized LASSO），能够在保留局部实现回归表示的同时，沿整个载荷轨迹进行变量选择。文章建立了精确路径支持恢复和最大范数误差界，并证明了自适应权重可以使收缩项渐近可忽略，从而获得可行的中心化混合正态推断。
AI.research_question: 在高频数据驱动的连续时间回归模型中，如何实现高维beta的高效估计与变量选择，同时保证统计推断的可行性？
AI.motivation: 高频数据环境下beta估计面临高维挑战，传统方法难以在保持计算可行性的同时实现变量选择与统计推断，亟需一个既能处理高维变量选择又能提供可靠推断的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: OLS锚定的一步路径正则化框架；Realized LASSO与Adaptive Realized LASSO；KKT筛选的二次代理更新；混合正态推断理论。
AI.method: 采用分块实现OLS路径上的一步路径正则化方法，通过KKT筛选和二次代理更新实现显式可计算的估计器；利用自适应权重处理收缩偏差，实现渐近正态推断。
AI.findings: （1）建立了路径支持恢复的精确性和均匀最大范数误差界；（2）普通Realized LASSO在√n尺度下留下非可忽略的收缩项，而自适应加权使该收缩项渐近可忽略；（3）模拟实验验证了理论结果；（4）应用于美国大型科技股的高频因子预测，展示了有利的样本外预测-复杂度权衡，尤其在波动市场时期。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在高频连续时间回归框架下建立了高维beta估计的精确路径支持恢复理论；揭示了Realized LASSO的√n阶收缩偏差问题，并证明自适应加权可消除该偏差，为高频高维推断提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高频金融数据中的高维因子预测提供了可计算的正则化估计框架，在实际应用（如美国大型科技股预测）中展示了良好的样本外预测表现与模型复杂度权衡。

title: Teaching Reliability and Factor Structure with Published Open Data: A Spreadsheet Template, an R Shiny Application, and their Verification
affiliations: Nanzan University

detail.title: Teaching Reliability and Factor Structure with Published Open Data: A Spreadsheet Template, an R Shiny Application, and their Verification

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no competing interests to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study involved no human participants. It reanalyses data collected by other investigators, deidentified by them and released under a CC0 public domain dedication as supporting information to a published article.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Courses in statistics teach statistics. What they less often do is take a researcher in an applied field through the few procedures that field uses, on the kind of data it produces, as far as the sentence that appears in a paper. Coefficient alpha is a case in point: it is reported almost universally in scale-based research, and usually as a bare value set against an arbitrary threshold. This short communication reports two open teaching tools built from the second position rather than the first, by an author whose field is public administration. The first is a spreadsheet template that computes Cronbach's alpha with every intermediate quantity visible; the second is a single-purpose R Shiny application that performs an exploratory factor analysis with its extraction, rotation and deletion rule fixed to a published specification, prints loadings to three decimals, and drafts the sentences a report requires while leaving the interpretation blank. Two slide decks and a conversion script accompany them. Verification used the openly deposited item-level data of a published validation study of a 35-item measure. Descriptive statistics, validity correlations and the split-half reliability were reproduced at the precision reported. Applied to the same ten items, the template and the application returned coefficients differing only in their treatment of missing responses, a discrepancy the template itself announces. The exercise also surfaced four defects in the author's own tools that testing against the bundled example could not have exposed.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了两个开放教学工具：一个用于计算Cronbach's alpha的电子表格模板，以及一个执行探索性因子分析的R Shiny应用。这两个工具从"应用领域研究者"的立场出发，而非统计学课程的立场，旨在帮助研究者完成论文中报告所需的统计步骤。通过使用已发表的35条目验证研究的公开数据验证，工具成功复现了描述性统计、效度相关性和分半信度，但也发现了作者自身工具的四个缺陷。
AI.research_question: 如何为应用领域的研究者（而非统计学学生）构建教学工具，使其能够完成从数据到论文报告语句的完整统计流程？
AI.motivation: 统计学课程教授的是统计学本身，但很少针对特定应用领域的研究者，教会他们该领域实际使用的少数几个程序，包括如何处理该领域产生的数据类型，以及如何写出论文中出现的报告语句。以Cronbach's alpha为例，它在基于量表的研究中几乎普遍被报告，但通常只是以一个裸数值对抗一个任意阈值，研究者缺乏对其计算过程和报告方式的深入理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该论文不涉及传统意义上的理论框架，其核心立场是教学法上的"第二立场"——即从应用领域研究者的实际需求出发，而非从统计学科的逻辑出发构建教学工具。理论基础可理解为基于实践导向的教学设计理念。
AI.method: 作者开发了两个开放教学工具：(1) 计算Cronbach's alpha的电子表格模板，所有中间量均可见；(2) 单用途R Shiny应用，按已发表规范执行探索性因子分析（提取、旋转和删除规则固定），以三位小数打印载荷，并草拟报告所需语句但留白解释部分。另附两个幻灯片和转换脚本。验证使用了一项已发表的35条目量表验证研究的公开逐项数据。
AI.findings: (1) 描述性统计、效度相关性和分半信度均以报告精度成功复现；(2) 对相同的十个条目，模板和应用返回的系数仅在缺失值处理上有所不同，模板自身会提示这一差异；(3) 测试过程暴露了作者自身工具中四个仅靠捆绑示例测试无法发现的缺陷。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献有限，主要在于提出了一种教学工具的构建立场——从应用领域研究者的实际论文写作需求出发（"第二立场"），而非从统计学学科体系出发（"第一立场"），为统计教学工具的设计提供了一种新的思路。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了两个可直接使用的开放教学工具（电子表格模板和R Shiny应用），帮助应用领域研究者完成Cronbach's alpha计算和探索性因子分析，并能自动生成论文报告语句，降低统计软件使用门槛。同时通过公开验证，展示了工具的可复现性和潜在的缺陷识别能力。

title: Rethinking the Money: Properties of Money in the 21st Century Working Paper

detail.title: Rethinking the Money: Properties of Money in the 21st Century Working Paper
detail.abstract: Over the past two decades, technological progress has changed not only how people pay, but also how they think about money itself. Cards, mobile wallets, instant payments, crypto-assets, stablecoins and the prospect of a digital euro have widened the menu of instruments that can be used to transfer value. Yet broader choice has also created confusion. The fact that something is digital, fast or programmable does not automatically make it money in the full economic sense. Building on the framework proposed by Hull and Sattath (2021), this paper revisits the traditional properties of money and asks how they should be interpreted in a world shaped by platforms, real-time payments and tokenised claims. It argues that the classical functions of money remain valid, but that in the twenty-first century they must be complemented by institutional properties such as convertibility at par, settlement finality, resilience under stress, privacy protection and interoperability. Against this benchmark, the paper compares commercial bank deposits, crypto-assets, stablecoins, tokenised deposits and central bank digital currencies, with particular attention to the digital euro. The central conclusion is that digital innovation is changing the form of money far more than its essence. Good money in the twenty-first century is still money that is trusted, stable, widely accepted and embedded in a credible public framework. From that perspective, the digital euro is best understood not as a technological fashion, but as a strategic attempt to preserve public money in a digital economy.

AI.tldr: 本文基于Hull和Sattath（2021）的框架，重新审视货币的传统属性在数字化时代（平台、实时支付、代币化债权）的适用性，提出21世纪货币需补充可兑换性、结算终局性、抗压韧性、隐私保护和互操作性等制度性属性，并据此比较商业银行存款、加密资产、稳定币、代币化存款和央行数字货币（特别是数字欧元），结论是数字创新改变的是货币形式而非本质，优质货币仍需可信、稳定、广泛接受并嵌入可信的公共框架。
AI.research_question: 在数字技术（卡片、移动钱包、即时支付、加密资产、稳定币、数字欧元）重塑支付格局的背景下，货币的传统属性应如何重新解读？数字创新是否改变了货币的本质？
AI.motivation: 过去二十年技术进步不仅改变了支付方式，也改变了人们对货币本身的认知。数字、快速或可编程的东西并不自动构成完整经济意义上的货币，更广泛的支付选择反而造成了困惑，因此需要重新界定数字时代货币的属性标准。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Hull和Sattath（2021）提出的框架，结合货币的传统职能理论（交易媒介、记账单位、价值贮藏），并补充21世纪所需的制度性属性：平价可兑换性、结算终局性、压力下的韧性、隐私保护、互操作性。
AI.method: 理论框架构建与比较分析。以传统货币属性为基础，加入数字时代补充属性作为基准，对商业银行存款、加密资产、稳定币、代币化存款和央行数字货币（重点为数字欧元）进行系统性比较评估。
AI.findings: （1）货币的传统职能依然有效，但21世纪需补充可兑换性、结算终局性、抗压韧性、隐私保护和互操作性等制度属性；（2）相较于其他数字支付形式，数字欧元应被视为在数字经济中维护公共货币的战略性举措，而非技术时尚；（3）数字创新改变的是货币的形式而非本质——好的货币仍然是可信、稳定、被广泛接受并嵌入可信公共框架的货币。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了货币属性理论，将传统三职能与数字时代制度属性（可兑换性、结算终局性、韧性、隐私、互操作性）相结合，提出"形式变化、本质不变"的分析框架，为评估新型数字货币形态提供了理论基准。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者评估各类数字支付工具的货币属性提供分析框架；为数字欧元的设计与定位提供理论依据，阐明其作为维护公共货币的战略意义；为理解加密资产和稳定币在经济学意义上的货币属性提供判据。

title: The Economics of Mercy: A Theoretical Framework for Restorative Fiscal Policy
affiliations: Al-Neelain University - Department of Economics

detail.title: The Economics of Mercy: A Theoretical Framework for Restorative Fiscal Policy

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Im a Professor interested of humanities
declarations.ethicsApproval: There is not conflict
declarations.funderStatement: No funding

detail.abstract: Classical economic models traditionally operate on the assumption of Homo economicus—a rational, self-interested agent who responds predictably to punitive deterrents and material incentives (Becker, 1968). This paper challenges that paradigm by introducing a novel theoretical framework: The Economics of Mercy. Defined as the systematic application of restorative justice, debt forgiveness, and conditional forbearance, mercy is posited not as an act of moral sentimentality, but as a high-yield macroeconomic strategy. This paper synthesizes behavioral economics (Kahneman & Tversky, 1979; Akerlof & Shiller, 2015), transaction cost theory (North & Weingast, 1989; Fukuyama, 1995; Rothstein, 2005), and human capital models (Becker, 1964; Western & Pettit, 2010) to argue that mercy reduces deadweight loss, unlocks liquidity, and generates a "trust dividend" that lowers systemic risk. Through the construction of two original quantitative metrics—the Recidivism Multiplier (RM) and the Mercy Fiscal Multiplier (MFM)—this paper demonstrates that conditional forbearance yields Pareto-superior outcomes compared to retributive enforcement. Historical analysis of debt jubilees from Ancient Mesopotamia (Hudson, 1993) to the 1953 London Debt Agreement (Ritschl, 2012) provides empirical grounding. The paper addresses the moral hazard objection (Krugman, 2009) by introducing a Risk Adjustment Factor (RAF) and concludes that mercy, when institutionalized, functions as an automatic stabilizer that preserves human capital and stimulates long-term aggregate demand. A formal Difference-in-Differences methodology is proposed for future empirical testing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"仁慈经济学"这一全新理论框架，主张将恢复性司法、债务减免和有条件宽容视为一种高收益的宏观经济策略，而非道德情感行为。通过构建累犯乘数（RM）和仁慈财政乘数（MFM）两个量化指标，结合行为经济学、交易成本理论和人力资本模型，论证有条件的仁慈相比惩罚性执法能产生帕累托更优的结果，并引入风险调整因子（RAF）解决道德风险问题。
AI.research_question: 仁慈（恢复性司法、债务减免、有条件宽容）能否作为一种系统的宏观经济策略，在降低系统性风险的同时产生比传统惩罚性执法更优的经济结果？
AI.motivation: 传统经济学建立在"经济人"假设之上，认为行为人对惩罚威慑和物质激励做出可预测的理性反应。但该范式忽视了仁慈在经济系统中的潜在价值。本文旨在挑战这一范式，论证仁慈不是道德情感主义，而是一种高收益的宏观经济策略，能够减少无谓损失、释放流动性并产生"信任红利"。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了三大理论支柱：1）行为经济学（Kahneman & Tversky, 1979; Akerlof & Shiller, 2015）——解释非理性行为与信任的作用机制；2）交易成本理论（North & Weingast, 1989; Fukuyama, 1995; Rothstein, 2005）——阐明仁慈如何降低制度交易成本；3）人力资本模型（Becker, 1964; Western & Pettit, 2010）——说明仁慈如何保护人力资本存量。
AI.method: 理论构建与历史实证分析相结合。方法包括：1）构建两个原创量化指标——累犯乘数（RM）和仁慈财政乘数（MFM）；2）历史案例分析——从古代美索不达米亚的债务豁免到1953年伦敦债务协定；3）提出风险调整因子（RAF）以回应道德风险质疑；4）提出正式的双重差分（DID）方法供未来实证检验。
AI.findings: 本文的主要发现是：1）有条件的宽容（conditional forbearance）相比惩罚性执法能够产生帕累托更优的结果；2）仁慈能够减少死重损失、释放流动性，并产生降低系统性风险的"信任红利"；3）历史证据（从古代美索不达米亚到1953年伦敦债务协定）为仁慈的宏观经济效益提供了经验支撑；4）引入风险调整因子后，制度化的仁慈可作为自动稳定器，保护人力资本并刺激长期总需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于：1）提出了"仁慈经济学"这一原创性理论框架，挑战了传统经济人假设的支配地位；2）创造性地整合了行为经济学、交易成本理论和人力资本模型来解释仁慈的经济机制；3）构建了累犯乘数（RM）和仁慈财政乘数（MFM）两个原创量化指标，为仁慈的经济效应提供了可测量工具；4）通过风险调整因子（RAF）回应了道德风险这一经典理论质疑，丰富了制度经济学关于宽容与信任的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 实践贡献在于：1）为政策制定者提供了将仁慈制度化的理论依据，将恢复性司法和债务减免从道德议题转化为经济政策工具；2）提出的量化指标（RM、MFM、RAF）可应用于司法、金融和财政政策的设计与评估；3）双重差分方法的设计为未来实证检验提供了明确的操作路径；4）历史经验——从古代债务豁免到现代债务协定——为当前债务危机和经济治理提供了可借鉴的政策启示。

title: Symbolism in Sufism: A Theoretical and Applied Study of the Models of Ibn Arabi and Ibn al-Farid
affiliations: The Iraqia University

detail.title: Symbolism in Sufism: A Theoretical and Applied Study of the Models of Ibn Arabi and Ibn al-Farid
detail.abstract: Symbolism constitutes a core epistemological feature of Sufi discourse. It did not emerge as literary ornamentation, but rather as a methodological necessity to articulate experiential and tastebased meanings that elude direct linguistic expression. This study theorizes the concept of symbolism in Sufism, examines its causes, types, and methodological controls, and applies this framework through a comparative analysis of two pivotal figures: Muhyiddin Ibn Arabi as the "model of the intellect," and Umar Ibn al-Farid as the "model of the heart." The findings indicate that Sufi symbolism performs three primary functions: protective, pedagogical, and epistemological. Furthermore, the study argues that the comprehension of Sufi symbols is contingent upon spiritual wayfaring (suluk) and direct tasting (zawq).

AI.tldr: 本文对苏菲主义中的象征主义进行了理论化探讨，认为象征主义并非文学装饰，而是表达超越直接语言表达范畴的经验性和品味性意义的方方法论必要。通过对两位核心人物——被称为"理智典范"的伊本·阿拉比和被称为"心灵典范"的伊本·法里德——的比较分析，研究发现苏菲象征主义具有保护、教学和认识论三种主要功能，且对其理解依赖于精神修行（suluk）和直接品味（zawq）。
AI.research_question: 苏菲主义中象征主义的本质是什么？其产生的原因、类型和方法论控制是什么？
AI.motivation: 苏菲话语的核心认识论特征是象征主义，但象征主义并非作为文学装饰出现，而是表达无法被直接语言所捕捉的经验性和品味性意义的方方法论必要。需要对这一现象进行系统理论化研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 苏菲主义认识论；象征主义理论；精神修行（suluk）与直接品尝（zawq）理论
AI.method: 对苏菲象征主义的概念进行理论化分析，并通过对伊本·阿拉比（理智典范）和伊本·法里德（心灵典范）两位关键人物的比较研究加以应用
AI.findings: 苏菲象征主义具有三种主要功能：保护功能、教学功能和认识论功能；对苏菲象征符号的理解取决于精神修行（suluk）和直接品尝（zawq）
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统地将苏菲象征主义概念进行理论化，阐释其产生原因、类型和方法论控制，并揭示了象征主义的三重功能框架以及理解象征所需的精神条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过伊本·阿拉比和伊本·法里德的比较分析，为理解苏菲文本中的象征语言提供了分析框架，有助于更准确地解读苏菲文学作品和宗教话语。

title: Holding Talent in Reserve: Journeymen, Stars, and the Rule of Succession
affiliations: London School of Economics & Political Science (LSE) - Department of Government

detail.title: Holding Talent in Reserve: Journeymen, Stars, and the Rule of Succession
detail.abstract: A leader's ablest people are worth one thing fielded and another withheld. Fielded, a talented minister, a star, delivers the performance his talent yields; withheld, the prospect that he might be called disciplines the lesser figure, a journeyman, in his place. We characterise the optimal schedule: the leader husbands her star while the government is strong and deploys him as it weakens; husband early, deploy late. And we identify the mechanism that sustains the schedule in equilibrium. It is not deterrence, the reserve held as a standing threat, but deployment: a scarce, durable star is a closer, brought on for the run-in. A hungry unknown outworks a coasting known talent while the hunger lasts; only as the incumbent's effort fades does proven quality overtake him, and the leader fields her star for the finish. The schedule survives a deeper bench of stars, and inverts under uncertainty: a proven veteran is fielded last, an untested prospect early.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究领导者如何在明星人才（高能力者）与普通人才之间进行最优的时间调度安排。核心结论是：领导者在政府/组织强势时应"养精蓄锐"（扣留明星），在弱势时应"适时派遣"（部署明星）。这类似于棒球比赛中终结者投手的运用策略——稀缺而持久的明星是"终结者"，在最后时刻登场。文章还深入分析了维持这种调度均衡的机制：不是威慑（将明星作为常备威胁），而是部署本身。此外，论文考察了更深板凳深度（更多明星）和不确定性条件下的调度方案变化。
AI.research_question: 领导者如何最优地调度有才能的下属（明星人才）与普通人才的出场时机？什么机制维持了这种最优调度方案在均衡中的持续性？
AI.motivation: 领导者面临的现实困境：明星人才若过早使用可能浪费其价值，若过晚使用可能错失机会。论文试图回答什么是最优的"使用-保留"时间表，并解释为什么这种时间表能在均衡中自我维持——特别是为什么机制不是威慑而是部署。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论均衡分析、激励理论（努力随时间衰减效应）、人才管理与组织理论。核心逻辑基于"饥饿的新人"与"成熟的明星"之间的努力-能力权衡动态变化。
AI.method: 理论建模（博弈论/最优控制模型），刻画领导者与下属之间的动态激励与调度博弈，分析均衡调度时间表及其稳健性。
AI.findings: 1）最优调度方案是"早养晚用"：组织强势时扣留明星，弱势时部署明星。2）维持均衡的机制是部署而非威慑。3）稀缺而持久的明星应作为"终结者"在最后阶段登场。4）当板凳深度增加（更多明星）时调度方案依然稳健。5）在不确定性条件下调度方案发生反转：有经验的老将最后上场，未经验证的新人提前上场。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人才调度均衡的维持机制——不是传统的"威慑"逻辑（保留作为常备威胁），而是"部署"逻辑（实际使用才能实现最优激励）。深化了对组织内人力资源动态最优配置的理论理解，并将体育管理中的"终结者"概念引入组织人才管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者提供可操作的人才调度指导：应在何时扣留明星人才、何时部署；理解为何"饥饿的新人"在短期内可能超过"懈怠的明星"；在不确定性环境下应如何调整调度策略（有经验者压轴、新人打头阵）。

title: A Modern Approach to Return on Security Investment (ROSI)
affiliations: and

detail.title: A Modern Approach to Return on Security Investment (ROSI)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Originally published by the FAIR Institute. Reposted with permission. Please refer to www.fairinstitute.org for the authoritative version.

detail.abstract:
Cybersecurity leaders are increasingly expected to justify security investments with the same financial rigor applied to other business initiatives. Traditional Return on Security Investment (ROSI) calculations offer a quick way to estimate the cost-effectiveness of security controls, but they often overlook important factors such as uncertainty in cyber risk, diminishing returns from additional spending, and the time value of money. As a result, ROSI alone can lead to incomplete or misleading conclusions when evaluating significant cybersecurity investments.


This paper presents a practical framework that combines FAIR-based cyber risk quantification with established financial decision tools such as Net Present Value (NPV), Internal Rate of Return (IRR), and the Gordon–Loeb model.


Originally published by the FAIR Institute. Reposted with permission. Please refer to www.fairinstitute.org for the authoritative version.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个实用框架，将基于FAIR的网络安全风险量化与NPV、IRR和Gordon-Loeb模型等金融决策工具相结合，以克服传统ROSI计算在评估重大网络安全投资时的局限性，包括忽视不确定性、边际收益递减和货币时间价值等问题。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个更完善的网络安全投资评估框架，以弥补传统ROSI计算在重大投资决策中的不足？
AI.motivation: 网络安全领导者需要以与其他商业投资相同的财务严谨性来论证安全投资，但传统ROSI计算方法忽略了网络风险的不确定性、额外支出的边际收益递减以及货币时间价值等重要因素，可能导致不完整或误导性的评估结论。
AI.theoretical_framework: FAIR（Factor Analysis of Information Risk）网络风险量化模型、净现值（NPV）、内部收益率（IRR）、Gordon-Loeb模型。
AI.method: 提出一个综合性的实用框架，将FAIR风险量化方法与NPV、IRR和Gordon-Loeb模型等传统金融决策工具相结合。
AI.findings: 该框架能够提供比传统ROSI更全面的网络安全投资评估，考虑到风险不确定性、投资边际收益递减以及货币的时间价值。
AI.theory_contributions: 将信息安全经济学中的FAIR模型与经典金融决策工具（NPV、IRR、Gordon-Loeb）进行整合，拓展了网络安全投资评估的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络安全领导者提供了更严谨的财务论证工具，帮助其以与其他商业投资同等水平的财务严谨性来评估和证明安全投资决策。

title: An Economic Analysis of Contractual Conditions
affiliations: and Yale University - Law School

detail.title: An Economic Analysis of Contractual Conditions

keywords: Economic Analysis of Contract Conditions and Remedies

detail.abstract: Law and economics has produced a vast literature on the efficient design of contract damages, but almost none on the defensive counterpart to damages: the contractual condition that lets a promisee withhold its own performance when the performance it was promised falls short. This article supplies that missing analysis. Contracts protect entitlements through a mixture of offensive protection-the right to sue for damages or specific performance-and defensive protection-the right to withhold. The observed variation in that mixture is neither random nor merely path dependent. Two variables dominantly explain this: the forfeiture that a defensive withholding can inflict on a relying counterparty, and the verifiability (or enforceability) of breach to a court. We catalog five recurring configurations, ranging from offensive-only to defensive-only protections, and use the forfeiture-verifiability framework to resolve a series of puzzles that resist explanation when damages are studied in isolation: why sellers enjoy a perfect-tender right while buyers of services receive only substantial-performance protection, why some restaurants are paid in advance and others after the meal, why insurers are protected by conditions alone, and why material-adverse-change clauses are drafted as standards rather than rules. A formal numerical model reproduces different offensive and defensive protection configurations as the optimal contract for a different region of the forfeitureverifiability space. Finally, we explain-and at times criticize-the doctrines through which courts limit the enforcement of conditions, arguing that anti-forfeiture, good-faith, burden-allocation, and interpretive rules are best understood as responses to externality and parentalism concerns, and that courts go astray when they excuse a condition without first correctly identifying the purpose it was meant to serve.

AI.tldr: 本文填补了合同法研究中关于"防御性保护"（即合同条件允许承诺方在对方履行不足时拒绝履行）的分析空白。作者提出两个核心变量——防御性扣留可能给对方造成的"没收损失"以及违约的可验证性——来解释合同中进攻性保护（损害赔偿/特定履行）与防御性保护（拒绝履行权）的混合比例变化。文章归纳了五种反复出现的配置模式，并通过一个形式化的数值模型和多个案例谜题展示了该框架的解释力，最后对法院限制合同条件的各类规则进行了规范分析。
AI.research_question: 合同中对价保护的"进攻性保护"（损害赔偿诉讼）与"防御性保护"（拒绝履行权）的混合配置是如何决定的？哪些变量能够系统性解释不同合同中进攻/防御保护比例的差异？
AI.motivation: 法律经济学对违约损害赔偿的"高效设计"已有大量文献，但对损害赔偿的防御性对应物——即允许承诺方在对方履行不足时保留自身履行的合同条件——几乎没有任何分析。作者认为这一缺失构成合同法理论的重要空白，因为合同通过进攻与防御两种保护的混合来保护权利，且这种混合的变化既非随机也非路径依赖，值得系统性解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 文章构建了"没收-可验证性"（forfeiture-verifiability）双变量分析框架，用于解释合同保护配置的选择。该框架将防御性扣留可能对依赖方造成的没收损失与违约行为对法院的可验证性（或可执行性）作为两大决定性变量。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析结合形式化建模的研究方法。作者首先进行概念分类，归纳出五种反复出现的保护配置模式（从纯进攻性到纯防御性）；随后构建形式化数值模型，证明不同配置在没收-可验证性空间的不同区域中分别构成最优合同；最后对法院限制合同条件的司法规则进行规范分析。
AI.findings: 研究发现：1) 合同保护配置可由"没收"和"可验证性"两个变量主导解释；2) 归纳出五种从进攻性到防御性的反复配置模式；3) 数值模型证明不同配置在没收-可验证性空间中各自对应最优解；4) 该框架能解决多个传统损害赔偿分析无法解释的谜题，如卖方享有完美履行权而服务买方仅获实质履行保护、餐馆的预付/后付差异、保险人的纯条件依赖保护、重大不利变更条款采用标准而非规则形式等。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 填补了法律经济学中合同条件（防御性保护）的理论空白，将研究视野从损害赔偿扩展到完整的保护体系；2) 提出"没收-可验证性"双变量框架，为理解合同保护配置的系统变异提供了统一的解释理论；3) 对法院限制条件的各类规则（反没收、诚信、负担分配、解释规则）提供了新的理论解读，认为它们应被视为对外部性和家长主义关切的回应。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为合同起草者在选择进攻性保护（损害赔偿条款）与防御性保护（条件条款）的组合时提供理论指导；2) 对法院在裁决条件执行问题时提供规范指引——法院应在免除条件之前先正确识别条件所要服务的合同目的，避免误判；3) 有助于理解并改进特定行业（保险、服务合同、并购交易）中合同保护的制度设计。

title: The Chokepoint State
affiliations: Temple University Beasley School of Law

detail.title: The Chokepoint State
detail.abstract: This paper argues that the second Trump administration is crystallizing a new phase of U.S. state-building-the Chokepoint State. In the Chokepoint State, state capacity is directed toward creating and controlling key nodes in financial and data networks, with the aim of using that control to punish adversaries, reward allies, and set new rules of the road. This stage in American state-making builds on earlier legal and administrative innovations, but it operates according to its own logic. In the Chokepoint State, actors that control nodes in economic and information networks can use their power to impose new, quasi-legal norms that do not derive from any ordinary lawmaking process. The second Trump administration's grab for power has depended heavily on the techniques of the Chokepoint State, but those techniques precede Trump and have been used by administrations from both major U.S. parties. The paper further argues that resistance in the Chokepoint State requires a combination of strategies to tame the state's discretion from within, while using countervailing power to build zones of sanctuary that exist outside the state's unbridled control.

AI.tldr: 本文论证特朗普第二任期正在促成美国国家建设的新阶段——"咽喉点国家"（Chokepoint State）。在该阶段，国家能力被导向创建和控制金融与数据网络中的关键节点，利用这种控制来惩罚对手、奖励盟友并制定新的游戏规则。这种国家形态建立在早期法律和行政创新的基础上，但有其自身的运作逻辑。实施抵抗需要结合内部驯服国家自由裁量权与外部建立庇护区的双重策略。
AI.research_question: 特朗普第二任期如何体现和推动美国国家建设进入"咽喉点国家"的新阶段？这一阶段的特征、运作逻辑及其抵抗策略是什么？
AI.motivation: 特朗普第二任期对权力的攫取展现了不同于传统国家形态的治理模式，其依赖金融和数据网络关键节点的控制来实现政治目标。这一现象需要被理论化，以理解美国国家形态的最新演变，并探索相应的抵抗策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家建设理论（state-building theory）；咽喉点控制理论（chokepoint control），该理论关注经济与信息网络中关键节点的权力运用；准法律规范（quasi-legal norms）理论，即通过节点控制施加不来源于普通立法程序的规范。
AI.method: 理论分析/概念化论文，基于对特朗普第二任期行政实践的分析，结合美国国家建设的历史脉络进行推理和论证。
AI.findings: 1）特朗普第二任期正在催生"咽喉点国家"这一新的国家建设阶段；2）该阶段的核心是将国家能力用于创建和控制金融与数据网络的关键节点；3）节点控制者可以施加不来源于普通立法程序的准法律规范；4）尽管特朗普依赖这些技术，但该技术早于特朗普，且被美国两党各届政府使用；5）抵抗需要结合内部驯服自由裁量权与外部建立庇护区的双重策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"咽喉点国家"（Chokepoint State）这一新的理论概念，为理解美国国家形态的最新演变提供了分析框架；揭示了国家权力通过节点控制施加准法律规范的新机制，扩展了国家建设理论的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解和应对美国行政权力扩张提供了分析框架；提出了抵抗"咽喉点国家"的具体策略组合，即从内部驯服国家自由裁量权与在外部建立庇护区相结合，为公民社会和政治行动者提供了实践指引。

title: A Fixed-Point BSDE Framework to Solve Heterogeneous Agent Continuous Time Model
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK) - Department of Economics

detail.title: A Fixed-Point BSDE Framework to Solve Heterogeneous Agent Continuous Time Model
detail.abstract: This paper presents a simple block-wise Backward Stochastic Differential Equation (BSDE) framework for solving continuous-time stochastic general equilibrium models. The main idea is to separate inner BSDE function evaluation from outer equilibrium fixed-point iteration: policy rules, asset prices, and state drift dynamics are held fixed during BSDE training, and are updated only in outer block iterations. We apply this approach to three examples: a representative-agent stochastic growth model, a three-country macro-finance model with global risk-free rate determination, and a continuous-time Krusell-Smith heterogeneous-agent model with learned distributional manifolds. The results show that the block BSDE method is numerically stable and flexible for both representative and heterogeneous-agent continuous-time models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种简单的分块倒向随机微分方程（BSDE）框架，用于求解连续时间随机一般均衡模型。核心思想是将内部的BSDE函数评估与外部的均衡不动点迭代分离：在BSDE训练期间固定策略函数、资产价格和状态漂移动力学，仅在外层块迭代中更新。该方法在三个模型上得到验证：代表性代理随机增长模型、三国家宏观金融模型以及具有学习分布流形的连续时间Krusell-Smith异质性代理模型。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种数值稳定且灵活的框架，以求解连续时间随机一般均衡模型（包括代表性代理模型和异质性代理模型）？
AI.motivation: 连续时间随机一般均衡模型在数值求解上具有挑战性，尤其是涉及异质性代理和内生分布时，传统方法在稳定性和灵活性方面存在不足，需要一种新的求解框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 倒向随机微分方程（BSDE）理论、连续时间随机一般均衡模型、块坐标迭代（blockwise iteration）方法。
AI.method: 提出了分块BSDE框架：将BSDE函数评估与均衡不动点迭代分离，在训练中固定策略规则、资产价格和状态漂移，最后通过外层块迭代更新这些元素。该方法基于深度学习方法实现BSDE函数逼近。
AI.findings: 分块BSDE方法在代表性代理和异质性代理的连续时间模型中均表现出数值稳定性和灵活性，能够成功求解随机增长模型、三国家宏观金融模型和Krusell-Smith异质性代理模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 从方法论层面为连续时间随机一般均衡模型的求解提供了新的计算框架，将BSDE技术与不动点迭代有机结合，扩展了深度学习在宏观经济建模中的应用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种数值稳定且灵活的求解工具，适用于多种连续时间宏观金融模型，包括代表性代理和异质性代理场景，对宏观经济政策分析和预测具有实用价值。

title: Threat Framing: How Institutions Define, Interpret, and Communicate Danger

detail.title: Threat Framing: How Institutions Define, Interpret, and Communicate Danger

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests, personal relationships, or other conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research, analysis, or conclusions presented in this working paper. The views expressed are solely those of the author.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper is a conceptual theoretical work based on analysis of existing scholarly literature and publicly available organizational examples. It did not involve human participants, identifiable personal data, or animal subjects. Accordingly, institutional ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Leadership scholars have long recognized that leaders influence how organizations perceive uncertainty, prioritize challenges, and mobilize collective action. Existing research demonstrates that framing, sensemaking, risk perception, and organizational threat significantly shape decision-making, yet comparatively less attention has been devoted to the leadership process through which institutions define, interpret, prioritize, and communicate perceived danger. This paper examines the relationship between framing, organizational sensemaking, and leadership influence through a conceptual analysis of scholarship on framing theory, organizational threat, and institutional decision-making. The analysis identifies a theoretical gap concerning how leaders transform ambiguous conditions into organizational priorities that justify collective attention and action. To address this gap, the paper develops the concept of Threat Framing, defined as the leadership process through which institutions define, interpret, prioritize, and communicate perceived danger. The analysis argues that organizational responses are shaped not solely by objective conditions but by the narratives through which leaders determine what constitutes a threat, why it matters, and how it should be addressed. By identifying Threat Framing as a distinct leadership mechanism, this paper extends existing scholarship on framing and organizational leadership while contributing a foundational construct to Narrative Power Leadership Theory (NPLT). The findings provide a theoretical framework for understanding how leadership narratives influence organizational priorities, institutional legitimacy, and collective action in environments characterized by uncertainty and change.

AI.tldr: 本文通过概念分析识别了领导力研究中关于领导者如何将模糊条件转化为组织优先事项的理论缺口，提出了"威胁框架"（Threat Framing）这一概念，定义为机构定义、解释、优先排序和沟通感知危险的领导过程，并将其作为叙述权力领导理论（NPLT）的基础性构念加以发展。
AI.research_question: 领导者如何通过框架、组织意义建构和领导力影响的过程，将模糊条件转化为组织的优先事项，从而证明集体关注和行动的正当性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究已表明框架、意义建构、风险感知和组织威胁显著影响决策，但较少关注机构定义、解释、优先排序和沟通感知危险的领导过程，存在理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 框架理论（Framing Theory）、组织威胁理论、制度决策理论、叙述权力领导理论（NPLT）
AI.method: 概念分析（Conceptual Analysis），综合梳理框架理论、组织威胁和制度决策的相关学术文献。
AI.findings: 组织回应不仅由客观条件塑造，还受到领导者界定何为威胁、为何重要以及如何应对的叙述驱动；威胁框架是一个区别于现有理论机制的独特领导机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将威胁框架识别为一种独特的领导机制，扩展了框架与组织领导力的现有研究，并为叙述权力领导理论（NPLT）贡献了一个基础性构念。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解在不确定和变革环境中领导叙述如何影响组织优先事项、制度合法性及集体行动提供了理论框架。

title: Developing Specialized External Quality Assurance Frameworks for basic Education with Special Purposes in Thailand: A Participatory Process for 2025-2029

detail.title: Developing Specialized External Quality Assurance Frameworks for basic Education with Special Purposes in Thailand: A Participatory Process for 2025-2029

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Formal ethics approval was not required because the study reports on an institutional framework-development process and does not present identifiable personal data or involve experimental interventions.
declarations.funderStatement: This work was conducted as part of the author’s professional responsibilities at ONESQA and received no external research funding.

keywords: Basic Education With Special Purpose School

detail.abstract: This paper details the development of the revised external quality assurance (EQA) frameworks for Basic Education institutions with special purposes in Thailand, implemented by the Office for National Education Standards and Quality Assessment (ONESQA) for the 2025-2029 cycle. These new frameworks address the need for a specialized assessment approach that recognizes the unique characteristics of seven distinct types of educational institutions, including those for specific disabilities, special education centers, Phrapariyattidhamma schools (General education department), schools promoting special abilities in sports, science, arts, and Pre-Military school. This study outlines the systematic, multi-phase development process undertaken in 2025, which involved internal drafting, external expert reviews, and extensive stakeholder consultations, including public hearings and on-site visits. The resulting framework is structured around defined criteria, standards, and indicators, and employs a two-tier assessment outcome: "Meets Standards" or "Under Development". The findings suggest that this participatory process has produced tailored, development-focused frameworks that align with national education law and ONESQA's 2021 regulations, promoting institutional accountability while respecting diverse educational missions.

AI.tldr: 本文详细介绍了泰国国家教育标准与质量评估办公室（ONESQA）为2025-2029周期制定的特殊目的基础教育机构外部质量保障（EQA）修订框架。该框架针对七种不同类型的特殊教育机构（包括特定残障学校、特殊教育中心、Phrapariyattidhamma学校（普通教育部门）、体育/科学/艺术特长学校和预备军校），通过多阶段系统开发过程（内部起草、外部专家评审、公众听证和实地考察等利益相关方磋商）制定完成。框架围绕明确的标准和指标构建，采用"达标"或"发展中"两级评估结果，旨在在促进机构问责的同时尊重多样化的教育使命。
AI.research_question: 如何为泰国具有特殊目的的基础教育机构（七种不同类型）制定符合其独特特征的、专门化的外部质量保障（EQA）评估框架？
AI.motivation: 传统的外部质量评估框架无法充分反映特殊目的教育机构的独特特征和多样化教育使命，需要开发一个专门化的评估方法，以替代一刀切的评估模式，在2025-2029周期内满足这些机构的特殊需求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部质量保障（EQA）框架理论；国家教育法律框架及ONESQA 2021年法规；基于参与式协商的评估标准开发方法。
AI.method: 多阶段系统开发过程：（1）内部起草；（2）外部专家评审；（3）广泛的利益相关方磋商（包括公众听证会和实地考察）。研究于2025年开展，框架围绕定义的标准、准则和指标构建，采用"达标"或"发展中"两级评估结果。
AI.findings: 这一参与式过程成功产出了量身定制的、以发展为导向的评估框架，与国家教育法律和ONESQA 2021年法规保持一致，同时促进了机构问责并尊重多样化的教育使命。
AI.theory_contributions: 贡献在于提出了针对特殊目的教育机构的外部质量保障框架的系统化开发方法论，展示了如何将参与式协商过程融入教育评估标准的制定，为差异化评估框架设计提供了理论参考。
AI.practical_contributions: 为泰国2025-2029周期七类特殊目的基础教育的EQA评估提供了实际可操作的新框架，包括明确的评估标准和两级评估结果，有助于提升特殊教育机构的评估适切性和发展导向性。

title: The Evolution of Portfolio Theory Under Risk & Uncertainty: From Mean-Variance to AI-Augmented Investing
affiliations: and

detail.title: The Evolution of Portfolio Theory Under Risk & Uncertainty: From Mean-Variance to AI-Augmented Investing

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Economic Surveys, 0[10.1111/joes.70148]

detail.abstract: This article summarizes the evolution of portfolio theory from mean-variance optimization to AI-augmented investment systems. Rather than treating portfolio models as isolated techniques, it organizes the literature as a sequence of responses to different forms of uncertainty: variance, systematic risk, expected-return estimation error, downside risk, tail loss, parameter ambiguity, risk-budgeting instability, conditional volatility, regime dependence, high-dimensional prediction, and AI governance. Combining a systematic literature review, public-metadata bibliometric analysis, and thematic synthesis, the article covers leading academic journals and practitioner-oriented outlets, including JF, JFE, RFS, RF, JFQA, Management Science, FAJ, JPM, FMPM, and JAM. The survey highlights how classical portfolio theory, CAPM and multifactor allocation, Bayesian/Black-Litterman models, CVaR, robust optimization, risk parity, volatility management, regime-switching allocation, parametric portfolio policies, machine learning, and LLM-based agents form a cumulative intellectual architecture. The article is designed as a compact roadmap for doctoral students, academic researchers, and quantitative researchers in hedge funds and asset management who seek a rapid but rigorous understanding of how portfolio theory has evolved and how its core problems remain relevant in the AI era. "The evolution of portfolio theory is not a succession of disconnected models, but a cumulative architecture for transforming uncertainty into disciplined investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了投资组合理论从均值-方差优化到AI增强投资系统的演进过程，将其组织为对不同形式不确定性（方差、系统风险、预期收益估计误差、下行风险、尾部损失、参数模糊性、风险预算不稳定性、条件波动率、体制转换、高维预测和AI治理）的一系列响应，构建了一个从经典投资组合理论到LLM代理的累积性知识架构。
AI.research_question: 投资组合理论如何从经典均值-方差优化演进到AI增强的投资系统？这一演进过程如何系统地回应不同类型的市场不确定性？
AI.motivation: 既有文献往往将投资组合模型视为孤立技术，缺乏对其演进逻辑的系统性梳理。作者旨在将其组织为一个由不同不确定性形式驱动的累积性知识架构，为研究者提供快速而严谨的理论全景图。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以不确定性类型为组织维度的理论框架，涵盖均值-方差理论、CAPM和多因子配置、贝叶斯/Black-Litterman模型、CVaR、稳健优化、风险平价、波动率管理、体制转换配置、参数化组合策略、机器学习及LLM代理等理论模块。
AI.method: 综合采用系统性文献综述、公共元数据文献计量分析和主题综合三种方法，覆盖JF、JFE、RFS、RF、JFQA、Management Science等顶刊及FAJ、JPM等实践导向期刊。
AI.findings: 投资组合理论的演进并非互不相关的模型更替，而是围绕不确定性类型逐层累积的智力架构，最终形成从经典理论到AI治理的完整谱系；不同模型分别回应特定形式的不确定性，共同构成将不确定性转化为纪律化投资决策的体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个以不确定性为线索的统一分析框架，将看似分散的投资组合模型整合为累积性知识架构，揭示了各模型之间的内在逻辑关联与演进路径，并指出核心问题在AI时代仍然具有相关性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为博士生、学术研究者和对冲基金及资产管理领域的量化研究者提供了快速理解投资组合理论演进的紧凑路线图，有助于实践者理解不同模型的适用场景及其在AI时代的持续价值。

title: The USD 50,000 Myth China's Individual Foreign-exchange Facilitation amount and Overseas Life Insurance
affiliations: University of Groningen, Faculty of Law

detail.title: The USD 50,000 Myth China's Individual Foreign-exchange Facilitation amount and Overseas Life Insurance
detail.abstract: China's annual USD 50,000 figure is routinely described as a quota: either a personal allowance to export capital or an absolute ceiling on lawful overseas expenditure. Neither account is correct. The figure is a person-specific facilitation amount within the administration of individual foreignexchange settlement and purchase. It ordinarily reduces the documents required at the bank counter. It does not convert an unopened capital purpose into a permitted transaction, and it does not cap a genuine current-account payment that can be supported by transaction-value documents. The error becomes especially serious in overseas insurance, where purchase of foreign currency, outward remittance, immediate use and any later return payment may engage different rules. Product design also matters. Official materials distinguish pure protection from policies carrying surrender, borrowing, participation or investment-return features, but they do not use a perfectly uniform taxonomy across every channel and period. This essay therefore replaces the language of quota with a transaction-file method. It asks who acted, what operation occurred, what purpose and product were involved, which legal instrument opened or closed the route, and which institution may impose which consequence. The method also explains why bank or card processing is evidence of an operational decision, not an adjudication of legality, and why an irregularity in the originating Mainland movement does not automatically determine the private-law status of a later Hong Kong policy.

AI.tldr: 本文驳斥了中国每年5万美元被普遍称为"额度"或"限额"的两种错误理解，指出该数字实为个人外汇结算与购汇管理中的便利化金额，并非资本外流的个人许可，也不是境外合法支出的绝对上限。文章提出以"交易文件法"取代"额度"话语体系，通过系统化分析相关法律与操作环节来准确理解跨境资金流动的法律性质。
AI.research_question: 中国每年5万美元的外汇便利化金额在跨境资金流动（尤其是境外保险领域）中的法律性质是什么？应如何正确理解和适用这一制度？
AI.motivation: 现行对5万美元这一数字的两种主流解释（个人资本外流许可以及合法境外支出的绝对上限）均不正确，导致实践中在境外保险等领域的法律判断出现严重错误。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外汇管理法律制度、个人外汇结算与购汇管理制度、跨境保险法律规制、交易合规与私法效力区分理论
AI.method: 规范性分析法：通过制度文本分析、交易流程拆解、产品类型分类等方法，构建"交易文件法"分析框架。
AI.findings: 1）5万美元是便利化金额而非额度或限额；2）购买外汇、境外汇款、即时使用及后续回款可能适用不同规则；3）官方材料对保险产品纯保障型与含退保/借款/分红/投资回报特征的产品有区分但分类不统一；4）银行或卡片处理仅反映操作决策而非合法性裁决；5）境内来源环节的不合规并不自动决定香港保单的私法效力。
AI.theory_contributions: 以"交易文件法"取代"额度"的话语框架，建立多维度分析模型（主体、操作、目的、产品、法律工具、机构与后果），厘清行政监管与私法效力之间的界限。
AI.practical_contributions: 为个人在外汇管理中正确理解自身权利边界提供指引，为境外保险跨境交易提供更为精确的法律分析路径，避免因"额度"误读导致的法律风险误判。

title: From Sinai to Standup: The Biblical and Talmudic Roots of Jewish Humor
affiliations: City University of New York (CUNY) - Koppelman School of Business and City University of New York (CUNY) - Paul H. Chook Department of Information Systems & Statistics

detail.title: From Sinai to Standup: The Biblical and Talmudic Roots of Jewish Humor
detail.abstract: Jewish humor is commonly treated as a product of the diaspora, forged in the shtetls of Eastern Europe and perfected on the American stage. This paper argues that the account is incomplete. The major genres of Jewish humor, including kvetching, sarcasm, irony, selfdeprecation, exaggeration, and humor involving the Almighty, have clear antecedents in the Torah, the Talmud, and the Midrash. Each section of the paper pairs classic modern jokes with their ancient counterparts, demonstrating that the Israelites in the wilderness complained with the same rhetorical flair as the customers of a Catskills resort, that the prophets and sages wielded sarcasm with precision, that biblical narrative is saturated with verbal, dramatic, and situational irony, and that God Himself argues, concedes, and laughs. The implications extend beyond literary history. If humor is embedded in the sacred texts, then wit and laughter are not departures from Jewish tradition but expressions of it. The sages understood what modern psychology has confirmed: humor teaches, heals, deflates arrogance, builds resilience, and speaks truth to power. A tradition that laughs is a tradition that endures.

AI.tldr: 本文论证犹太幽默的主要体裁（抱怨、讽刺、反讽、自嘲、夸张、涉及上帝的笑话）并非仅源于流散时期，而是早已存在于《妥拉》《塔木德》和《米德拉什》等犹太圣典中。通过将现代经典笑话与古代对应文本配对，论文揭示幽默深植于犹太传统核心，而非其背离。
AI.research_question: 犹太幽默的主要体裁是否在犹太圣典（《妥拉》《塔木德》《米德拉什》）中已有清晰先例，而非仅仅是流散经历的产物？
AI.motivation: 主流观点将犹太幽默视为流散产物（源自东欧shtetl、成熟于美国舞台），这一叙事不完整，忽略了犹太圣典中早已存在的幽默传统。
AI.theoretical_framework: 犹太文学与宗教文本分析；幽默的心理学功能理论（幽默具有教导、疗愈、消解傲慢、建立韧性、向权力说真话的功能）。
AI.method: 文本配对分析法：将现代经典犹太笑话与《妥拉》《塔木德》《米德拉什》中的古代文本进行逐类对比，展示各幽默体裁（抱怨、讽刺、反讽、自嘲、夸张、涉及上帝的幽默）在古代圣典中的对应先例。
AI.findings: 1）以色列人在旷野中的抱怨与度假村顾客的抱怨具有相同的修辞风格；2）先知和贤者精确运用讽刺；3）圣经叙事充满言语反讽、戏剧反讽和情境反讽；4）上帝本身会争辩、让步和发笑。幽默不是对犹太传统的背离，而是其表达方式。
AI.theory_contributions: 修正并补充犹太幽默起源的主流叙事，将犹太幽默的谱系从流散时期向前延伸至圣典时代；论证幽默与智慧传统的内在统一性，呼应现代心理学对幽默功能的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解犹太文化认同提供新视角：幽默是犹太传统韧性与延续性的重要机制；为教育、心理疗愈和当代文化实践中运用幽默提供历史与文本基础。

title: Gender Management Gap over the Life Cycle: A Stock-Flow Decomposition
affiliations: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou)

detail.title: Gender Management Gap over the Life Cycle: A Stock-Flow Decomposition
detail.abstract: Early in their careers, women and men are similarly represented in management. By late career, a substantial gender gap in management has emerged. Using NLSY79 panel data, I conduct a dynamic stock-flow accounting of the gender management gap. The decomposition attributes three quarters of the life-cycle management gap to higher exit rates among women. Entry becomes an important source of divergence only later in the career. Women's managerial spells are less durable, exits are more likely to persist, and reentry is lower. These results point to managerial durability as a central source of gender disparity in management.

AI.tldr: 本文利用NLSY79面板数据进行动态存量-流量核算，发现职业生涯早期男女在管理岗位中的代表性相当，但到职业生涯晚期出现了显著的性别管理差距。分解结果显示，约四分之三的生命周期管理差距源于女性更高的离职率（流出），而非进入率。女性的管理任期更不稳定、离职后更难回归、再进入率更低，表明管理任期的持续性（managerial durability）是性别管理差距的核心来源。
AI.research_question: 在职业生涯生命周期中，男女在管理岗位代表性差距是如何形成的？差距主要源于进入率、退出率还是流动动态的差异？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注男女在管理岗位进入端的差异，但职业晚期的管理性别差距可能更多源于流出现象。理解差距在生命周期中如何累积，有助于识别性别不平等的关键机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 动态存量-流量核算（dynamic stock-flow accounting）框架，将管理岗位性别差距分解为进入率、退出率、再进入率等流量组成部分。
AI.method: 使用美国NLSY79（1979年全国青年纵向调查）面板数据，通过动态存量-流量分解方法，追踪个体从早期到晚期职业生涯在管理岗位的进入、退出与再进入动态。
AI.findings: (1) 职业生涯早期男女在管理岗位中的代表性相当，晚期出现显著差距；(2) 约四分之三的差距源于女性更高的退出率；(3) 进入率仅在职业后期才成为重要的分化来源；(4) 女性的管理任期较短、更容易持续退出、再进入率较低。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"管理任期持续性"（managerial durability）作为理解性别管理差距的核心概念，将研究重心从进入端转向流动与持续性动态，丰富了职业性别隔离理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织政策制定者提供了新的干预方向：减少女性管理者的流失、提高其管理任期的持续性，可能比单纯增加招聘女性进入管理岗位更有效地缩小职业晚期的性别管理差距。

title: Competitive effects of entry and price dispersion in local markets

detail.title: Competitive effects of entry and price dispersion in local markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None. The author has no financial or personal relationships with any organization or person that could inappropriately influence this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: This paper estimates the disciplining effect on prices induced by the entry of a new service station into a local market. Using administrative, official and publicly available databases, retail margins are approximated and entries are identified. By means of an event study, the response of prices and margins to the entry of a new competitor in the local market is captured. A causal effect close to 7% is found on the retail margin of 93-octane gasoline and 6% on diesel, and a markedly smaller effect on 97-octane gasoline. The effect attenuates with distance and ceases to be distinguishable from zero between three and four kilometers. The minimum price in the market falls by 0.85% for 93-octane gasoline and by 1.00% for diesel, while the maximum does not move in a way distinguishable from zero, the shift in the cumulative distribution is concentrated in the lower half. The gain from entry is therefore disproportionately captured by the consumer who compares prices.

AI.tldr: 本文利用行政、官方和公开数据库估计了新加油站进入本地市场对价格产生的约束效应。通过事件研究法，发现新竞争者进入使93号汽油零售利润率下降约7%，柴油下降6%，97号汽油影响显著更小。该效应随距离衰减，在3-4公里之间不再显著。市场最低价格下降（93号汽油0.85%，柴油1.00%），但最高价格无明显变化，价格分布下移集中在下半部分，说明比较价格的消费者获得了主要收益。
AI.research_question: 新加油站进入本地市场对加油站零售价格和利润率产生多大的纪律约束效应？这种效应在距离、价格分布上的异质性表现如何？
AI.motivation: 研究新竞争者进入对本地市场竞争和价格的影响，为理解市场进入的竞争效应提供因果证据，特别是针对零售加油站这一典型本地市场。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本地市场竞争理论、市场进入的竞争效应理论、价格分布与消费者搜索理论
AI.method: 利用行政、官方和公开数据库构建零售利润率指标并识别新加油站进入事件，采用事件研究法（event study）捕获价格和利润率对新竞争者进入的响应，分析距离衰减效应和价格分布变化。
AI.findings: 1）新进入使93号汽油零售利润率下降约7%，柴油下降6%，97号汽油影响显著更小；2）效应随距离衰减，在3-4公里间不再显著；3）市场最低价格下降0.85%（93号汽油）和1.00%（柴油），最高价格无显著变化；4）累计分布下移集中在下半部分，比较价格的消费者获得主要收益。
AI.theory_contributions: 为市场进入的竞争纪律效应提供了因果识别证据，揭示了本地市场地理边界（3-4公里）和价格分布的异质性反应，丰富了关于竞争如何影响价格分布而非仅平均价格的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加油站市场的竞争政策制定提供参考，帮助理解市场进入的距离效应和价格调整机制，对评估市场进入审批和竞争监管政策具有实践价值。

title: From Fiduciary Judgment to Decision Architecture: Structuring AI for Trustworthy Investment Management
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: From Fiduciary Judgment to Decision Architecture: Structuring AI for Trustworthy Investment Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence offers material advantages for investment management, where decisions require large-scale information processing, repeated estimation under uncertainty and consistent application of analytical criteria. Behavioral decision research supplies a further rationale for structured computational support: professional judgment is exposed to cognitive bias and to noise, understood as unwanted variability in judgments that should be substantially similar. Greater predictive capability, however, does not by itself produce better fiduciary decisions. Portfolio management remains a constrained process in which expected return must be evaluated against risk tolerance, liquidity, time horizon, legal restrictions, investor-specific circumstances and portfolio interactions.

This paper asks how fiduciary judgment can be translated into executable AI decision architecture without compromising investor protection. It brings together behavioral decision theory, portfolio-management principles embodied in the Investment Policy Statement (IPS), the European Union Artificial Intelligence Act, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and the conflict problem identified by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission in its 2023 Predictive Data Analytics proposal.

The paper develops a fiduciary-aligned architecture in which AI enters the established investment-management sequence without acquiring authority to redefine that sequence. The IPS specifies investor objectives and constraints; portfolio theory supplies the analytical logic of risk, diversification, allocation and construction; and decision architecture converts those requirements into executable controls over data use, permissible correlations, suitability, conflicts of interest, materiality, execution, monitoring, rebalancing and escalation. Independent runtime validation is reserved for decisions capable of producing material financial, regulatory or investor-protection consequences.

The framework separates predictive capability from institutional authority. Its contribution is a method for translating fiduciary and investment-management practice into machine-executable decision boundaries, allowing institutions to use AI without transferring fiduciary purpose or unconstrained execution authority to the model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种"信义对齐（fiduciary-aligned）"的AI决策架构，将人工智能嵌入既有投资管理流程，但不赋予其重新定义该流程或获得不受约束执行权的权威。通过将信义义务、投资政策声明（IPS）、投资组合理论及监管框架转化为机器可执行的决策边界，实现AI的预测能力与机构权威的分离。
AI.research_question: 信义判断如何被转化为可执行的AI决策架构，同时不损害投资者保护？
AI.motivation: AI为投资管理提供了预测能力优势，但更强的预测能力本身并不自动产生更好的信义决策。专业判断易受认知偏差和噪声影响，而投资组合管理是一个受约束的过程（需评估风险容忍度、流动性、时间范围、法律限制等），因此需要结构化计算支持与投资者保护的平衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为决策理论（认知偏差与噪声）；投资组合管理原则（投资政策声明IPS）；欧盟人工智能法案（EU AI Act）；NIST AI风险管理框架；美国证监会2023年预测数据分析提案中的冲突问题。
AI.method: 概念性/规范性架构设计方法。将行为决策理论、投资组合管理原则及多个监管框架整合，开发出一套信义对齐的AI决策架构，将投资管理流程分解为数据使用、相关性许可、适合性、利益冲突、重要性、执行、监控、再平衡和升级等可执行控制点。
AI.findings: 提出将预测能力与制度权威分离的框架。AI进入既定的投资管理流程但不获得重新定义该流程的权力；独立运行时验证仅保留给可能产生重大财务、监管或投资者保护后果的决策。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一种将信义义务和投资管理实践转化为机器可执行决策边界的方法论，从而在不将信义目的或不受约束的执行权威转移给模型的前提下使用AI。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融机构提供了可操作的AI部署架构框架——将IPS、投资组合理论和监管要求转化为AI系统内的具体控制机制，同时确保投资者保护不被削弱。

title: Liquidity Supply Risk and Stock Prices
affiliations: Concordia University, Quebec - Department of Finance

detail.title: Liquidity Supply Risk and Stock Prices
