detail.abstract: This paper develops an equilibrium model in which liquidity-supply risk is represented by stochastic variation in the effective weight of active liquidity providers. Transaction costs make liquidity traders adjust their positions slowly, allowing liquidity providers to remain marginal even when their aggregate weight is small. When the weight of active liquidity providers declines, the remaining providers must absorb more risk. As a result, the stock price falls, while the conditional risk premium, return volatility, and conditional Sharpe ratio rise. The model shows that liquiditysupply risk generates countercyclical expected returns and volatility, a volatilityrisk component, and a short-run momentum effect arising from delayed portfolio adjustment. Quantitatively, the mechanism has a substantial effect on stock prices and risk premia, but it does not fully account for the empirical magnitude of volatilityof-volatility. The results suggest that time-varying liquidity provision is a priced aggregate state variable reflecting the changing risk-bearing capacity of marginal liquidity providers.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个均衡模型，将流动性供给风险表示为活跃流动性提供者有效权重的随机变化。交易成本使流动性交易者缓慢调整头寸，即使流动性提供者的总权重很小，他们仍能保持边际地位。当活跃流动性提供者的权重下降时，剩余提供者必须吸收更多风险，导致股价下跌，同时条件风险溢价、收益波动率和条件夏普比率上升。
AI.research_question: 流动性供给风险如何影响资产价格、风险溢价和收益波动率？
AI.motivation: 现有文献主要关注流动性需求侧冲击，而对流动性供给侧（即流动性提供者风险承担能力随时间变化）对资产定价的影响研究不足。本文旨在揭示时间变化的流动性供给能力是一种被定价的宏观状态变量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 均衡资产定价模型，包含流动性提供者和流动性交易者两类参与者，重点刻画流动性供给风险（liquidity-supply risk）及交易成本导致的缓慢调整机制。
AI.method: 构建理论均衡模型进行解析推导，并在定量层面评估模型对股票价格和风险溢价的数值影响。
AI.findings: 流动性供给风险产生逆周期的预期收益和波动率、波动率风险成分，以及由延迟投资组合调整引起的短期动量效应。定量上该机制对股价和风险溢价有显著影响，但无法完全解释实证中波动率之波动率的量级。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将流动性供给风险形式化为活跃流动性提供者权重的随机变化，并证明时间变化的流动性供给是一个被定价的聚合状态变量，反映边际流动性提供者风险承担能力的变化。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解逆周期风险溢价、波动聚集和短期动量等市场异象提供了新的理论解释，对投资者风险管理与监管层理解市场流动性动态具有参考价值。

title: International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) Adoption in Africa: Divergence Between Legal Reform and Reporting Quality
affiliations: Ministry of Finance and Economic Planning, Controller and Accountant General's Department, Controller and Accountant General's Department, Ghana Revenue Authority, Private enterprise and Transilvania University of Brasov

detail.title: International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) Adoption in Africa: Divergence Between Legal Reform and Reporting Quality

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors have no relevant financial or non-financial interests to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable
declarations.funderStatement: This study received no external funding.

detail.abstract: African governments have pursued International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) reform for two decades, but evidence on outcomes remains fragmented. This study asks whether legal adoption of accrual-based IPSAS predicts actual improvement in financial reporting quality. We built two datasets. The first tracks documented IPSAS adoption milestones for 20 African countries between 1990 and 2026, coded from primary government, IFAC, and academic sources. The second compiles Public Expenditure and Financial Accountability (PEFA) indicator PI-29 scores (Annual Financial Reports) across 24 assessment rounds in 12 countries, drawn directly from PEFA report tables. We apply crisp-set qualitative comparative analysis (csQCA) to the milestone data and a discrete-time survival framework to model time to accrual-stage reporting. Results show no consistent relationship between legal mandate and reporting performance. Ghana's PI-29 score fell from C+ to D+ after its 2016 accrual mandate. Liberia and Sierra Leone show PEFA scores moving independently of documented IPSAS status. Mauritius scored A on every dimension across three assessments (2007 to 2015) while remaining on cash-basis IPSAS throughout. The QCA truth table finds no configuration of legal mandate, donor support, and regional bloc membership reaching consistency above 0.60. We conclude that legal adoption of IPSAS is a poor proxy for reporting quality in this region, and that North African Arab Maghreb Union countries follow a distinct civil-law reform track that does not map onto the IPSAS framework at all. We recommend that researchers and donors track PEFA-type performance indicators alongside legal milestones, not in place of them.

AI.tldr: 本研究检验非洲20个国家1990-2026年间IPSAS法律采纳与实际财务报告质量之间的关系，发现法律采纳并不能预测报告质量的改善，建议研究人员和捐助者同时跟踪PEFA类绩效指标与法律里程碑。
AI.research_question: 非洲国家基于权责发生制的IPSAS法律采纳是否真的能预测财务报告质量的实际改善？
AI.motivation: 非洲各国政府推行IPSAS改革已有二十年，但关于改革成效的证据仍然零散，现有文献缺乏对法律采纳与实际报告质量之间关系的系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度采纳与制度执行的理论视角，区分法律层面的采纳与实际绩效层面的执行；结合定性比较分析（QCA）和事件史分析框架。
AI.method: 构建两个数据集：(1) 20个非洲国家1990-2026年IPSAS采纳里程碑数据（来自政府、IFAC和学术来源）；(2) 12个国家24轮评估的PEFA PI-29指标评分。采用清晰集定性比较分析（csQCA）和离散时间生存分析模型。
AI.findings: 法律授权与报告绩效之间没有一致性关系：加纳2016年采纳权责发生制后PI-29评分从C+降至D+；利比里亚和塞拉利昂的PEFA评分与IPSAS地位变化无关；毛里求斯在保持现金制IPSAS下三次评估均获A级。QCA真值表显示没有任何法律授权、捐助支持和区域集团成员配置的组合一致性超过0.60。北非阿拉伯马格里布联盟国家遵循独特的民法改革路径，与IPSAS框架完全不匹配。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"法律采纳即改革成功"的隐含假设，揭示了制度采纳与实际执行之间的脱节；表明单一路径的全球标准框架（IPSAS）在多元制度环境中可能缺乏适用性，尤其是对民法法系国家。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议研究人员和捐助者应同时追踪PEFA类绩效指标与法律里程碑，而非仅以法律采纳作为改革成效的替代指标；对国际组织和捐助机构的评估框架具有直接的政策含义。

title: From Performance to Habit: How Preference Falsification Becomes Self-Reinforcing
affiliations: Duke University - Department of Economics and

detail.title: From Performance to Habit: How Preference Falsification Becomes Self-Reinforcing
detail.abstract: Sensitive public debates often lead individuals to falsify their preferences to maintain social approval. Because repeatedly calculating the net benefits of preference falsification is inefficient, they develop entrenched issue-specific habits. The paper argues that habitual preference falsifiers entrap themselves through their public personas while becoming desensitized to internal dishonesty. It formalizes this process, operationalizes its key parameters with behavioral and demographic proxies, and tests four predictions using panel data on U.S. attitudes toward transgender bathroom policies, with gay marriage and Social Security spending as comparator issues. All four predictions are supported. Qualifying contact theory, increases in the reputational cost of supporting pro-outgroup policies reduce support disproportionately among ingroup members with prior contact. Educated elites become more habituated to initial falsification than their less-educated peers. Individuals who discuss politics frequently and those highly attentive to politics habituate more strongly, making their public stances less responsive to new information. Competing explanations fail.

AI.tldr: 本文研究敏感公共议题中个体偏好伪造（preference falsification）的习惯化机制。论文认为，由于反复计算偏好伪造的净收益效率低下，个体逐渐形成固化的议题特定习惯。习惯性偏好伪造者通过公开身份自我束缚，同时对内在不诚实逐渐脱敏。论文形式化了这一过程，用行为与人口统计代理变量操作化关键参数，并利用美国跨性别厕所政策态度的面板数据（以同性婚姻与社会保障支出作为对照议题）检验了四个预测，均获支持。
AI.research_question: 在敏感公共辩论中，个体如何通过习惯化机制形成偏好伪造，以及哪些因素（既有接触、教育水平、政治讨论频率与政治关注度）调节这一习惯化过程及其对公共立场的影响？
AI.motivation: 敏感公共辩论常导致个体为维持社会认可而伪造偏好，但反复计算偏好伪造的净收益是低效的，因此个体发展出固化的议题特定习惯，这一习惯化过程尚未得到系统形式化与实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 偏好伪造理论（preference falsification theory）、习惯形成理论（habit formation theory）、接触理论（contact theory）
AI.method: 形式化建模偏好伪造的习惯化过程，使用行为与人口统计代理变量操作化关键参数；利用美国跨性别厕所政策态度的面板数据，以同性婚姻和社会保障支出为对照议题，检验四个预测。
AI.findings: 四个预测全部获得支持：(1) 支持外群体政策的声誉成本上升，会对有先前接触的群体内成员的支持度产生更大的不成比例削减（限定接触理论）；(2) 受过教育的精英比受教育程度较低的同伴更习惯于初始偏好伪造；(3) 频繁讨论政治的人以及高度关注政治的人习惯化程度更强；(4) 这些群体的公共立场对新信息的响应性降低。竞争性解释未能成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 形式化了偏好伪造的习惯化过程，揭示了声誉成本与先前接触对支持外群体政策态度的交互效应，对接触理论进行了重要限定；扩展了偏好伪造理论，引入习惯机制解释公共立场为何对新信息缺乏响应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解敏感议题（如跨性别政策）中公众真实偏好与公开立场之间的落差提供了实证依据；对政策沟通、公共舆论调查数据的解读以及社会政策制定具有实践启示——公开立场可能因习惯化而系统性地偏离真实偏好。

title: Occupational Complexity, Capital-Skill Complementarity, and the Evolution of U.S. Wage Inequality: A Quantitative Analysis
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, University of British Columbia (UBC) and University of Toronto

detail.title: Occupational Complexity, Capital-Skill Complementarity, and the Evolution of U.S. Wage Inequality: A Quantitative Analysis

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: International Finance Discussion Papers (Topic)

detail.abstract: We document a strong, positive relationship between occupational problem complexity, measured from US data on problem-solving requirements, and occupational wage growth since 1980. In contrast, employment shifts toward more complex occupations have been modest, suggesting a race between the demand for and supply of complex skills. We rationalize these findings by formulating and structurally estimating a quantitative general equilibrium model on the granular occupational level. In our model, workers have heterogeneous comparative advantages in solving complex problems and physical capital admits capital-skill complementarity in occupation space. The equilibrium features Positive Assortative Matching of worker skills to occupational problem complexity, and the model quantitatively explains the evolution of the occupational wage- and employment structure over the last four decades. The model estimates uncover two distinct periods of technological change. Until around 2000, rising complexity premia were driven by capital-skill complementarity and declining equipment capital prices. Post-2000 patterns reflect supply-side technological change whereby occupations became more efficient in utilizing worker skills for complex problem-solving. Our framework helps unify distinct approaches to studying task automation and task augmentation on the one hand and skill-biased technological change on the other.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国数据记录了职业问题复杂性与职业工资增长之间的强正相关关系，并构建了一个结构性估计的定量一般均衡模型来解释过去四十年来职业工资和就业结构的演变。模型揭示了两段不同的技术变革时期：2000年前由资本-技能互补性和设备资本价格下降驱动，2000年后由供给侧技术变革驱动，使职业在利用工人技能解决复杂问题方面更有效率。
AI.research_question: 职业问题复杂性如何影响职业工资增长和就业结构演变？技术进步如何通过不同机制驱动这一过程？
AI.motivation: 观察到职业问题复杂性与职业工资增长之间存在强正相关，但就业向更复杂职业的转移却有限，表明复杂技能的供需之间存在"竞赛"。需要一种统一的定量框架来解释这一现象并整合任务自动化和技能偏向型技术变革两种研究路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 定量一般均衡模型，建立在职业粒度层面；包含工人异质性比较优势（在解决复杂问题方面）和资本-技能互补性（在职业空间中）；均衡特征为工人技能与职业问题复杂性之间的正向匹配（Positive Assortative Matching）。
AI.method: 使用美国问题解决需求数据度量职业问题复杂性，并基于1980年以来的微观数据；构建并结构性估计定量一般均衡模型，在职业粒度层面进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）职业问题复杂性与职业工资增长呈强正相关；（2）就业向更复杂职业的转移幅度有限；（3）模型能定量解释四十年来职业工资与就业结构的演变；（4）2000年前复杂性溢价由资本-技能互补性和设备资本价格下降驱动；（5）2000年后由供给侧技术变革驱动，职业在利用工人技能解决复杂问题方面更有效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个统一框架，整合了任务自动化/任务增强与技能偏向型技术变革两种研究路径；构建了包含异质性比较优势和资本-技能互补性的职业层面一般均衡模型，并在均衡中内生导出正向匹配结构。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解过去四十年美国职业工资和就业结构演变提供了定量解释；区分了两种不同的技术变革时期及其驱动机制，为政策制定者理解技能需求变化和技术变革方向提供参考。

title: Public Sector Intensity and Regional Welfare Buffering in Türkiye: Evidence from NUTS-2 Regions, 2000-2024

detail.title: Public Sector Intensity and Regional Welfare Buffering in Türkiye: Evidence from NUTS-2 Regions, 2000-2024
detail.abstract: This article examines whether public sector intensity operates as a source of developmental capacity or as a welfare buffer in less developed regions. Using regional and sectoral GDP data for 26 NUTS-2 regions in Türkiye over the period 2000-2024, the study focuses on public administration, education, human health, and social work activities in relation to regional welfare and fiscal capacity. The empirical strategy combines five-year period averages, regional typology, correlation analysis, and fixed-effects panel estimates. The findings show that higher public sector shares and higher public sector-to-tax ratios are systematically associated with lower regional welfare and weaker regional economic position. Less developed eastern and southeastern regions exhibit high public sector intensity and high public sector-to-tax ratios, yet remain substantially below the national average in GDP per capita. In contrast, industrial and private-sector-driven regions display lower public sector shares and higher income levels. Ankara represents a distinct public-metropolitan case in which public sector concentration is embedded within a high-income and knowledgeintensive metropolitan economy. The article argues that public sector intensity provides important welfare-stabilizing functions, but it does not generate long-term regional convergence unless it is connected to private investment, productive capacity, sectoral diversification, and structural transformation.

AI.tldr: 本文利用土耳其26个NUTS-2地区2000-2024年的区域和部门GDP数据，考察公共部门强度在欠发达地区是作为发展能力来源还是福利缓冲器。研究发现，较高的公共部门占比和公共部门-税收比率与较低的区域福利和较弱的区域经济地位系统性地相关。公共部门强度提供了重要的福利稳定功能，但除非与私人投资、生产能力、部门多元化和结构转型相连接，否则不会产生长期区域趋同。
AI.research_question: 在欠发达地区，公共部门强度究竟是作为发展能力的来源，还是仅仅作为福利缓冲器发挥作用？
AI.motivation: 以往关于公共部门在区域发展中的角色存在争议，需要实证检验公共部门强度与区域福利和财政能力之间的关系，尤其是在欠发达地区的具体表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 区域发展理论、公共部门经济理论、福利国家理论（涉及发展能力与福利缓冲两种对立视角）
AI.method: 使用土耳其26个NUTS-2地区2000-2024年的区域和部门GDP数据，涉及公共管理、教育、卫生健康和社会工作活动；采用五年期平均值、区域类型学、相关分析和固定效应面板估计。
AI.findings: （1）较高的公共部门占比和公共部门-税收比率与较低的区域福利和较弱的区域经济地位系统性相关；（2）欠发达的东部和东南部地区表现出高公共部门强度和高的公共部门-税收比率，但人均GDP仍远低于全国平均水平；（3）工业和私营部门驱动的地区公共部门份额较低而收入水平较高；（4）安卡拉代表了一种独特的公共-都市案例，公共部门集中嵌入高收入和知识密集型都市经济中。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了公共部门作为发展能力来源与福利缓冲器的理论视角，指出公共部门强度在缺乏与私人投资和生产能力联系时无法实现长期区域趋同。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欠发达地区政策制定提供启示：公共部门投入应结合私人投资、生产能力建设、部门多元化和结构转型，而非仅作为福利稳定工具。

reference: B.E. Eckbo (ed.), Handbook of the Economics of Corporate Finance, Vol. 2: Corporate Takeovers and the Market for Corporate Control, Elsevier, forthcoming 2026.
title: Hedge Fund Activism: Influence, Control, and Corporate Governance
affiliations: Duke University - Fuqua School of Business, Emory University Goizueta Business School and Emory University, Goizueta Business School, Students

detail.title: Hedge Fund Activism: Influence, Control, and Corporate Governance

publicationDetails.detailsText: B.E. Eckbo (ed.), Handbook of the Economics of Corporate Finance, Vol. 2: Corporate Takeovers and the Market for Corporate Control, Elsevier, forthcoming 2026.

detail.abstract: Hedge fund activism, traditionally a mechanism for mitigating managerial agency problems in diffusely owned public corporations, is evolving into a broader conduit for allocating corporate control. Updated evidence from 5,714 activist campaigns from 1994 through 2024 shows that, while the core empirical regularities of activism remain largely intact, ownership transitions, asset reallocation, and leadership changes have emerged as important post-intervention outcomes. Several ongoing developments are changing how activists “influence control” without acquiring direct control. Activism increasingly interacts with private equity in public-to-private ownership transitions; more negotiated settlements and private engagement provide alternatives to public confrontation; and activists play a growing role in facilitating the reallocation of assets and managerial talent.  Meanwhile, recent-year regulatory changes, notably shorter disclosure windows and pass-through voting, are altering the premises supporting activism by changing how activists accumulate stakes and assemble shareholder support. Taken together, these developments extend activism from disciplining managers to influencing who owns corporate assets, where those assets reside, and who exercises managerial authority.

AI.tldr: 本文基于1994至2024年间5,714起维权活动的更新证据，指出对冲基金维权正从传统的缓解管理层代理问题的机制，演变为分配公司控制权的更广泛渠道。尽管传统的实证规律基本不变，但所有权转移、资产重新配置和领导层变更加凸显；同时，维权活动越来越多地与私募股权互动、采用协商和解与私下接触、以及促进资产和管理人才的重组。近年的监管变化（如更短的披露窗口和穿透投票）正在改变维权活动的运作前提。
AI.research_question: 对冲基金维权活动如何从传统的约束管理层代理问题的机制，演变为影响公司控制权分配（包括所有权、资产和管理权归属）的更广泛渠道？
AI.motivation: 传统文献将维权活动视为缓解分散持股上市公司管理层代理问题的机制，但近年维权活动呈现出新的形式和结果（如所有权转移、资产重新配置、领导层更替），需要系统的更新证据来理解其演变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论（agency theory）、公司控制权理论（corporate control theory）
AI.method: 基于1994至2024年5,714起维权活动的大样本实证分析，结合近年制度环境变化（监管规则）的定性分析。
AI.findings: （1）维权活动的核心实证规律基本保持不变；（2）所有权转移、资产重新配置和领导层变化成为重要的干预后结果；（3）维权与私募股权在公转私的所有权转移中互动增多；（4）更多协商和解和私下接触替代公开对抗；（5）维权在促进资产和管理人才重新配置中发挥更大作用；（6）近年监管变化（更短披露窗口、穿透投票）正在改变维权活动的运作前提。
AI.theory_contributions: 将维权活动的理论视角从单纯约束管理层（代理问题治理）扩展到公司控制权分配领域，提出维权活动正在影响"谁拥有公司资产、资产位于何处、谁行使管理权"三个维度的控制权问题，丰富了公司控制权理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、公司和监管机构理解维权活动的新形式和新影响提供系统证据；提示监管变化（披露窗口、穿透投票）对维权活动生态的实际影响。

title: Energy Security in Transition: Multi-Scale Risks, Metrics, and Circular Bio-Resources from Europe to Bavarian Region of Germany
affiliations: Fraunhofer UMSICHT - Fraunhofer Institute for Environmental, Safety and Energy Technology

detail.title: Energy Security in Transition: Multi-Scale Risks, Metrics, and Circular Bio-Resources from Europe to Bavarian Region of Germany
detail.abstract: This article reviews how energy security is being reconceptualised and practiced in the context of Europe’s low-carbon transition, with a particular focus on Germany and the state of Bavaria, and on the role of circular bio-resources converted by thermo-chemical-conversion technologies. A targeted review of recent peer-reviewed work was undertaken using major bibliographic databases, complemented by a critical appraisal of widely used indicator frameworks and composite indices, and by a spatially explicit assessment of bio-waste and sewage-sludge conversion potential in Bavaria using Thermo-Catalytic Reforming (TCR®) as an illustrative technology. The synthesis shows that the dominant understanding of energy security has shifted from narrow fuel-supply concerns to broader socio-technical concepts that link security to sustainability, risk, equity and digitalisation. However,prevailing indices remain strongly supply- andprice-oriented, rely on overlapping indicators and weakly justified weights, and only partially capture environmental, social and technological dimensions. At the European level, diversification of energy mixes, improvements in energy and carbon intensity, and expansion of renewables have improved several aspects of security, yet high import dependence and new vulnerabilities associated with gas trade, critical materials and concen trated low-carbon technology supply chains persist. Germany’s Energiewende has raised the share of renewables and reduced coal use, but the simultaneous nuclear phase-out and former reliance on Russian pipeline gas have created a complex risk profile in which system flexibility, storage, hydrogen and bioenergy become central levers. The Bavarian case underlines that energy security is strongly region-specific: high industrial demand, heterogeneous renewable resources, land-use and biodiversity constraints, water stress and local acceptance shape feasible pathways. Across all scales, the growing use of digital platforms and artificial intelligence offers powerful capabilities for fore casting, clustering and operational security, but also introduces cyber and governance risks. Overall, the review argues for explicitly risk-oriented, multi-scale energy-security metrics and scenarios that embed climate-neutrality, justice and water-energy-food nexus constraints; for systematic integration of circular bio-resource and thermo-chemical pathways into regional and national planning; and for treating digitalisation and ’Artificial Intelligence’ (AI) as core dimensions of energy security rather than neutral enablers.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了欧洲低碳转型背景下能源安全概念的重新定义与实践，聚焦德国和巴伐利亚州，探讨循环生物资源经热化学转化技术在能源安全中的作用。研究表明能源安全理解已从狭义燃料供应转向更广泛的社会技术概念，但现有指标体系仍以供应和价格为导向。文章建议采用风险导向、多尺度的能源安全度量，系统整合循环生物资源路径，并将数字化和AI视为能源安全的核心维度。
AI.research_question: 在欧洲低碳转型背景下，能源安全如何被重新概念化和实践？循环生物资源经热化学转化技术在其中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 传统能源安全概念以燃料供应安全为核心，但低碳转型带来了新的脆弱性和多维挑战，需要重新审视能源安全的定义、度量与实践方式，特别是在德国和巴伐利亚的具体情境下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能源安全的社会技术理论框架，将安全与可持续性、风险、公平性和数字化相联系的广义能源安全概念；同时批判性审视了现有指标框架和综合指数体系。
AI.method: 目标性文献综述（基于主要书目数据库）、对广泛使用的指标框架和综合指数的批判性评估，以及对巴伐利亚州生物废物和污水污泥转化潜力的空间显式评估（以热催化重整TCR®技术为例）。
AI.findings: 1) 能源安全理解已从窄化燃料供应转向更广泛的社会技术概念，但现有指数仍偏重供应和价格，指标重叠、权重依据薄弱；2) 欧洲层面多元化、能效提升和可再生能源扩展改善多项安全指标，但进口依赖、天然气贸易、关键材料和集中化低碳供应链仍构成新脆弱性；3) 德国能源转型在提高可再生能源比例和减少煤炭的同时，核淘汰和俄罗斯管道气依赖造成复杂风险状况；4) 巴伐利亚案例显示能源安全强烈区域特异性；5) 数字化和AI带来能力也引入网络和治理风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出将数字化和AI视为能源安全的核心维度而非中立使能因素；主张开发风险导向、多尺度的能源安全度量方法；强调将水-能源-粮食纽带约束嵌入能源安全框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议将循环生物资源和热化学转化路径系统整合到区域和国家规划中；为巴伐利亚和德国提供具体的能源安全规划启示；为政策制定者提供改进能源安全指标体系的建议。

reference: Journal of Management and Financial Sciences, Vol. XIX, Issue 60, pp. 61-80l
title: Ahead of Its Time. The Emergence of Insurance Education at the Warsaw School of Economics (1906–1939)
affiliations: Warsaw School of Economics (SGH) and

detail.title: Ahead of Its Time. The Emergence of Insurance Education at the Warsaw School of Economics (1906–1939)

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Management and Financial Sciences, Vol. XIX, Issue 60, pp. 61-80l

detail.abstract: This article examines the origins and development of insurance education at the Warsaw School of Economics (SGH) between 1906 and 1939. Against the backdrop of the rising importance of insurance in Europe, SGH established the first comprehensive academic programme in Poland dedicated to both business and social insurance. The study addresses three main questions: what historical, economic and social conditions influenced the establishment of this programme; how the SGH model compares with early initiatives in Germany, France, the United Kingdom and the United States, as well as with attempts in Central and Eastern Europe; and what its achievements meant for insurance science and practice. The article demonstrates that SGH's pioneering curriculum-interdisciplinary, closely linked to market practice, and open to women-was unique in the region. Although interrupted by the Second World War, its intellectual and institutional legacy shaped later developments in Polish insurance education.

AI.tldr: 本文考察了华沙经济学院（SGH）在1906年至1939年间保险教育的起源与发展，证明SGH开创性地建立了波兰首个涵盖商业保险和社会保险的综合学术课程，其跨学科、紧贴市场实践、向女性开放的教学模式在该地区独树一帜。尽管被第二次世界大战中断，其知识与制度遗产深刻影响了后来波兰保险教育的发展。
AI.research_question: 本研究提出三个核心问题：(1) 哪些历史、经济和社会条件影响了该课程项目的建立；(2) SGH模式与德国、法国、英国、美国以及中欧和东欧的早期保险教育举措相比有何异同；(3) SGH在保险科学与实践方面的成就意味着什么。
AI.motivation: 在欧洲保险业重要性日益上升的背景下，SGH建立了波兰第一个专门针对商业和社会保险的综合性学术项目。该研究旨在填补对波兰早期保险教育历史发展的关注空白，并梳理其在区域内的独特性与影响力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文采用历史比较分析框架，从历史、经济和社会条件多维度考察保险教育制度的形成，并通过跨国比较（德国、法国、英国、美国及中欧东欧地区）来定位SGH模式的独特性。
AI.method: 采用历史分析方法，对SGH保险教育项目的历史背景、课程设置、教学模式及制度发展进行系统梳理，并与欧洲多国及美国早期保险教育举措进行比较研究。
AI.findings: 研究发现SGH的开拓性课程具有跨学科性、与市场实践紧密联系、且向女性开放等独特特征，在中东欧地区具有独特性；该课程在培养保险人才和推动保险科学发展方面取得了重要成就，其遗产虽受二战中断，但深刻影响了战后波兰保险教育的发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为保险教育史研究提供了中东欧地区的比较视角，揭示了在特定历史经济条件下学术机构如何构建具有区域特色的保险教育模式，丰富了跨国保险教育发展路径的理论认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过梳理SGH早期保险教育的模式与遗产，为当代保险教育课程设计提供历史参照，特别是跨学科融合、产学研结合及性别平等方面的实践经验。

title:
Local Books, Global Truth

Instant Settlement Without Miners, Validators, Or Forks— And A Fraud Detector That Comes for Free
affiliations: Universidad Politécnica de Madrid

detail.title:
Local Books, Global Truth

Instant Settlement Without Miners, Validators, Or Forks— And A Fraud Detector That Comes for Free
detail.abstract: Bitcoin prevents double-spending by making the whole network agree on one history, and pays for it with energy, waiting, probabilistic finality and a system that stops or forks when the network splits. Proof-of-stake removes the energy but keeps the global vote-and adds locked capital, validator cartels and slashing. We show that neither is necessary for the large family of systems whose participants are identifiable: banks, market infrastructures, payment networks, federated databases. A double-spend has a telltale anatomy-every local ledger is impeccable, every pairwise reconciliation matches, and the fraud exists only in the global picture. Once that is understood, the cure is not a global vote but a shared order: a validated timestamp service, tolerant of up to one third lying anchors, under which each node processes locally and the local pieces are guaranteed to reassemble into a consistent whole. The result is settlement that is instant, energy-free, scales with the number of nodes, and keeps running under partition. Experiments with 2,000 wallets executed 1,198,203 settlements with zero inconsistencies and blocked all 480 injected double-spends. The same test, run in reverse, detects circular float ("kiting") and hidden conflicts in replicated data-the latter provably invisible to pairwise synchronization-and names the offending entries.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种不同于比特币工作量证明（PoW）和权益证明（PoS）的全新共识机制：对于参与者可识别（如银行、支付网络、联邦数据库）的分布式系统，双重支付可以通过共享的、可验证的时间戳顺序来解决，而非依赖全局投票。系统容忍最多三分之一的恶意锚点，可实现即时、无能耗、可扩展且在分区下持续运行的结算。实验在2,000个钱包上执行了1,198,203笔结算，零不一致，并拦截了全部480次注入的双重支付攻击。
AI.research_question: 对于参与者可识别的分布式系统（银行、支付网络、联邦数据库等），是否存在一种既不需要工作量证明的能源消耗，也不需要权益证明的资本锁定和验证者卡特尔化的共识机制，来实现安全的双重支付防护？
AI.motivation: 比特币通过全局网络共识防止双重支付，但代价高昂：能源消耗、等待确认、概率性最终性以及网络分裂时系统停止或分叉。权益证明（PoS）消除了能源需求，但仍保留全局投票机制，同时引入了资本锁定、验证者卡特尔和罚没（slashing）等新问题。作者认为对于参与者可识别的一大批系统而言，这些机制都不是必需的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重支付的可识别解剖结构理论：每个本地账本都无可挑剔，每对节点间的对账都匹配，但欺诈仅存在于全局图景中。基于此认识，解决方案不是全局投票，而是共享顺序——一个经过验证的时间戳服务，容忍多达三分之一的恶意锚点。
AI.method: 本文采用理论分析与实验验证相结合的方法。理论层面分析了双重支付的内在结构特征；实验层面使用2,000个钱包执行1,198,203笔结算，测试系统在注入480次双重支付攻击下的表现。同时将同样的机制反向应用于检测循环浮账（kiting）和复制数据中的隐藏冲突。
AI.findings: 基于共享顺序（而非全局投票）的共识机制能够实现即时、无能源消耗、随节点数扩展且在分区下持续运行的结算。实验结果显示：1,198,203笔结算零不一致，480次注入的双重支付攻击全部被拦截。该机制还可反向应用于检测循环浮账和复制数据中的隐藏冲突（后者对成对同步机制是不可见的），并能指出违规条目。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了双重支付的核心解剖结构——欺诈仅存在于全局图景而非局部账本中；2. 论证了对于参与者可识别系统，全局投票（无论是PoW还是PoS）并非必要，共享顺序即可解决双重支付问题；3. 将时间戳服务与拜占庭容错（容忍1/3恶意锚点）相结合，形成新的理论框架；4. 证明该方法可推广到检测循环浮账和复制数据冲突等更广泛的应用场景。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为银行、市场基础设施、支付网络和联邦数据库等实际系统提供了无需能源消耗和资本锁定的结算方案；2. 实现即时结算（无需等待区块确认）；3. 系统在网络分区时仍可持续运行；4. 可扩展性好，随节点数量增长；5. 提供了双重支付防护和欺诈检测（如kiting、复制数据冲突）的实用工具。

title: Measuring the Circuit Operationalization, the Falsification Surface, and the Price of Measurement in the Conscious Cost Program

detail.title: Measuring the Circuit Operationalization, the Falsification Surface, and the Price of Measurement in the Conscious Cost Program
detail.abstract: The first four papers of the Conscious Cost research program develop a single theoretical apparatus — consciously recognized cost (Cs), invested cost (Cq), their divergence (Gap), reference scale (R), voluntariness (V), institutional tacitness (T), and independence of self-worth (P) — across four scales of human organization: interpersonal relations, civic institutions, markets, and polities. Each paper closes with the same honest admission: the variables are conceptually defined but not operationalized, and the propositions are structural claims not yet exposed to controlled test. This paper does one thing with that admission. It converts it from a recurring deferral into a specified falsification surface. Three contributions follow. First, the paper extracts the core propositions of Papers 1–4 into a proposition–prediction table governed by three operating rules that close, or place under public governance, the rescue clauses through which adverse findings could otherwise be shown out — including a registry rule under which the theory’s own rescue history becomes a measured quantity. Second, the paper consolidates the operationalization candidates into a single instrument inventory, with Gap specified as a domain-indexed schema (Gap_d = Cq_d − Cs_d) whose measurement proceeds domain by domain, and with the assumptions beneath every instrument entered in a measurement-assumption registry of their own. Third, the paper draws a distinction no prior paper draws: between what the theory’s definitions entail about its own measurement — a single negative determination: the reading of a direct cost question can never be presumed a variable-independent sample, because the question belongs by definition to the class of operations that constitute the variable — and the auxiliary hypotheses that must be added before its measurement conditions become predictable. The auxiliary hypotheses are registered in the same four-column form the paper imposes on Papers 1–4, under the same operating rules, and each is distinguished — margin by margin — from the established literatures of measurement reactivity, framing, and question wording; one, on the selective pricing of research access, is withdrawn in the open when the reckoning shows its differential content was not differential. The paper revises no proposition of Papers 1–4. What it adds, it adds under declaration: auxiliary hypotheses, measurement assumptions, and one specification of the program’s definitional base, each registered where it can fail. The paper closes by mapping the residue — what cannot be measured, in which mode, and conditional on what — and marking the boundary where Paper 5’s document-based instrument and Paper 6’s negative determination take over.

AI.tldr: 本文是Conscious Cost研究项目的第五篇论文，将前四篇论文中反复推迟的变量操作化与命题检验问题，转化为一个明确的证伪面。作者提取前四篇论文的核心命题建立命题-预测表，制定三条操作规则以封闭"救援条款"，将操作化候选整合为工具清单（Gap按领域索引），并区分了理论定义对自身测量的单一否定性规定与必须添加的辅助假设。
AI.research_question: 如何将Conscious Cost理论项目（论文1-4）中反复声明"尚未操作化、尚未检验"的延续性问题，转化为一个明确、可检验的证伪面——具体包括：核心命题如何转化为可检验的预测？操作化候选如何整合？测量条件如何变成可预测的？
AI.motivation: 前四篇论文每次都以同一诚实声明收尾：变量仅做概念定义而未操作化，命题仅为结构主张而未经受控检验。这种重复性推延需要一个转折点——将承认转化为一个特定的证伪面，而非继续搁置。
AI.theoretical_framework: Conscious Cost理论程序：自觉成本（Cs）、投入成本（Cq）、两者差距（Gap）、参照尺度（R）、自愿性（V）、制度默会性（T）、自我价值独立性（P）。本文引入"测量-假设登记册"与"救援条款治理"框架。
AI.method: 命题-预测表构建（受三条操作规则治理，包括注册规则）；操作化工具清单整合；Gap按领域索引的模式（Gap_d = Cq_d − Cs_d）逐域测量；测量假设登记册；辅助假设按四列格式登记并逐条与既有文献区分。
AI.findings: （1）核心命题被提取为命题-预测表，救援条款被三条操作规则封闭或置于公共治理之下；理论自身的救援历史成为可测量量。（2）操作化候选整合为统一工具清单，Gap按领域逐域测量。（3）理论定义对自身测量有单一否定性规定：直接成本问题的读数不能被视为变量无关的样本。（4）辅助假设被登记，其中一项关于研究访问的差别定价假设被公开撤回。（5）不修改论文1-4的任何命题，新增内容均以声明方式登记在可失败之处。（6）划定了与第5篇论文（基于文档的工具）和第6篇论文（否定性确定）的边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 将理论项目的可证伪性从"结构性声明"推进到"特定证伪面"；引入"救援条款治理"概念（包括注册规则，使理论的救援历史本身成为可测量的量）；区分理论定义对测量的内蕴含义与外部辅助假设，划清与测量反应性、框架效应、问题措辞等既有文献的边界；提出"直接成本问题的读数不能视为变量无关样本"这一否定性确定。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供统一的工具清单和Gap的领域索引测量模式，为研究者实际操作化Conscious Cost变量提供可操作的路径；通过测量假设登记册使每个工具背后的假设透明化；通过公开撤回一项无效辅助假设，示范了可错性管理的实践范例。

title: A Hidden but Singular Version of Reformulating Production Functions, or a belated Obituary for the Symmetric Three-stage of Production
affiliations: Takming University of Science and Technology and Takming University of Science and Technology

detail.title: A Hidden but Singular Version of Reformulating Production Functions, or a belated Obituary for the Symmetric Three-stage of Production
detail.abstract: From delving into the books of Milton Friedman and others, the authors of this paper have reclaimed and now represent a peculiar and unconventional method for transforming production functions that may be hidden within those books; that is, a rare reformulation and treatment is applied to the general formula of a one-single-productwith-two-factor function, so that the majority of the new functions after transformation treat K/L and L as the simultaneous independent variables, with the dependent variable now representing an "average" corresponding to a particular factor ratio. By deriving ∂APL/∂L and solving for MPL, we elaborate on the implications of this approach: the extended symmetric version of the three stages of production can be shown to be almost nonexistent unless we loosely require that, for example, an unusual differential of the new function with respect to L converges to zero while the original three-stage diagram holds beforehand. To avoid misunderstanding this kind of reformulation as a trivial and insignificant mathematical exercise, the article then focuses on the "Sato/Rowe" function, which has almost disappeared for long, and similarly transforms it, deriving and solving its ∂APL/∂L and MPL. The important lesson from such mathematical operations and inferences is as follows: even though this homogeneous function of degree one can absolutely be used to characterize compellingly the law of variable proportions and the original three stages of production, it cannot make the symmetric version of the three-stage come true-unless L/K's approaching infinity has an economic significance that cannot be ignored, and we also happen to disregard other ostensibly insignificant considerations.

AI.tldr: 本文从弗里德曼等人的著作中重新发掘了一种罕见的柯布-道格拉斯型生产函数变换方法，将单产品双要素生产函数的一般形式重新表述为以K/L和L为独立变量、以特定要素比率的"平均值"为因变量的新函数形式。通过推导∂APL/∂L并求解MPL，作者证明了：除非要求新函数对L的微分收敛于零等苛刻条件，否则扩展的三阶段生产对称版本几乎不存在。文章进一步将这一方法应用于几乎被遗忘的"Sato/Rowe"函数，得出结论：即使该一次齐次函数能有效刻画要素可变比例法则和原始三阶段生产，也无法实现三阶段的对称版本，除非L/K趋近无穷大具有不可忽视的经济意义。
AI.research_question: 隐藏在弗里德曼等人著作中的非常规生产函数变换方法是什么？将一般生产函数重新表述为以K/L和L为独立变量的形式后，三阶段生产的对称扩展版本是否存在？
AI.motivation: 作者希望从经典著作中重新发掘一种被忽视的生产函数变换方法，并检验这一方法对生产三阶段理论（特别是其对称扩展版本）的适用性，以避免将这种数学重构视为微不足道的练习，同时重估几乎被遗忘的Sato/Rowe函数的理论价值。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生产函数理论、生产三阶段理论（边际报酬递减规律）、一次齐次（线性齐次）函数理论、Sato/Rowe函数理论
AI.method: 数学推导与分析：对单产品双要素生产函数的一般公式进行重新表述和变换，通过对新函数求∂APL/∂L并求解MPL，推导新函数形式的性质；将该变换方法应用于Sato/Rowe函数，进行同样的微分和求解分析。
AI.findings: （1）经变换后的新函数以K/L和L为独立变量，因变量表示特定要素比率的平均值；（2）除极端宽松条件下（如新函数对L的微分收敛为零），对称的三阶段生产版本几乎不存在；（3）尽管Sato/Rowe函数（一次齐次函数）能有效刻画可变比例法则和原始三阶段，但无法实现三阶段的对称版本，除非L/K趋近无穷大的经济意义被强调且忽略其他次要考虑。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文揭示了生产函数变换方法的新形式及其对古典生产三阶段理论的深刻影响，证明了对称三阶段版本在一般条件下的不可能性，重新评估并复兴了Sato/Rowe函数的理论意义，深化了对一次齐次生产函数性质边界的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学研究者提供了生产函数变换与分析的详细数学工具和方法论指南，提醒研究者在应用生产三阶段理论时注意对称版本的理论边界和适用条件，避免对生产函数转换结果产生误判。

title: Key Players and Collapse in Networks with Endogenous Participation
affiliations: Virginia Tech - Department of Economics, University of Grenoble Alpes, CNRS, Virginia Tech and Virginia Tech - Department of Economics

detail.title: Key Players and Collapse in Networks with Endogenous Participation
detail.abstract: We study intervention in linear-quadratic network games with endogenous participation. Agents pay a fixed participation cost and, when active, choose actions with strategic complementarities, making equilibrium behavior depend on their position in the active network. Removing a player weakens the incentives of others and may trigger a cascade of exits. We show that participation equilibria form a complete lattice and develop an algorithm that selects the largest equilibrium. We then revisit the key-player problem when participation can adjust. The cascade key-player minimizes aggregate action after all induced exits and may differ from the player selected under fixed participation. We characterize this target through the network's internally viable groups and decompose the effect of removal into direct network and cascade components. We also characterize collapse players, whose removal eliminates every viable group, and show that pivotal players can cause complete collapse even when the player with the largest conventional influence cannot.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了具有内生参与决策的线性二次网络博弈中的干预问题。在固定参与成本下，活跃代理人的行动具有战略互补性，删除某玩家可能引发退出级联。作者证明了参与均衡形成完全格并开发了选择最大均衡的算法，进而重新审视了关键玩家问题，提出了级联关键玩家和崩塌玩家的概念。
AI.research_question: 在内生参与的网络博弈中，如何识别最优干预目标（关键玩家），以及移除玩家后网络级联效应如何影响总体行动水平？
AI.motivation: 传统关键玩家问题假设参与网络是固定的，但现实中代理人的参与决策是内生的——移除一个玩家会削弱他人激励并可能引发退出级联。理解这种级联动态对设计有效的网络干预至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 线性二次网络博弈、参与均衡的完全格理论、网络内生退出级联模型
AI.method: 理论分析与博弈论建模，通过参与均衡的格结构性质发展算法，利用网络内部可行群体（internally viable groups）刻画关键玩家特征。
AI.findings: （1）参与均衡形成完全格，可设计算法选择最大均衡；（2）级联关键玩家与固定参与下的关键玩家可能不同；（3）可通过内部可行群体刻画级联关键玩家，并将移除效应分解为直接网络效应和级联效应；（4）界定崩塌玩家——其移除可消灭所有可行群体，且枢纽玩家可能引发完全崩塌而传统影响力最大的玩家不能。
AI.theory_contributions: 将内生参与引入网络博弈的关键玩家分析，扩展了网络博弈理论和干预理论；建立了参与均衡的格结构性质；首次区分了固定参与与内生参与下的关键玩家识别差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为网络干预政策（如经济网络中的监管、社交媒体平台治理、金融网络风险管控）提供了更精确的目标选择工具，帮助决策者识别能引发级联崩塌的最优干预对象。

title: How to Beat FCFS
affiliations: Stanford University - Department of Management Science & Engineering and University of Chicago

detail.title: How to Beat FCFS
detail.abstract: We study two observable queues with identical service rates, serving agents who arrive stochastically over time. Agents join the queue that minimizes their expected waiting time. Assuming one queue uses the ubiquitous First-Come-First-Served (FCFS) service rule, we show that by simply modifying its service order, the other queue can capture a strict majority of the demand. We establish an upper bound on the arrival share any rule can capture against FCFS. When both queues can design their service order, we show a novel variant of Last-Come-First-Served (LCFS) is an equilibrium in a low congestion regime. Without commitment, the picture changes, and there is an equilibrium where both queues use FCFS, and agents route to the queue with the shorter waitlist.

AI.tldr: 本文研究两个具有相同服务速率的可观察队列，代理会随机随时间到达并加入期望等待时间最小的队列。研究发现，当一个队列采用先来先服务（FCFS）规则时，另一队列仅通过修改服务顺序就能捕获严格多数的需求。文章还建立了任何服务规则对抗FCFS所能捕获的到达份额的上界。当两个队列都能设计服务顺序时，在低拥塞条件下，一种新型的后进先出（LCFS）变体是均衡策略。在没有承诺的情况下，均衡变为两个队列都使用FCFS，代理会根据较短的等待队列进行路由。
AI.research_question: 在可观察队列的竞争环境中，服务顺序的设计如何影响各队列吸引到达需求的能力？均衡的服务规则是什么？
AI.motivation: 现实中许多服务系统（如呼叫中心、医院急诊、网络服务）中，多个服务提供者竞争客户。尽管服务顺序设计是操作管理中的重要决策变量，但现有研究对其在竞争性队列环境中的战略作用理解不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 队列博弈理论（queueing game theory）、马尔可夫决策过程、非合作博弈均衡分析
AI.method: 理论建模与分析：建立竞争性可观察队列的博弈模型，推导服务规则对到达份额的影响上界，并分析在有承诺和无承诺两种情况下的均衡服务规则。
AI.findings: (1) 面对FCFS竞争者，其他队列通过修改服务顺序能捕获严格多数的需求，并存在到达份额的上界；(2) 当双方都能设计服务顺序时，在低拥塞环境下新型LCFS变体是均衡策略；(3) 在没有承诺的情况下，双方均采用FCFS形成均衡，代理根据较短的等待队列进行路由。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统分析竞争性队列中服务顺序作为战略决策变量的作用，建立了服务规则捕获到达份额的理论上界，并揭示了有承诺与无承诺情境下均衡服务规则的差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为服务运营管理者提供策略性服务顺序设计的理论指导，说明如何通过调整服务规则在竞争中获取更大市场份额，同时指出承诺能力对竞争均衡的重要影响。

title: When Trade Dries Up: Infrastructure Constraints and Firm Performance
affiliations: University of Toronto - Finance Area

detail.title: When Trade Dries Up: Infrastructure Constraints and Firm Performance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.ethicsApproval: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract: This paper investigates how drought affects firms and supply chains by constraining capacity in critical trade infrastructure. Combining granular data on firms' maritime shipping and exogenous variation in the capacity of a major trade route caused by water scarcity, I analyze the effects of disruption on the performance of U.S. firms. A one-standard deviation decrease in available water reduces revenues by 0.2 and operating income by 0.37 percentage points. Inventories decrease, and operating expenses increase with constraints, while the incidence of costs varies with firms' market power. Analyses of vessel movement and transportation costs indicate that the effects coincide with vessel reallocation and increases in freight rates. Compared to disruptions at individual suppliers, the risks of drought-related choke points are opaque and affect many firms at once. Mentions of drought and supply chain pressure increase only marginally in earnings calls. Although sophisticated investors appear to respond to information on realized constraints in water supply by increasing shorting, analysts do not fully anticipate the effects, and earnings surprises tend to become more negative. Since many economies rely on waterways increasingly constrained by drought, the findings highlight how local physical climate shocks can spread through supply-chain infrastructure, generating non-local losses that can be challenging to observe.

AI.tldr: 本文研究干旱通过限制关键贸易基础设施（水运通道）的容量对企业及其供应链的影响。利用企业海运数据和因水资源短缺导致的美国主要贸易航线容量外生变化，发现可用水量每减少一个标准差，企业收入降低0.2个百分点，营业利润降低0.37个百分点。干旱导致的供应链瓶颈风险不透明且影响范围广泛，投资者和分析师均未能充分预期其影响。
AI.research_question: 干旱如何通过限制关键贸易基础设施（水运通道）的容量影响企业绩效和供应链？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注个别供应商中断的影响，而干旱导致的航运咽喉点风险具有不透明性和广泛影响面，且许多经济体越来越依赖受干旱约束的水道，因此亟需量化此类气候冲击通过供应链基础设施传播的经济后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 供应链中断理论、贸易基础设施容量约束理论、气候风险定价理论
AI.method: 结合企业级海运微观数据与美国主要贸易航线因水资源短缺导致的容量外生变化，采用实证分析（准自然实验框架），辅以船舶运动数据分析、运费分析、盈利电话会议文本分析和分析师预测偏差分析。
AI.findings: （1）可用水量每减少一个标准差，企业收入下降0.2个百分点，营业利润下降0.37个百分点；（2）库存下降、运营费用上升，成本负担因企业市场势力而异；（3）影响伴随着船舶重新调度和运费上升；（4）干旱和供应链压力的提及在盈利电话会议中仅边际增加；（5）成熟的投资者通过增加做空应对实际水供应约束信息，但分析师未能完全预期影响，盈利意外趋于负向。
AI.theory_contributions: 将气候物理冲击通过供应链基础设施（特别是水运通道）传播的机制理论化，区别于传统个别供应商中断研究，揭示瓶颈型基础设施风险的系统性和不透明性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业风险管理、投资者决策（识别干旱相关供应链风险的信号）以及政策制定者（关注水运基础设施对经济韧性的重要性）提供实证依据。

title: Green Digital Finance in Emerging Markets:  FinTech as a Catalyst for Clean-Energy Adoption in Middle-Income Economies Facing Growth Transition Tradeoffs

detail.title: Green Digital Finance in Emerging Markets:  FinTech as a Catalyst for Clean-Energy Adoption in Middle-Income Economies Facing Growth Transition Tradeoffs
detail.abstract: Climate and development commentary treats FinTech as a catalyst for clean-energy adoption in middle-income economies. The public files treat it first as a payments layer. In the World Bank Global Findex 2025, 79 percent of adults held an account in 2024, against 51 percent in 2011. Sub-Saharan Africa had about 40 percent of adults on mobile money and 430 million active mobile-money accounts in the IMF/OWID file. That is a real rail. It is not a generation-share. Among 85 middle-income countries with both series, the correlation of account ownership with solar-plus-wind's share of electricity is-0.07. Conditional on income, a ten-point rise in account ownership is associated with 0.4 points less solar-plus-wind, not more. In a balanced reading of World Bank indicators and Ember/Energy Institute electricity files, 32 of 106 middle-income countries clear all three clocks we define-a finance rail, an electricity-access floor, and a clean kilowatt-hour-covering 3.85 billion people, of which China and India are most of the headcount. Twenty developing countries occupy a PAYG cell: accounts without the access floor. Nineteen of them are in sub-Saharan Africa. Kenya has account ownership of 90 percent, solar-plus-wind of 18 percent, electricity access of 77 percent, and generation of 228 kilowatt-hours per person. Indonesia has accounts of 56 percent, access of 100 percent, solar-plus-wind of 0.4 percent, and a fossil share of 80 percent. IEA World Energy Investment 2025 puts global clean-energy capital at 2.2 trillion dollars, China's share at almost one-third, Africa's at 2 percent. IFC-Amundi puts 2025 emerging-market GSSS issuance at 187 billion dollars, of which China is 111 billion and sub-Saharan Africa 1.7 billion. FinTech substitutes for a missing bank branch. It does not substitute for a missing offtaker, a missing wire, or a missing carbon price. The growth-transition tradeoff is not resolved by a payments app.

AI.tldr: 本文基于世界银行全球金融包容性指数、IMF/OWID移动货币数据及Ember/能源研究所电力数据，系统检验了金融科技（FinTech）对中等收入经济体清洁能源采用的影响。研究发现账户拥有率与太阳能和风能发电占比之间的相关性为负（-0.07），在控制收入后，账户拥有率每提高10个百分点，太阳能和风能占比反而下降0.4个百分点。论文提出了"三条时钟"框架（金融轨道、电力接入底线、清洁千瓦时覆盖），在106个中等收入国家中仅32个国家同时满足三条件，涵盖38.5亿人口（主要为中国和印度）。20个发展中国家处于PAYG（现收现付）状态——有账户但缺乏电力接入底线，其中19个位于撒哈拉以南非洲。论文结论指出：FinTech能替代缺失的银行网点，但不能替代缺失的承购方、电网线路或碳价机制，增长-转型的权衡无法通过支付应用解决。
AI.research_question: 金融科技（FinTech）在多大程度上能够作为催化剂促进中等收入经济体的清洁能源采用？金融科技究竟解决的是什么问题，又无法解决什么问题？
AI.motivation: 气候与发展领域的评论普遍将FinTech视为清洁能源采用的催化剂，但这一论断缺乏系统性实证检验。作者希望纠正这种过度乐观的叙事，通过跨国家数据揭示FinTech在能源转型中的真实角色和边界。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文隐含的理论框架包括：金融基础设施与能源基础设施的互补性理论、金融包容性与技术扩散的关系、以及"替代vs.互补"框架——即FinTech能否替代传统的银行网点、电网基础设施、电力承购方和碳定价机制。
AI.method: 基于世界银行全球金融包容性指数（Global Findex 2025）、IMF/OWID移动货币数据、Ember/能源研究所电力数据、IEA世界能源投资数据及IFC-Amundi绿色债券数据，对85-106个中等收入国家进行相关性分析和条件分析，并构建"三条时钟"（finance rail, electricity-access floor, clean kilowatt-hour）分类框架。
AI.findings: (1) 账户拥有率与太阳能和风能发电占比的相关性为-0.07（85个中等收入国家）；(2) 控制收入后，账户拥有率每提高10个百分点，太阳能和风能占比下降0.4个百分点；(3) 106个中等收入国家中仅32个同时满足三条时钟标准（覆盖38.5亿人，以中国和印度为主）；(4) 20个发展中国家处于PAYG状态（有账户无电力接入底线），其中19个在撒哈拉以南非洲；(5) 全球清洁能源资本2.2万亿美元中，中国占近三分之一，非洲仅占2%；新兴市场GSSS发行1870亿美元中，中国占1110亿，撒哈拉以南非洲仅17亿。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文对"FinTech促进清洁能源采用"的主流叙事进行了系统性反驳和修正，提出了"三条时钟"分析框架来系统性评估中等收入国家的能源转型条件，并区分了FinTech作为支付层与作为能源转型催化剂的角色差异，深化了对金融基础设施与能源基础设施互补性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了清醒的指导：FinTech可以弥补银行网点不足，但无法替代电网建设、电力承购协议和碳定价机制。政策资源应聚焦于补齐能源基础设施短板，而非过度依赖金融科技解决能源转型问题。同时识别出了PAYG国家集群（主要位于撒哈拉以南非洲）作为需要重点关注的转型困境地区。

title: The Correct Implied Stock Return From Option Prices : Resolution and Flat Variance Drift Calibration
affiliations: University of Toledo

detail.title: The Correct Implied Stock Return From Option Prices : Resolution and Flat Variance Drift Calibration
detail.abstract:
This paper implements a native, log-additive calibration framework to isolate and extract the continuous drift structure of underlying stock assets directly from the options cross-section. Moore (2023) explains that the Moore model is a variable Fokker Planck model where the drift is from market prices. Moving away from traditional Black-Scholes-Merton parameters that force a flat global macroeconomic interest rate into local tracking coordinate fields, this framework treats the option pricing weights accurately as variable expectations moving through time. The empirical design matrix is verified across a static snapshot of the Rubinstein (1994) S&P 500 Index options dataset from January 2, 1990, evaluated using clean Market Mid-Prices (the arithmetic average of Bid and Ask quotes).

The primary empirical discovery of this calibration engine is that adjusting the baseline stochastic
variance parameter to be completely flat across the entire contract chain yields an extraordinary
optimal fit that is significantly higher across two distinct cuts of the data set: the raw Actual Traded
Prices and the un-smoothed Market Mid-Prices. By enforcing a strict no-intercept frame to
eliminate coordinate warping and multicollinearity, the mid-price design matrix resolves the cross-
section with extreme precision (R^2 = 0.9973) while holding the variance baseline perfectly flat at
18.72%. This high statistical fit provides definitive evidence that the real, underlying relationship is
unity, driven by the rigid boundary conditions of a rate-substituted replication portfolio. When this
unity system is optimized, the extracted underlying asset drift parameter resolves to a perfectly flat,
uniform line at approximately 21.01% across every single individual strike price. This incredible
cross-sectional coherence proves that the options surface does not require variable volatility; when
variance is flat, the implied stock return rate adapts natively to satisfy the physical boundary
conditions of the market, leaving the final validation of this extraction entirely to the profession.

AI.tldr: 本文实现了一个本地对数可加校准框架，直接从期权横截面中提取标的股票的连续漂移结构。实证发现，当方差参数在整条合约链上完全平坦时，模型达到极优拟合（R²=0.9973），提取的标的资产漂移参数在所有执行价格上均匀平坦于约21.01%，证明期权曲面无需可变波动率。
AI.research_question: 如何从期权横截面数据中直接提取标的股票资产的连续漂移结构，而非依赖传统Black-Scholes-Merton框架中强制设定的全局平坦利率参数？
AI.motivation: 传统Black-Scholes-Merton模型强制使用全局宏观利率，无法反映市场价格的局部时变特征。Moore模型作为可变Fokker-Planck模型，其漂移来自市场价格，因此需要一个校准框架来直接从期权横截面中提取标的资产的漂移结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: Moore可变Fokker-Planck模型；对数可加校准框架；Black-Scholes-Merton框架批判；复制定价组合的刚性边界条件理论
AI.method: 采用本地对数可加校准框架，使用Rubinstein (1994) S&P 500指数期权数据集（1990年1月2日静态快照），基于市场中间价（买卖报价的算术平均）进行评估。实施严格的无截距框架以消除坐标扭曲和多重共线性，将方差基线设定为完全平坦。
AI.findings: 1) 将方差参数在整条合约链上完全平坦化后，模型在原始实际成交价和未平滑市场中间价两组数据上均获得显著更高的最优拟合；2) 中间价设计矩阵在方差基线完全平坦（18.72%）时达到R²=0.9973的极高精度；3) 提取的标的资产漂移参数在所有执行价格上解析为约21.01%的完全平坦均匀线。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明期权曲面并不需要可变波动率；当方差平坦时，隐含股票收益率会自适应地满足市场物理边界条件，揭示真实底层关系为统一性（unity），由利率替代复制定价组合的刚性边界条件驱动。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个新的校准引擎，可从期权横截面中直接提取标的资产的漂移结构，为期权定价、风险管理及标的资产收益率估计提供了替代传统BSM框架的实证工具。

title: Reforming Rollovers
affiliations: Texas Tech University School of Law

detail.title: Reforming Rollovers

declarations.declarationOfInterest: N/A
declarations.funderStatement: N/A

detail.abstract:
Millions of Americans change jobs annually. When they do, those with employer sponsored retirement plans, like 401(k)s, will: cash out their retirement savings and suffer a substantial tax penalty; do nothing, allowing their savings to languish while being diminished by extra fees; or roll over those funds into another employer sponsored retirement plan or individual retirement account (IRA). IRAs entail debilitatingly high fees and lack fiduciary and other protections, making plan-to-plan rollovers the optimal option.
 
This Article is the first to detail how insidious choice architecture is used to enrich fiduciaries and steer workers away from that option. It explains how, amid America's retirement savings crisis, plan administrators employ manipulative "sludge" to erect barriers to plan-to-plan rollovers. It evaluates why sludge is effective and why it harms workers' retirement prospects. To demonstrate that the process is intentionally broken, the author, a retirement benefits scholar, recounts how rolling over her own savings proved more challenging than obtaining a mortgage. If a seasoned lawyer and benefits scholar cannot reasonably move her own money, how are busy workers unfamiliar with the intricacies of retirement law supposed to perform rollovers? They aren't. When fiduciaries erect costly, demoralizing, and unnecessary barriers-sludge-between Americans and their savings, they jeopardize retirement security. Fortunately, the concepts currently employed against workers can be harnessed to protect them. Behavioral economics-informed, technological, and other solutions exist to combat sludge. Deploying those solutions in the rollover context now will help safeguard Americans' long-term retirement prospects.

AI.tldr: 本文首次详细揭示退休计划管理人如何利用"污泥"（sludge）——即险恶的选择架构——来设置障碍，阻止工人进行计划间转存（plan-to-plan rollover），从而从中牟利并损害工人的退休保障。作者结合自身经验，提出利用行为经济学和技术解决方案来对抗这些障碍。
AI.research_question: 退休计划管理人是如何以及为何利用选择架构（sludge）来阻止工人进行计划间转存？这种行为对工人退休前景有何危害？以及如何利用行为经济学和技术手段来对抗这些障碍？
AI.motivation: 数百万美国人每年更换工作，面临退休储蓄处置的艰难选择。虽然计划间转存是最优选项，但管理人通过隐蔽的选择架构设置障碍，引导工人远离该选项，损害工人退休保障。作者作为退休福利学者亲身经历转存困难，促使她深入剖析这一系统性问题的运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 选择架构理论（Choice Architecture）、"污泥"（Sludge）理论（行为经济学中的摩擦成本概念）、行为经济学（Behavioral Economics）
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（normative legal analysis），结合作者个人经历（自我民族志/参与观察法）作为实证证据，辅以对美国退休储蓄制度现状的制度分析与行为经济学理论框架的运用。
AI.findings: （1）退休计划管理人系统性地利用"污泥"策略，即蓄意设计的繁琐、昂贵且不必要的障碍，来阻止工人进行计划间转存；（2）这些策略之所以有效，是因为工人缺乏退休法律专业知识且面临时间与认知资源限制；（3）转存过程被故意设计成"破碎"的流程，即使是资深律师和退休福利学者也难以完成；（4）这种设置严重损害了工人们的退休安全。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将"污泥"（sludge）概念系统性地应用于退休计划转存领域，揭示了受托人如何反向利用选择架构来损害而非保护受益人利益，拓展了行为经济学中关于选择架构弊端（而非仅益处）的理论探讨。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了对抗污泥的具体解决方案，包括行为经济学知情干预、技术手段（如简化数字化流程）等，为政策制定者和监管者提供了保护工人退休利益的可操作建议，有助于改善美国退休储蓄转存制度的公平性和可及性。

title: Employment Discrimination and Corporate Investment
affiliations: University of North Dakota - Department of Economics and Finance

detail.title: Employment Discrimination and Corporate Investment
detail.abstract: I examine how employment discrimination affects corporate investment by exploiting the staggered adoption of state-level Employment Nondiscrimination Acts (ENDAs), which prohibit employment discrimination based on sexual orientation and gender identity. Using an imputation-based difference-indifferences estimator, I find that corporate investment declines significantly among firms headquartered in states adopting ENDAs. The evidence suggests that stronger employment nondiscrimination protections increase firms' labor costs, leading firms to scale back their operations and reduce corporate investment. Overall, the findings indicate that although ENDAs provide important legal protections for LGBT workers, they may also impose unintended costs on firms by influencing their investment decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文利用美国各州逐步采纳《就业不歧视法案》（ENDAs）这一准自然实验，采用基于插补的双重差分估计方法，发现总部位于采纳ENDA州的企业的公司投资显著下降。证据表明，更强的就业不歧视保护增加了企业的劳动力成本，促使企业缩减运营规模并减少投资。虽然ENDAs为LGBT员工提供了重要的法律保护，但也可能通过影响企业投资决策而对公司施加了非预期的成本。
AI.research_question: 就业歧视法律保护（ENDAs）如何影响企业的公司投资决策？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注反歧视法律对劳动力市场结果（如就业、工资）的影响，但鲜有研究探讨其对企业的资本投资决策的影响。ENDAs的逐步采纳为识别就业歧视保护与企业投资之间的因果关系提供了自然实验机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 劳动力成本理论——更强的就业不歧视保护会提高企业的劳动力成本（如合规成本、诉讼风险、用工灵活性下降），进而影响企业的投资决策。
AI.method: 利用美国各州逐步采纳ENDAs的政策变化作为准自然实验，采用基于插补（imputation-based）的双重差分（difference-in-differences）估计方法，比较总部位于采纳ENDA州的企业与未采纳州企业的投资变化。
AI.findings: 总部位于采纳ENDAs州的公司的公司投资显著下降；这种下降与劳动力成本上升、企业缩减运营规模有关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将就业歧视保护的研究从劳动力市场结果拓展到企业投资决策领域，揭示了劳动法规与企业资本配置之间的传导机制，丰富了劳动法与公司金融交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于ENDAs可能带来的非预期经济成本的证据，提示在推进LGBT权益保护时需权衡其对企业经营和投资活动的潜在负面影响。

title: The Intraday Correlation Pattern
affiliations: , , Shanghai University of Finance and Economics - School of Statistics and Management,  and Shanghai University of Finance and Economics

detail.title: The Intraday Correlation Pattern
detail.abstract: We establish a functional central limit theorem for a nonparametric estimator of the intraday periodic component of the instantaneous correlation between two financial assets, constructed from high-frequency data over a long time span. Our theory is developed in the Skorokhod space, which we show to be necessary, as the correlation functional fails to be Hadamard differentiable in the conventional L 2 metric; our approach further accommodates correlation patterns of either sign within the day as well as the benchmark case of a zero integrated correlation. We propose an estimator of the limiting covariance function, which enables a test for the equivalence of intraday correlation periodicity across two non-overlapping time periods. An empirical application to S&P 500 index and US Treasury bond futures uncovers pronounced intraday periodicity in correlation, whose shape varies over time, offering auxiliary information about potential drivers behind the long-term variation in the stock-bond correlation.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了日内瞬时相关性非参数估计量的泛函中心极限定理，在Skorokhod空间中发展统计推断理论，并提出可检验不同时间区间日内相关性周期模式是否等价的测试方法。实证应用于标普500指数与美国国债期货，发现相关性具有显著的日内周期性且形态随时间变化。
AI.research_question: 如何在高频数据长时间跨度下，对两个金融资产瞬时相关性的日内周期成分进行非参数估计，并建立其泛函中心极限定理以支持统计推断？
AI.motivation: 股票与债券相关性是资产配置和风险管理的关键参数，其日内周期模式及长期变化对理解市场动态具有重要意义，但现有理论框架在相关性泛函的推断上存在技术困难（如Hadamard不可微性）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 泛函中心极限定理（FCLT）；Skorokhod空间理论；Hadamard可微性；非参数估计。
AI.method: 基于高频数据长时间跨度构建日内瞬时相关性的非参数估计量；在Skorokhod空间中推导泛函中心极限定理；提出限制协方差函数的估计量并构造检验统计量；实证应用于S&P 500指数与美国国债期货的高频数据。
AI.findings: （1）相关性泛函在传统L2度量下不满足Hadamard可微性，需在Skorokhod空间中进行理论推导；（2）提出的测试方法可检验两个不相交时间段日内相关性周期性的等价性；（3）实证发现股票-债券相关性具有显著的日内周期性，且其形态随时间变化。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次为日内瞬时相关性的非参数估计建立泛函中心极限定理；（2）在Skorokhod空间中处理相关性泛函的不可微性问题，拓展了相关统计推断的理论框架；（3）允许日内相关性符号变化及零积分相关性的基准情形，提升了理论适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提供了检验日内相关性周期模式随时间变化的统计工具；（2）实证揭示了股票-债券相关性日内周期形态的时变特征，为理解长期相关性的驱动因素提供辅助信息，有助于资产配置和风险管理决策。

title: Paying Not to Know: News Avoidance in Times of War
affiliations: Tel Aviv University - Eitan Berglas School of Economics, The Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Department of Economics and Hebrew University of Jerusalem - Hebrew University

detail.title: Paying Not to Know: News Avoidance in Times of War
detail.abstract: Do individuals at war avoid news about outgroup victims? Would such news affect them if they were exposed to it? We study Israelis and Jordanians during the 2023-2025 Gaza war. Four findings stand out. First, individuals are substantially less willing to read about outgroup than ingroup civilian victims. Second, news avoidance is driven less by instrumental considerations or universal affective factors, and more by social identity and group norms. Third, reading about outgroup victims increases knowledge, fosters empathy toward the outgroup, and affects policy positions. Finally, these effects arise even among individuals who would rather avoid such news.

AI.tldr: 本文研究2023-2025年加沙战争期间以色列人和约旦人是否回避关于外群体受害者的新闻报道，以及如果被接触此类新闻会产生何种影响。研究发现：人们显著不愿意阅读外群体平民受害者的新闻；新闻回避主要由社会身份和群体规范驱动，而非工具性考量或普遍情感因素；阅读外群体受害者新闻能增加知识、促进对外群体的共情并影响政策立场；这些效应即使对原本回避此类新闻的人也依然存在。
AI.research_question: 战争中的人们是否会回避关于外群体受害者的新闻？如果被暴露于此种新闻，会产生什么影响？
AI.motivation: 理解冲突情境下人们对跨群体受害者信息的回避行为及其因果效应，填补关于新闻回避与群体间态度关系的实证空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会身份理论、群体规范理论、新闻回避理论（工具性考量vs情感因素）
AI.method: 以2023-2025年加沙战争期间的以色列人和约旦人为样本的实验研究设计
AI.findings: 四项主要发现：(1)个体显著不愿意阅读外群体平民受害者新闻；(2)新闻回避主要受社会身份和群体规范驱动；(3)阅读外群体受害者新闻增加知识、促进共情并影响政策立场；(4)这些效应在原本回避此类新闻的人中也存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 区分了新闻回避的不同驱动机制（工具性vs情感vs社会身份/群体规范），证明社会身份和群体规范在新闻回避中的核心作用；揭示了新闻暴露对群体间态度转变的有效性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为冲突地区媒体传播和干预设计提供启示：即使人们主动回避外群体信息，强制或偶然的新闻暴露仍可促进共情和知识改变，提示媒体平台和政策制定者可通过信息设计促进群体间理解。

title: Dynamic Investment in Durable Equipment

detail.title: Dynamic Investment in Durable Equipment
detail.abstract: This paper studies a continuous time game in which a finite number of investors purchase durable equipment on a primary market and rent it out. Investors exercise market power as oligopolists in the rental market and as oligopsonists in the purchase market, so the purchase price rises with the aggregate purchase rate and equipment stocks adjust gradually without any internal adjustment cost or capacity constraint. The unique open loop equilibrium is characterized in closed form. The unique symmetric Markov perfect equilibrium in affine strategies is shown to generate the same path. If initial endowments are symmetric, there exists a closed loop equilibrium under which investors overaccumulate relative to the Markov perfect equilibrium, but it rests on non-credible threats. In contrast to the classical pattern, it is the more competitive outcome that requires commitment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一个连续时间博弈模型，其中有限数量的投资者在初级市场购买耐用设备并将其出租。投资者在租赁市场行使寡头垄断权力，在购买市场行使寡头垄断权力。论文以闭式解刻画了唯一的开环均衡，证明了唯一的对称马尔可夫完美均衡（仿射策略）产生相同的路径，并探讨了闭环均衡下过度积累与承诺可信度的问题。
AI.research_question: 在投资者同时作为租赁市场寡头卖家和购买市场寡头买家的连续时间动态博弈中，不同均衡概念（开环均衡、马尔可夫完美均衡、闭环均衡）下的均衡路径和资本积累结果有何特征？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常关注单一市场权力（要么是寡头垄断的卖方，要么是寡头垄断的买方），而实际市场中投资者往往同时在两个市场行使市场权力。此外，需要澄清不同均衡概念（开环与闭环）在此类动态博弈中的结果差异及承诺问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 连续时间动态博弈理论；寡头垄断/寡头垄断（oligopoly/oligopsony）市场结构理论；开环均衡、马尔可夫完美均衡与闭环均衡的比较博弈论分析。
AI.method: 构建连续时间动态博弈模型，采用闭式解方法刻画唯一的开环均衡；利用仿射策略求解马尔可夫完美均衡；通过比较均衡概念分析闭环均衡的存在性及其可信度问题。
AI.findings: (1) 唯一的开环均衡可以闭式解形式刻画；(2) 仿射策略下的唯一对称马尔可夫完美均衡与开环均衡产生相同的路径；(3) 若初始禀赋对称，存在一个闭环均衡，其中投资者的资本积累超过马尔可夫完美均衡水平，但该均衡依赖不可信威胁；(4) 与经典模式相反，在本文模型中，更具竞争性的结果反而需要承诺（commitment）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将寡头垄断与寡头垄断的双重市场权力同时纳入连续时间动态博弈框架；证明了在多重市场权力结构下开环均衡与马尔可夫完美均衡的路径等价性；揭示了闭环均衡中资本过度积累现象及其依赖不可信威胁的机制；颠覆了经典文献中关于竞争结果与承诺关系的传统认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 为耐用资本品市场中投资者策略性购买与出租行为提供了理论预测；对市场监管者在双重市场权力环境下的政策设计具有启示意义；揭示了竞争性市场结果可能需要更强制度承诺的实践含义。

title: Exit as Adjudication: Tax-Right Withdrawal, Self-Executing Contracts, and a Zhouli Alternative to Procedural Justice

detail.title: Exit as Adjudication: Tax-Right Withdrawal, Self-Executing Contracts, and a Zhouli Alternative to Procedural Justice
detail.abstract: Different civilizations have accumulated distinct intellectual resources for governance. The Tiebout model of jurisdictional competition, rooted in Western traditions of territorial administration, provides a mature analytical framework for understanding population mobility and public goods provision. This paper draws upon a different tradition: the Zhouli (Rites of Zhou) order-not as a system of ceremonial norms, but as a constitutional vision in which governing authority originates from popular delegation, governors are bound by contractual constraints, and the people retain ultimate fact-based adjudicative power. Although the Zhouli institutions of "three inquiries" (san ci) and "three pardons" (san you) survived in their original form for only eight centuries, they established a legitimacy framework that has endured in Chinese civilization for three millennia. Building upon this Zhouli logic, the paper reconceives classical government bureaucracy as a peer matrix of professional guilds, each serving as a collective trustee of the people's delegated tax rights. Rather than following the conventional chain of procedural authorization and enforcement-based correction, it proposes a self-executing closed loop of tax-right withdrawal. Individual citizens withdraw their tax delegation; cumulative withdrawals are measured against a dynamically adjusted liquid threshold; once the threshold is breached, management replacement or guild reorganization is triggered automatically; the Office of Constitutional Oversight then convenes a post-hoc review; and only under conditions of systemic breakdown are military modules activated, assembled by lottery from market-capacity archives. The core finding is that the withdrawal mechanism does not rely on procedural review to prevent abuse, but on the physical self-adjudication of the tax base itself. If a withdrawal fails to affect a guild's tax base, it naturally subsides; if it reaches the scale of tax-base collapse, this fact itself signals that the guild has lost its popular mandate. Under this design, the function of procedure shifts from rights adjudication to transition management, offering an alternative logic to Western procedural justice: fact-based adjudication in place of procedure-based adjudication.

AI.tldr: 本文基于《周礼》传统（而非西方蒂伯特模型），重新构想政府官僚体系为专业行会的同行矩阵，提出以"税权撤回"为核心的自执行闭环机制——公民撤回税收授权，累积撤回量触发阈值后自动引发管理层更替或行会重组，以事实自裁量取代程序性审查作为正义基础。
AI.research_question: 如何基于《周礼》宪法秩序传统的"事实裁决"逻辑，而非西方程序正义传统，重新设计政府官僚治理的问责与纠错机制？
AI.motivation: 不同文明积累了不同的治理智力资源。西方蒂伯特模型虽成熟，但仅代表一种传统；《周礼》秩序提供了另一种宪法愿景——统治权威源于民众授权、统治者受契约约束、民众保留事实裁决权，这为治理设计提供了替代性逻辑。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《周礼》宪法秩序理论（三询、三宥制度所确立的合法性框架）、蒂伯特管辖权竞争模型（作为对照）、事实自裁决理论（以税基实物状态作为授权合法性的物理判定标准）
AI.method: 概念重构与制度设计方法：将《周礼》的治理逻辑映射到现代官僚治理框架，提出"专制撤回闭环"制度模型，包含动态调整的流动性阈值、自动触发机制、事后审查（宪政监督办公室）以及市场能力档案的抽签军事模块。
AI.findings: 撤回机制不依赖程序性审查防止滥用，而是依赖税基本身的物理自裁决：撤回若未影响行会税基则自然消退；若达到税基崩溃规模，这一事实本身即表明行会丧失民众授权。程序的功能从权利裁决转变为过渡管理。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"基于事实的裁决"（fact-based adjudication）替代"基于程序的裁决"（procedure-based adjudication）的治理逻辑，为治理理论提供了非西方文明传统的替代性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政府问责机制设计提供了可操作的自执行闭环模型：税权撤回机制、阈值触发更替、事后审查与危机军事模块，可作为公共治理制度创新的参考方案。

title: Climate-resilient Fiscal Policy: Integrating Climate Shocks Into Sovereign Budgeting, Debt Sustainability, and Public Investment Planning

detail.title: Climate-resilient Fiscal Policy: Integrating Climate Shocks Into Sovereign Budgeting, Debt Sustainability, and Public Investment Planning
detail.abstract: Climate change is reshaping sovereign fiscal landscapes by intensifying disaster‑related spending, eroding public revenues, and increasing long‑term investment needs for adaptation and resilient infrastructure. These shocks propagate through national budgets, debt dynamics, and public investment systems, creating structural vulnerabilities that traditional fiscal frameworks are not designed to manage. This report develops an integrated approach to climate‑resilient fiscal policy that embeds climate‑risk diagnostics into core fiscal institutions, including budgeting processes, debt‑sustainability analysis, and public investment management. Using empirical evidence and scenario‑based stress testing, it demonstrates how recurrent climate shocks can generate persistent deficits, raise sovereign risk premia, and accelerate debt accumulation—particularly in climate‑vulnerable economies. The report proposes a three‑pillar framework: climate‑informed fiscal rules, strengthened macro‑fiscal risk management, and strategic investment in resilience to reduce long‑term fiscal exposure. It concludes that integrating climate considerations into sovereign fiscal planning is essential for maintaining debt sustainability, protecting development gains, and enabling governments to transition from reactive crisis response to proactive resilience building.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将气候风险诊断嵌入主权财政制度（预算、债务可持续性分析、公共投资管理）的综合方法，通过实证和情景压力测试展示气候冲击如何导致持续赤字、主权风险溢价上升和债务加速积累，并构建"气候信息财政规则—强化宏观财政风险管理—韧性战略投资"三大支柱框架。
AI.research_question: 如何将气候风险系统性地整合到主权财政规划与制度中，以维持债务可持续性并减少长期财政风险敞口？
AI.motivation: 气候变化正通过加剧灾害相关支出、侵蚀公共收入、增加适应性和韧性基础设施的长期投资需求，重塑主权财政格局；传统财政框架无法管理这类结构性脆弱性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候韧性财政政策理论；财政制度经济学；主权债务可持续性分析框架；宏观财政风险管理理论。
AI.method: 实证分析与情景压力测试相结合，将气候风险诊断嵌入预算流程、债务可持续性分析（DSA）和公共投资管理（PIM）等核心财政制度中。
AI.findings: 反复的气候冲击可产生持续赤字、推高主权风险溢价并加速债务积累，尤其在气候脆弱经济体中更为显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出三支柱框架（气候信息财政规则、强化宏观财政风险管理、韧性战略投资），为气候韧性财政政策提供系统性理论框架，将气候因素从边缘考量提升为财政制度核心组成部分。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供将气候因素纳入主权财政规划的操作路径，帮助政府从被动危机响应转向主动韧性建设，维持债务可持续性并保护发展成果。

title:
Leverage is not Transmission
Operating Leverage, Shareholder Leverage, and the Path from Commodity Price to Equity Value in Precious Metals and Critical Minerals
affiliations: Independent

detail.title:
Leverage is not Transmission
Operating Leverage, Shareholder Leverage, and the Path from Commodity Price to Equity Value in Precious Metals and Critical Minerals

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal relationships that could have influenced or could reasonably be perceived to have influenced this research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required because this study uses publicly available corporate filings, market data, and other publicly available sources and does not involve human participants or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Commodity-price leverage is often treated as though it transmits directly from a metal price to a mining equity. This paper argues that it does not. Operating leverage measures the sensitivity of mine-level margin to metal prices, but shareholder value depends on additional transmission layers: share count, royalties, taxes, buybacks, capital allocation, undeveloped assets, acquisition outcomes, and policy or physical-market constraints. Using filing-based data across a 37-company universe of gold, silver, PGM, antimony, copper, nickel, and critical-mineral exposures, the paper separates three forms of leverage: operating leverage, shareholder leverage, and asset leverage. It then extends the framework beyond mine economics to physical-market scarcity, chokepoint assets, exploration optionality, and acquisition as a transmission pathway.

The results show why apparently similar commodity exposure can produce materially different equity outcomes. McEwen provides a limiting illustration: its Gold Bar operation has the highest operating leverage in the sample at 4.21×, while its annual margin per share is approximately $0.50 and its copper optionality is approximately $7.64 per share. Across twelve gold producers with both measures verified, operating leverage and margin per share have a Spearman rank correlation of −0.664 and a Pearson correlation of −0.472. The paper treats this as a descriptive result within the observed universe, not a universal population relationship or causal estimate; the direction survives individual-company deletion, while statistical significance is fragile when the extremes are removed.

A broader physical-market analysis finds that silver's persistent deficits have transmitted through inventories, lease rates, and borrowing conditions, but have not translated one-for-one into spot-price formation. Adversarial tests qualify rather than eliminate the framework: high-cost producers lose part of their relative operating edge as prices rise, but the advantage does not disappear except at extreme prices; the operating/shareholder distinction survives direct cross-sectional testing; and scarcity transmission is better described as overwhelmed at the price layer than blocked. The paper concludes that the relevant object of analysis is not leverage alone, but economic transmission: how a change in commodity conditions survives—or fails—at each layer between the physical market and what one shareholder ultimately owns.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"商品价格杠杆直接从金属价格传导至矿业股票"的传统假设，提出需要区分运营杠杆、股东杠杆和资产杠杆三种形式，并构建了"经济传导"框架来理解商品条件变化如何在物理市场与股东最终拥有价值之间的每一层（股份数、特许权使用费、税收、回购、资本配置、未开发资产、并购结果及政策约束）中生存或失效。基于37家覆盖黄金、白银、铂族金属、锑、铜、镍及关键矿产公司的样本，研究发现表面相似的商品敞口可产生截然不同的股票结果，并指出核心分析对象应是"经济传导"而非单纯的杠杆。
AI.research_question: 商品价格杠杆如何从金属价格传导至矿业股票价值？不同传导层如何影响最终的股东回报？
AI.motivation: 传统观点将商品价格杠杆视为从金属价格直接传导至矿业股票，但实际传导过程涉及多个中间层面（股份数、特许权使用费、税收、回购、资本配置等），单一杠杆概念无法充分解释矿业股权的差异化表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济传导框架（economic transmission），区分三种杠杆形式：运营杠杆（矿场利润率对金属价格敏感度）、股东杠杆（股东层面的传导）、资产杠杆（资产层面的传导），并延伸至物理市场稀缺性、咽喉点资产、勘探期权性和并购传导路径。
AI.method: 基于37家公司（覆盖黄金、白银、铂族金属、锑、铜、镍和关键矿产）的备案数据，分离三种杠杆形式，运用Spearman和Pearson相关性分析、个体公司删除敏感性检验、对抗性测试（高成本生产商、直接横截面测试、稀缺性传导检验）来验证框架。
AI.findings: （1）McEwen的Gold Bar矿运营杠杆高达4.21倍，但每股年利润率仅约0.50美元，铜期权价值约7.64美元/股，说明高运营杠杆不等于高股东回报；（2）12家黄金生产商中，运营杠杆与每股利润率呈负相关（Spearman rho=-0.664，Pearson r=-0.472）；（3）白银持续赤字已传导至库存、租赁利率和借贷条件，但未一对一转化为现货价格形成；（4）对抗性测试显示高成本生产商在价格上涨时失去部分相对运营优势但不会完全消失；运营/股东区分在直接横截面测试中成立；稀缺性传导在价格层面是被淹没而非被阻断。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"经济传导"分析框架替代单一的杠杆概念，将传导分解为多个层次，并系统区分运营杠杆、股东杠杆和资产杠杆三种形式，为矿业估值和商品-股权传导研究提供了更精细的理论透镜。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了区分表面相似但实际结果迥异的矿业股权的分析工具；揭示了高运营杠杆并不必然转化为高股东回报，帮助投资决策者识别真正具有经济传导效率的矿业资产；对商品市场参与者理解稀缺性如何（或不如何）传导至价格形成提供实证依据。

title: Base Rates and Autocorrelation-Robust Diagnostics for a Topological Regime Classifier: Reassessing Quasi-Experimental Designs under Overlapping Return Horizons and a Drifting Outcome

detail.title: Base Rates and Autocorrelation-Robust Diagnostics for a Topological Regime Classifier: Reassessing Quasi-Experimental Designs under Overlapping Return Horizons and a Drifting Outcome
detail.abstract:
The HYG GFC Wasserstein topological regime classifier introduced in Takagi (2026a) marks trading days on which HYG's daily H1 persistence diagram is close to a reference diagram computed from the 60-day window ending on the Global Financial Crisis S&P 500 nadir (2009-03-09). This paper subjects that classifier's reported conditional regularity to five quasi-experimental diagnostic designs: sequential confound adjustment, difference-in-differences, dose-response examination, Granger causality testing, and Transfer Entropy. Two methodological questions are treated throughout as first-order concerns.

The first concerns standard errors. The 20-day forward return used as the outcome variable is built from overlapping daily windows, inducing a lag-1 residual autocorrelation near 0.93 and a variance-inflation factor near 13, for which ordinary least squares does not account.

The second concerns the null hypothesis, and is logically prior to the first. The frequency of positive outcomes on classified days has conventionally been assessed against a 50% reference, including in Takagi (2026a). On the S&P 500 20-day forward return that is not the unconditional frequency: over this sample it is 66.7%, and the control-day frequency is 66.5% overall, 66.1% in-sample and 67.1% out-of-sample. Correcting the reference is not a change of standard error; it moves the point estimate.

This separates the statistics into two classes. In contrasts (the coefficient on the classifier dummy, the DiD interaction, any classified-versus-control comparison) the base rate enters both arms and cancels, so only the standard error is at issue. Levels (the conditional frequency of positive outcomes, the conditional mean) are assessed against an external reference, and the choice of reference determines the point estimate.

Among the level statistics, the reported conditional frequency of 77.4% is a lift of +10.9 percentage points over the applicable base rate rather than +27.4 over a coin flip (one-sided binomial p = 0.020, against 2.37e-7). By sub-period the lift is +4.3 points in-sample, not distinguishable from the base rate at conventional levels (p = 0.307), and +22.9 points out-of-sample (p = 0.004). Among the contrast statistics, the out-of-sample coefficient is significant at the 10% but not the 5% level under Newey-West standard errors across all six sequential specifications; the full-sample coefficients sit on the 5% boundary, and which side they appear to fall on is settled by the lag truncation (five of six specifications clear 0.05 at lag 19, two at lag 38, none at lag 50, with identical point estimates throughout). The difference-in-differences interaction is +0.245% with p = 0.820, and moved by an order of magnitude when one year of in-sample data was recovered at the start of the panel. Transfer Entropy is significant at lags 5 and 20 under the conventional i.i.d. shuffle test and in none of twelve configurations under a circular-shift surrogate that preserves the source series' own serial correlation. No result in any diagnostic family survives Bonferroni or Benjamini-Hochberg correction within that family.

The paper also documents and corrects a defect in the replication code underlying earlier versions, which imposed the 252-day warm-up twice and discarded the first year of valid classifier output, including the window containing the reference date. All figures use the corrected panel, which reproduces Takagi (2026a) cell for cell.

The paper does not conclude that the conditional regularity is spurious, nor that the classifier works. A sample of 84 classified days with this dependence structure does not adjudicate the question in either direction. The claim concerns the two specification errors and their magnitude. The findings are descriptive throughout and do not constitute a forecast, a causal claim, an investment recommendation, or a trading rule. Replication code reproducing every table and figure is released under the MIT License.

AI.tldr: 本文对Takagi (2026a)提出的HYG GFC Wasserstein拓扑制度分类器进行了严格的稳健性诊断测试。作者发现两个关键规范错误：(1)重叠日度窗口导致残差自相关严重，OLS标准误不可靠；(2)结果变量（S&P 500 20日前向收益）的正向无条件频率为66.7%而非50%，基准参考的错误设定影响了水平统计量的点估计。通过五种准实验诊断设计（序贯混淆调整、双重差分、剂量-反应、Granger因果、传递熵），作者发现大部分证据在正确的标准误和基准校正下大幅削弱，多数结果不通过多重检验校正。
AI.research_question: Takagi (2026a)报告的HYG GFC Wasserstein拓扑制度分类器的条件规律性在正确的推断方法（处理重叠窗口标准误和正确的零假设基准）下是否仍然成立？
AI.motivation: 原分类器声称在标记日20日前向收益为正的条件频率为77.4%，相对于50%基线有显著提升（p=2.37e-7）。但作者指出存在两个一阶方法论问题：(1)重叠窗口导致OLS标准误严重低估（自相关0.93，VIF约13）；(2)该样本中S&P 500无条件正向频率为66.7%而非50%，基准误设直接改变了水平统计量的点估计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文不构建新的理论框架，而是运用经典的计量经济学与统计推断理论：Newey-West异方差自相关一致（HAC）标准误、双重差分（DiD）识别策略、Granger因果检验、传递熵（Transfer Entropy）信息论框架、多重检验校正（Bonferroni和Benjamini-Hochberg）、圆形平移替代（circular-shift surrogate）假设检验。
AI.method: 五种准实验诊断设计：(1)序贯混淆调整（SEA）——六个嵌套设定；(2)双重差分；(3)剂量-反应检验；(4)Granger因果检验；(5)传递熵分析（含i.i.d.洗牌与圆形平移两种替代检验）。同时修正了复制代码中252天预热期被施加两次导致首年有效输出被丢弃的缺陷。
AI.findings: (1)样本外条件频率为77.4%，正确基准下的提升为+10.9个百分点（p=0.020）而非+27.4（p=2.37e-7）；样本内提升仅+4.3点（p=0.307，不显著），样本外+22.9点（p=0.004）。(2)样本外系数在Newey-West标准误下仅在10%水平显著（六个设定均如此）；全样本系数位于5%边界，取决于滞后截断选择（lag 19：5/6通过，lag 38：2/6，lag 50：无）。(3)DiD交互项+0.245%（p=0.820），且恢复一年样本内数据后量级变动了一个数量级。(4)传递熵仅在i.i.d.洗牌测试下于滞后5和20显著，在保留序列自相关的圆形平移替代检验下12个配置均不显著。(5)没有任何结果通过族内Bonferroni或BH校正。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文方法论贡献在于：(1)明确区分了对比统计量（contrasts）与水平统计量（levels）两类推断问题——在前者中基准率在两侧抵消，仅标准误成问题；在后者中基准选择直接决定点估计。(2)演示了当结果变量的无条件频率偏离0.5时，使用50%作为零假设基准会系统性夸大分类器条件规律性的显著性。(3)演示了重叠窗口数据导致的序列相关对推断结论的根本性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: (1)为评估金融分类器/择时信号提供了正确的推断协议——包括HAC标准误、正确基线校正、多重检验校正和多替代检验方法。(2)发布MIT许可的复制代码，修正了原始代码中的预热期重复施加缺陷。(3)提供了一个方法论模板：即使是看似显著的机器学习/拓扑信号，在严格的准实验诊断下其证据强度可能大幅下降。

title: All Rise: Introducing Legal Literacy as the Newest Member of the IEP Transition Team+

detail.title: All Rise: Introducing Legal Literacy as the Newest Member of the IEP Transition Team+
detail.abstract: In 2026, over seven million students with disabilities will receive special education services under the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act (IDEA). A substantial share of these students will work with their high schools toward the IDEA's promise of further education, employment, and independent living through a transition plan. However, the promise falls flat because, without legal literacy, students cannot meaningfully self-determine and self-advocate for the future they envision. Research indicates that students often lack awareness of their legal rights and are unprepared to manage these rights by the end of their transition plan. Schools then cite that unpreparedness as grounds for steering families toward legal guardianship, robbing students of the opportunity to autonomously manage their own rights as the IDEA intended. Legal literacy is the foundational step for self-advocacy and self-determination, allowing students to meaningfully make choices and participate in the transition process. This article argues that legal literacy should be added by amendment to the IDEA, so that the Act's promise can be realized by the students it was written to serve. Part I reviews the history of IDEA legislation and regulations regarding transition services. Part II defines legal literacy and exposes existing gaps in the transition process and in postsecondary outcomes. Part III proposes adding legal literacy to the IDEA's definition of transition services and reviews the outcomes it would produce. Part IV acknowledges and rebuts objections to the amendment about funding, resources, statute design, and federal overreach.

AI.tldr: 本文主张通过修订《残疾人教育法案》（IDEA），将法律素养（legal literacy）纳入过渡服务（transition services）的定义中，以帮助残疾学生实现自我决定和自我倡导，避免因缺乏法律知识而被学校引导至法定监护，从而真正实现IDEA所承诺的继续教育、就业和独立生活的目标。
AI.research_question: 如何通过将法律素养纳入《残疾人教育法案》（IDEA）的过渡服务，帮助残疾学生实现自我决定和自我倡导，并兑现该法案对残疾学生的承诺？
AI.motivation: 2026年将有超过七百名残疾学生接受IDEA下的特殊教育服务，但许多学生在过渡计划结束时缺乏法律权利意识，无法自我决定和自我倡导；学校以此为由引导家庭走向法定监护，剥夺了学生自主管理权利的机会，使IDEA的承诺落空。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自我决定理论、自我倡导理论、法律素养理论
AI.method: 规范分析/法律论证方法：回顾IDEA立法史和法规，定义法律素养，识别过渡过程和高等教育成果中的现有差距，提出立法修正建议，并回应关于资金、资源、法规设计和联邦越权的反对意见。
AI.findings: 法律素养是自我倡导和自我决定的基础性步骤，能使学生在过渡过程中有意义地做出选择和参与；将法律素养纳入IDEA过渡服务定义可以弥补现有差距并改善后中学教育成果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将法律素养概念引入IDEA过渡服务框架，为残疾学生的自我决定和自我倡导提供了法律层面的理论支撑，填补了过渡服务研究中关于法律权利意识的空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体的立法修正建议（将法律素养纳入IDEA过渡服务定义），并为可能面临的资金、资源、法规设计和联邦越权等反对意见提供应对策略。

title: The Integration Tax: A Practitioner's Framework for Technology Mergers and Acquisitions

detail.title: The Integration Tax: A Practitioner's Framework for Technology Mergers and Acquisitions
detail.abstract: Technology mergers and acquisitions (M&A) fail on execution far more often than on strategy. Decades of research-from KPMG's often-cited 1999 finding that 83% of mergers failed to boost shareholder returns, to Bain & Company's 2004 finding that roughly 70% of deals failed to increase shareholder value-point to the same conclusion: the deal is rarely the hard part. Most published guidance on post-merger integration (PMI) is organizational-governance charts, synergy trackers, cultural playbooks-and treats the underlying engineering work as a black box that "IT will handle." This paper opens that black box. Drawing on eighteen-plus years of experience building and operating systems in regulated, data-intensive environments, I present a staged, engineering-first framework for technology M&A integration: discovery and stack inventory, surviving-platform determination, schema convergence, legacy-to-target data migration, a three-gate data certification pipeline (QA → UAT → Production), parallel-track product development, cutover with explicit forward/backward sync rules, and legacy decommissioning. I introduce five practitioner constructs-Surviving Platform Determination (SPD), Schema Convergence Debt (SCD), the Dual-Run Window (DRW), Sync Directionality Risk (SDR), and the Integration Health Index (IHI)-that give engineering leaders a shared vocabulary for planning and reporting integration risk upward. A high-level treatment of call-center/CX platform integration is included, with a deeper best-practices treatment reserved for a follow-on paper. The goal is a framework a working engineering leader can actually apply on their next deal, not a slide template.

AI.tldr: 本文基于作者18年以上在受监管、数据密集型环境中建设和运营系统的经验，提出了一套以工程优先的技术并购（M&A）整合分阶段框架，涵盖从技术栈盘点、存活平台确定、模式收敛、数据迁移、三级数据认证管道、并行产品开发、切换及遗留系统退役的完整流程。论文引入了五个实践者概念：存活平台确定（SPD）、模式收敛债务（SCD）、双运行窗口（DRW）、同步方向风险（SDR）和整合健康指数（IHI），为工程领导者提供了规划和上报整合风险的共享词汇。
AI.research_question: 技术并购在执行环节远比战略环节更容易失败，那么如何构建一个以工程为核心、可直接应用于实际交易的并购后整合（PMI）框架？
AI.motivation: 现有关于并购后整合的公开指导大多聚焦于组织治理、协同跟踪和文化手册等组织层面问题，将底层工程工作视为"IT会处理的"黑箱。然而大量研究（如KPMG 83%的并购未能提升股东回报、Bain 70%的交易未能增加股东价值）表明并购失败主要在执行层面。本文旨在打开这一黑箱，提供工程领导者可实际应用的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文提出的概念框架包括：存活平台确定（SPD）、模式收敛债务（SCD）、双运行窗口（DRW）、同步方向风险（SDR）和整合健康指数（IHI）。这些概念共同构成了一个工程视角下的技术并购整合理论体系。
AI.method: 本文采用基于实践经验的框架构建方法，作者基于十八年以上在受监管、数据密集型环境中建设和运营系统的亲身经验，提炼出分阶段的技术并购整合框架，并引入五个原创性的实践者概念。
AI.findings: 论文提出了一个八阶段的工程优先技术并购整合框架：发现与栈盘点、存活平台确定、模式收敛、遗留到目标数据迁移、三级数据认证管道（QA→UAT→生产）、并行产品开发、带明确前向/后向同步规则的切换，以及遗留系统退役。同时引入了五个实践者概念，并为呼叫中心/CX平台整合提供了高层次的处理方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次将并购后整合的焦点从组织层面转向工程执行层面，提出了五个原创性的实践者概念（SPD、SCD、DRW、SDR、IHI），为工程领导者建立了一个规划和上报整合风险的共享词汇，填补了PMI文献中工程执行维度的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文提供了一个工程领导者可以在下一次并购交易中实际应用的框架，而非仅停留在幻灯片模板层面。该框架包含可操作的阶段划分、明确的数据认证管道和切换规则，以及用于风险评估和上报的整合健康指数（IHI），并展望了呼叫中心/CX平台整合的深度最佳实践。

title: PyXtabond2 User Manual : Dynamic Panel GMM Estimation in Python
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: PyXtabond2 User Manual : Dynamic Panel GMM Estimation in Python
