This modular organizational form evolved gradually from medieval ecclesiastical corporations and chartered trading companies into the modern public corporation through the emergence of increasingly abstract and general legal rules of incorporation. The paper concludes that stakeholder and managerial theories ultimately rest on epistemic assumptions incompatible with a world of uncertainty and decentralized learning. The shareholder-owned corporation, embedded in external capital markets and disciplined by transferable ownership claims, evolved precisely because it is an effective institutional response to complexity, experimentation, and economic change.

AI.tldr: 本文论证Hansmann-Kraakman的公司概念（法律人格、资产分割、可转让股份、委托管理、投资者所有）与法律制度主义相容，并将公司重新概念化为一种模块化法律架构，通过封装和信息隐藏来应对复杂性。
AI.research_question: 公司是否可以被股东所有？Hansmann-Kraakman的公司概念与法律制度主义是否相容，以及哪种公司概念能更好地解释公司的经济角色？
AI.motivation: 法律制度主义者正确地强调公司由法律构成而非仅由私人契约构成，但许多人错误地得出结论认为股东不拥有公司，公司本身也不能成为所有权的对象。作者试图纠正这一错误认识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律制度主义、Hansmann-Kraakman公司理论、模块化系统理论、信息隐藏与封装理论、复杂性与知识分工理论
AI.method: 理论分析与概念重构，结合公司法律制度的历史演进分析（从中世纪教会公司到特许贸易公司再到现代公众公司）
AI.findings: 公司作为模块化法律架构，通过资产分割和组织边界定义创建受保护的模块，使丰富、复杂且难以定价的互动得以发生；公司法是一套抽象的设计规则，减少大规模合作的认知负担；股东所有的公司在外部资本市场中受可转让所有权约束，是应对复杂性、实验和经济变化的有效制度回应。
AI.theory_contributions: 调和了法律制度主义与Hansmann-Kraakman公司理论，提出公司作为模块化法律架构的新概念框架，将公司法的经济角色理解为设计规则以应对复杂性和知识分工。
AI.practical_contributions: 为股东所有权的正当性提供认识论基础，反驳利益相关者和管理层理论，说明股东所有的公司制度在应对不确定性和分散学习方面的制度优势。

title: The Two Yardsticks: Heterogeneous Valuation and the Generalized Product Frontier

detail.title: The Two Yardsticks: Heterogeneous Valuation and the Generalized Product Frontier
detail.abstract: The product theorem says that under relative-gains preferences a settlement both parties prefer to conflict exists if and only if λ_R·λ_U ≤ 1, and its proof chains one party’s acceptance condition into the other’s — a step valid only when both parties measure the stake with the same index. This paper characterizes feasibility when they do not: each party i evaluates every share through its own increasing index v_i. Four results follow. First, the feasibility frontier in weight space is an exactly characterized decreasing curve λ_U = Φ(λ_R), computable from the two indices and the conflict values, which reduces to the hyperbola λ_U = 1/λ_R under a common index; verified against an oracle on 2,973 randomized heterogeneous instances with no disagreement. Second, the product theorem survives in generalized form: feasibility holds if and only if λ_R·λ_U ≤ Δ(x*), where Δ is a cross-valuation distortion — a ratio of the two parties’ exchange rates between own gain and rival gain — evaluated at the marginal acceptance point; Δ ≡ 1 exactly when the indices agree up to positive affine transformation on the relevant range. Third, a pivot theorem: when the conflict positions are symmetric, the point (1,1) lies on the frontier for every pair of indices whatever — heterogeneity rotates the frontier around the common-index pivot rather than shifting it — while under asymmetric conflict positions the threshold moves in both directions, rising when valuations are complementary (each party relatively prizes what it receives) and falling when they are rivalrous, with degradation linear in the divergence of the indices. Fourth, a measurement result that converts the elicitation protocol’s principal contamination into information: the product of willingness-to-pay answers elicited at the conflict allocation equals the true product times a local version of Δ, and in 2,932 randomized heterogeneous instances the elicited product predicted feasibility correctly 96.6 per cent of the time against 90.6 per cent for the true product. The distortion that curvature inflicts on the measurement points, on average, in the direction of the truth, because it partially encodes the yardstick divergence that actually governs feasibility. We close with the reading the series requires: memory policy is yardstick policy, and mutual sacralization of the same object is the configuration that lowers the threshold below one.

AI.tldr: 本文在"相对收益偏好"博弈论框架下，研究了当双方使用不同测度指数（index）评估利益时，冲突与和解的可行性边界。研究发现：可行性边界在权重空间中是一条精确刻画的递减曲线λ_U=Φ(λ_R)；乘积定理以广义形式成立（λ_R·λ_U≤Δ(x*)）；对称冲突位置下(1,1)点始终位于边界上（异质性只旋转不移动边界）；并对测量协议中的污染进行了信息转化，通过2,932个随机实例验证了预测准确率达96.6%。
AI.research_question: 当谈判双方使用不同的递增测度指数（v_i）评估各自份额时，在相对收益偏好下冲突前和解的可行性条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 经典的乘积定理（product theorem）假设双方使用相同的利益测度指数来衡量得失，但现实中双方往往使用不同标准（yardstick）评估同一标的。该研究旨在突破这一假设限制，刻画异质性指数下可行性边界的完整特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于相对收益偏好（relative-gains preferences）的博弈论框架，结合乘积定理、可行性边界理论、跨估值扭曲（cross-valuation distortion）概念，以及正仿射变换等价性分析。
AI.method: 理论推导与数值验证相结合：精确刻画可行性边界函数Φ；构建广义乘积定理；利用2,973个随机异质性实例通过oracle验证；在2,932个随机实例中比较elicited product与true product的可行性预测准确率。
AI.findings: (1) 可行性边界是精确刻画的递减曲线λ_U=Φ(λ_R)，共同指数下退化为双曲线λ_U=1/λ_R；(2) 乘积定理以广义形式成立λ_R·λ_U≤Δ(x*)，Δ为跨估值扭曲；(3) 对称冲突位置下(1,1)点为固定枢轴，不对称下阈值双向移动（互补估价上升、竞争估价下降）；(4) 测量的elicited product包含真实乘积与局部Δ之积，预测准确率96.6%对90.6%。
AI.theory_contributions: 将乘积定理从同质指数推广至异质指数的一般情形；揭示"记忆政策即测度标准政策"的理论命题；证明了异质性对可行性边界的影响是旋转而非平移（对称情形下的枢轴定理）；建立了跨估值扭曲Δ作为统一的可行性修正因子。
AI.practical_contributions: 为谈判与冲突解决提供可操作的可行性判据（λ_R·λ_U≤Δ(x*)）；纠正了传统启发协议中测量污染的方向性偏差，表明该偏差平均而言指向真相；提出了"对同一对象的相互神圣化可降低冲突阈值至1以下"的政策洞见。

title:
The FTX-Alameda Research Fraud: Anatomy of an $8.9 Billion Collapse 
A Comprehensive Analysis of Corporate Structure, Fraud Mechanics, Regulatory Failure, and Legislative Aftermath
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
The FTX-Alameda Research Fraud: Anatomy of an $8.9 Billion Collapse 
A Comprehensive Analysis of Corporate Structure, Fraud Mechanics, Regulatory Failure, and Legislative Aftermath

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is based on publicly available documents and did not involve human participants
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: This paper presents a forensic analysis of the FTX Trading Ltd. and Alameda Re- search fraud, the largest cryptocurrency fraud in history, resulting in an $8.9 billion shortfall in customer deposits. Drawing upon court filings, SEC and CFTC com- plaints, bankruptcy examiner reports, and trial testimony, this study examines the corporate architecture that enabled systematic misappropriation of customer funds through a coded backdoor (allow_negative), fabricated balance sheets, and circu- lar collateralisation of the proprietary FTT token. The paper analyses the catalytic role of the CoinDesk exposé and Binance CEO Changpeng Zhao’s divestiture an- nouncement in precipitating a $6 billion bank run, evaluates why regulatory frame- works and investor due diligence failed to detect the fraud, and assesses the legal outcomes including Sam Bankman-Fried’s 25-year prison sentence and the evolv- ing legislative response encompassing the EU’s MiCA regulation and proposed U.S. legislation. The analysis concludes that the FTX collapse represents classical embezzlement enabled by regulatory arbitrage, absent corporate governance, and the deliberate cultivation of political and reputational capital.

AI.tldr: 本文对FTX和Alameda Research欺诈案进行了法证分析，这是历史上最大的加密货币欺诈案，导致89亿美元客户存款缺口。研究揭示了通过编码后门（allow_negative）、伪造资产负债表和FTT代币循环抵押构建的企业架构如何实现系统性客户资金挪用。
AI.research_question: FTX交易有限公司和Alameda Research欺诈案的企业架构、触发机制、监管失灵原因及法律后果是什么？
AI.motivation: FTX崩溃是历史上最大的加密货币欺诈案，造成89亿美元客户存款缺口，研究其运作机制对理解加密货币市场监管漏洞和公司治理失败具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典贪污（classical embezzlement）、监管套利（regulatory arbitrage）、公司治理理论、政治与声誉资本理论
AI.method: 法证分析方法，基于法庭文件、SEC和CFTC投诉、破产审查员报告及庭审证词等多源证据进行定性案例分析。
AI.findings: FTX通过allow_negative编码后门实现客户资金挪用，使用伪造资产负债表和FTT代币循环抵押掩盖欺诈；CoinDesk曝光和赵长鹏宣布减持引发60亿美元挤兑；监管框架和投资者尽职调查均未能发现欺诈；SBF被判25年监禁；欧盟MiCA法规和美国立法正在演进。
AI.theory_contributions: 将FTX崩溃定性为监管套利和缺乏公司治理所促成的经典贪污案例，揭示了加密货币领域政治与声誉资本在掩盖欺诈中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加密货币市场监管改革提供实证依据，有助于改进监管框架设计和投资者尽职调查方法，为MiCA等立法演进提供参考。

title: Funding Strategic Asset Accumulation: A Post-Keynesian Stock–Flow Theory
affiliations: Hanyang University

detail.title: Funding Strategic Asset Accumulation: A Post-Keynesian Stock–Flow Theory

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This theoretical study involved no human participants or animals.
declarations.funderStatement: The author received no specific funding for this work.

detail.abstract: Strategic asset-stock theory explains how investment flows build hard-to-imitate productive stocks. We use Post-Keynesian economics (PKE) to explain which planned flows remain funded through time. Under fundamental uncertainty, banks can create credit, but liquidity preference and shared financial conventions shape its allocation and renewal. A convention change can redirect unchanged aggregate new bank lending before firm-specific technical evidence changes. Accumulation–funding fit describes the ex ante correspondence between an asset path’s timing needs and its funding terms. Committed-horizon coverage, payment rigidity, and refinancing exposure determine which paths are interrupted. Dierickx and Cool’s accumulation properties explain why resulting stock gaps can persist after funding returns. The theory identifies a monetary source of strategic-asset differences that can support advantage when value and rent conditions hold.

AI.tldr: 本文整合了战略资产存量理论与后凯恩斯主义经济学，提出"积累-融资匹配"（accumulation-funding fit）概念，解释融资流如何通过时间维度影响企业战略资产的构建与中断，从而揭示了战略资产差异的货币性来源。
AI.research_question: 在根本不确定性条件下，银行信贷的配置与展期如何影响企业战略资产的积累过程，以及融资中断如何导致难以模仿的资产存量差距持续存在？
AI.motivation: 战略资产存量理论解释了投资流如何构建难以模仿的生产性存量，但未充分解释哪些计划中的投资流能在时间推移中持续获得融资支持。本文引入后凯恩斯主义经济学以填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略资产存量理论（Dierickx & Cool）、后凯恩斯主义经济学（PKE）、根本不确定性、流动性偏好、金融惯例（conventions）、积累-融资匹配
AI.method: 理论整合与概念建构——将后凯恩斯主义货币与融资理论融入战略资产存量理论框架，提出新的理论构念（积累-融资匹配）并进行逻辑推演。
AI.findings: 金融惯例的转变可以在企业特定技术证据变化之前，就重新引导总量不变的新银行信贷的配置方向；资产路径的时间需求与融资条款之间的匹配程度（承诺期限覆盖、支付刚性、再融资敞口）决定了哪些资产积累路径会被中断；且由于积累的性质，融资恢复后存量差距仍可能持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 将货币融资因素引入战略管理理论，识别了战略资产差异的货币性来源；在资金供给层面解释了战略资源异质性的成因，补充了仅关注投资流本身的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了融资条件与战略资产积累路径匹配的诊断工具，有助于识别和规避融资中断风险，理解企业竞争优势的货币性前提条件。

title: Calling off the Dogs: Enforcement Threat and the 2025 Presidential Inaugural Fund

detail.title: Calling off the Dogs: Enforcement Threat and the 2025 Presidential Inaugural Fund
detail.abstract: The theory of rent extraction (McChesney 1987), that politicians profit by threatening harm and selling forbearance, has gone largely untested for four decades because the transaction is typically invisible. However, the 2025 presidential inaugural fund supplied a clean record of the payments: corporate donations, publicly disclosed, collected while an incoming administration's threats were live and its favors were still promises. In a sample of 665 firms coded for threat status using only pre-inauguration information, firms facing active federal enforcement donated at 38.6 percent against a 14.3 percent base rate, while firms in industries the administration had promised to help, and firms facing only industry-wide harm, donated like everyone else. Within sectors, enforcement threat raises the probability of donating by 30.6 percentage points, an estimate that survives seven logged re-estimations and a firm-size control. The evidence that payment bought better case outcomes is suggestive but underpowered. Payment followed jeopardy, not hope: the pattern protection predicts, and the opposite of what favor-buying would predict here.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2025年总统就职基金的企业捐款公开记录，测试了McChesney（1987）提出的"租金榨取"理论——即政客通过威胁伤害企业来出售"不作为"以获利。通过对665家企业的分析发现，面临联邦执法威胁的企业捐款率显著更高（38.6% vs 基准14.3%），而面临行业性伤害或获得政府承诺帮助的企业并无异常捐款行为。控制行业和规模等因素后，执法威胁将捐款概率提高了30.6个百分点。该证据表明企业捐款是出于规避伤害（"恐惧驱动"），而非购买好处（"希望驱动"）。
AI.research_question: 政客是否通过威胁伤害企业来谋取租金（即"榨取性捐款"）？具体而言，面临联邦执法威胁的企业是否更可能向新政府捐款以购买"不伤害"的承诺？
AI.motivation: 租金榨取理论提出四十年来因交易过程不可见而几乎未被实证检验。2025年总统就职基金提供了一个独特的数据窗口：企业捐款公开披露，且发生在新政府威胁仍然有效、承诺尚未兑现的时刻，使得该理论首次可被直接检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 租金榨取理论（Rent Extraction Theory, McChesney 1987）：政客通过制造威胁（如执法行动）来榨取企业租金，企业支付款项以购买"免于伤害"的宽容。
AI.method: 利用2025年总统就职基金的企业捐款公开记录，对665家企业按照就职前的信息编码威胁状态（是否面临活跃的联邦执法）。采用逻辑回归分析，控制行业和公司规模，并进行七次对数重估（logged re-estimations）进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）面临联邦执法威胁的企业捐款率为38.6%，远高于14.3%的基准率；（2）获得政府承诺帮助的企业以及面临行业性伤害的企业捐款率与其他人无异；（3）在行业内部，执法威胁将捐款概率提高30.6个百分点，该估计在多次稳健性检验后依然显著；（4）关于捐款能否改善执法结果的证据虽有暗示性但统计功效不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为租金榨取理论提供了直接的实证证据，验证了McChesney（1987）的核心命题：企业付款是对威胁的回应（规避伤害），而非对好处的追求。通过区分"恐惧驱动"与"希望驱动"的捐款动机，为政治捐款理论提供了新的实证区分维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了执法威胁与企业政治捐款之间的系统关联，为政策制定者监督政企关系、评估执法程序公正性以及规范政治献金制度提供了实证基础。

title: Nowhere Else to Put It: Institutional Distrust, Constrained Investment Choice, and Empty Housing in Emerging Asia
affiliations: Saki Partners

detail.title: Nowhere Else to Put It: Institutional Distrust, Constrained Investment Choice, and Empty Housing in Emerging Asia
detail.abstract: This paper asks why household and elite savings across emerging Asia flow so overwhelmingly into residential real estate, and why so much of that real estate is deliberately left empty. It argues that this concentration is not primarily a matter of cultural preference but of constrained choice under institutional distrust. Working through the hierarchy of stores of value available to an ordinary saver, it shows how each rung has been compromised: bank deposits by negative real returns and by catastrophic failure, epitomised by the collapse of Saigon Commercial Bank; equity and corporate-bond markets by manipulation, weak enforcement and extreme concentration in a single family conglomerate; and the physical hedges of gold and diamonds by counterfeiting, state-monopoly embezzlement, certification fraud and the price-collapsing rise of laboratory-grown stones. With trusted alternatives eliminated, real estate becomes the residual asset by default, attracting both legitimate savings and the darker pools of corruption and tax evasion, for which vacancy is a feature rather than a cost. The paper traces how this capital is parked in empty units, trapped by resale restrictions and title limbo, and exported to destination markets such as Australia, before documenting the resulting bubble risk and setting out five recommendations for policymakers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了新兴亚洲家庭和精英储蓄为何大量涌入住宅房地产，且大量房产被刻意空置。作者认为这主要不是文化偏好，而是在制度不信任下的约束性选择。通过逐层分析可用的价值储存工具（银行存款、股票/债券市场、黄金钻石等实物对冲），作者展示了每一层级如何被侵蚀，最终使房地产成为"默认的剩余资产"，并分析了空置作为腐败和逃税特征的现象、资本流向、泡沫风险及政策建议。
AI.research_question: 为什么新兴亚洲的家庭和精英储蓄如此大量地流入住宅房地产？为什么其中大量房产被刻意空置？
AI.motivation: 传统上这类现象常被归因于文化偏好，但作者认为这无法解释空置现象，需要从制度信任和约束选择的角度重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值储存层级理论（hierarchy of stores of value）、制度信任/制度不信任理论、约束性选择理论
AI.method: 概念性/论证性分析：通过系统性检视储蓄者可选的各种价值储存工具的失效机制，结合案例（如西贡商业银行倒闭）进行推理论证。
AI.findings: 1) 银行存款因负实际回报和银行倒闭危机而受损；2) 股票和公司债市场因操纵、执法薄弱和单一财团集中而不可靠；3) 黄金和钻石等实物对冲因造假、国有垄断挪用、认证欺诈和培育钻石价格崩跌而失效；4) 房地产成为被信任的替代选项消除后的"默认剩余资产"；5) 空置是腐败和逃税资金的特征而非成本；6) 这些资金被困于转售限制和产权悬置状态，并流向澳大利亚等目的地市场；7) 存在泡沫风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 将新兴亚洲的房地产储蓄集中和空置现象从"文化偏好"重新框定为"制度不信任下的约束性选择"，丰富了关于资产配置与制度环境关系的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出五项政策建议，为政策制定者应对房地产泡沫风险和资本错配提供参考。

title: Measuring Spite: Invariance, Elicitation, and What Survives Curvature

detail.title: Measuring Spite: Invariance, Elicitation, and What Survives Curvature
detail.abstract: Every result in this series turns on a matrix of relative-gains weights that has never been measured. This paper shows that it can be, and states precisely how much of it survives the standard objection that utility is not linear in payoffs. The instrument is one question: how much of your own payoff would you give up to prevent a gain of one unit to that person. Under a common payoff index v, the weight this recovers at profile x is not λ_ij but λ_ij·v′(x_j)/v′(x_i), so the elicited matrix is a positive diagonal similarity transform of the true one. The consequence is a sharp identification result. Λ is identified exactly up to positive diagonal similarity and no further, so a function of Λ is recoverable by an experimenter ignorant of v if and only if it is invariant under that transformation. What is invariant turns out to be exactly the part of the theory that decides whether peace is possible: every directed-cycle product, hence the bilateral product λ_R·λ_U; the spectrum, hence the spectral radius; and the zero pattern, hence which parties are resented by nobody. What is not invariant is the row sum — the attention budget on which the social-preference results rest — which is recovered only under linearity or at an equal-payoff profile. The paper proves the invariance, reports 14,376 numerical tests against twelve payoff indices confirming that the feasibility threshold does not move, identifies the two hypotheses that do bind (continuity and a common index), quantifies the finite-stake bias and removes it by extrapolation from two stake sizes, and sets out the resulting protocol, including a column-wise screening procedure that makes the unresented-party criterion operational and a synthetic-validity study that fixes the estimator, the grid and the equivalence margin the protocol should pre-register. It closes by restating what each prior result in the series predicts once the parameter is observed rather than assumed.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了一个从未被测量的相对收益权重矩阵可以通过一个简单问题被识别，并明确了在效用非线性于收益的标准反对意见下，该矩阵有多少可以被恢复。核心发现是：通过"你愿意放弃多少自己的收益来阻止他人获得一单位收益"这一问题，实验者可以恢复真实权重矩阵的正对角相似变换，且只能恢复到这一步。论文证明了哪些理论结果是该变换下不变的（有向环乘积、谱、零模式），哪些不是（行和），并通过14,376次数值测试、有限风险偏差修正和协议设计，给出了完整的测量方案。
AI.research_question: 相对收益权重矩阵Λ能否被测量？在效用非线性于收益的约束下，实验者能在多大程度上恢复该矩阵？哪些基于Λ的理论预测是可识别的？
AI.motivation: 该系列所有结果都依赖于一个从未被实际测量的相对收益权重矩阵Λ，且面临"效用不是收益的线性函数"这一标准反对意见。需要解决这个测量缺口，确定哪些理论结论在参数被观测而非假设时仍然成立。
AI.theoretical_framework: 相对收益权重理论、正对角相似变换、矩阵谱理论、显示偏好识别理论
AI.method: 理论证明（不变性定理）、14,376次数值模拟（跨12种收益指数）、有限风险偏差量化与两档风险外推消除、列式筛选程序、合成有效性研究（确定估计器、网格和等价边际）
AI.findings: (1) 通过单问题即可恢复Λ的正对角相似变换；(2) 有向环乘积（包括双边乘积λ_R·λ_U）、谱、谱半径、零模式（谁不被怨恨）均为变换下不变，可识别；(3) 行和（注意力预算）不可识别，仅在线性性或等收益剖面下可恢复；(4) 14,376次数值测试确认可行性阈值在12种收益指数下不变；(5) 两个关键假设是连续性和共同收益指数；(6) 有限风险偏差可量化并通过外推消除。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了相对收益权重矩阵Λ的精确可识别性边界（正对角相似变换内完全识别，之外不可识别），区分了理论中可观测与不可观测的部分，将"和平是否可能"的判定（有向环乘积、谱、零模式）与依赖注意力预算的结果（行和）进行了严格的识别性划分。
AI.practical_contributions: 给出了可操作的测量协议：单问题测量工具、两档风险外推偏差消除法、列式筛选程序使"无怨恨方"标准可操作化、合成有效性研究以预设估计器、网格和等价边际，为实验者提供了完整的预注册方案。

title: Where Did the Gold Go? Bolivia's Mining, Mercury, Law, and Forecasts

detail.title: Where Did the Gold Go? Bolivia's Mining, Mercury, Law, and Forecasts

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, identifiable personal data, animals, clinical interventions, or the collection of primary data requiring ethical approval. The research relies exclusively on publicly available and/or secondary data. Therefore, institutional ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The research was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Bolivia’s recorded gold exports collapsed after 2023 while gold prices rose and the Banco Central de Bolivia (BCB) developed a domestic purchasing and export-administration channel. This paper separates extraction, commercialization, regulation, pollution, and prediction using 413 monthly gold-export observations (1992–May 2026), a 3,496-observation mineral panel, 80 interrupted-time-series specifications, temporal placebos, automatic break searches, two independent pre-policy counterfactuals, negative-control outcomes, local projections, orthogonal machine learning, regime models, and strict rolling-origin forecasting. All 80 policy-sequence specifications produce a negative post-level coefficient, and the two counterfactual models place observed post-policy exports near 30% of conditional counterfactual levels. Yet temporal randomization gives 𝑝 ≈ 0.059, the globally preferred one-break date is 2012, and the 2023 intervention is a compound sequence rather than an isolated treatment. A non-gold production negative control does not reproduce a comparable collapse. The legal analysis adds DS 5076 and the June–July 2026 BCB rules that tie export certification and quotas to the domestic BCB channel; because these rules post-date the outcome sample, they create a genuine distribution shift for forecasts. The environmental analysis maps sixteen distinct pathways spanning elemental-mercury vapor, methylmercury, fish and human biomonitoring, sediment, turbidity, channel change, forests, biodiversity, occupational exposure, and broader mine-waste risks. The strongest conclusion is therefore a change in the recorded gold commercialization regime, not a proven collapse of extraction and not a quantified national pollution dose-response.

AI.tldr: 本文利用413个月度黄金出口观测、3,496条矿产品面板数据和80个中断时间序列设定，严格检验2023年后玻利维亚黄金出口骤降是否源于真正的开采崩溃。结果显示，2023年干预是一种“复合政策序列”而非单一处理，所有政策序列设定均产生负向系数，观察到的政策后出口约为反事实水平的30%，但时间随机化检验p≈0.059未达严格显著，全局最优断点日期为2012年。作者认为最可靠的结论是“记录中的黄金商业化体制发生变化”，而非开采崩溃或量化环境污染剂量-反应关系的证实。
AI.research_question: 2023年后玻利维亚黄金出口骤降（伴随金价上涨和央行建立国内购买与出口管理渠道）究竟反映了什么？是开采崩溃、商业化体制变化，还是监管/统计口径变化？
AI.motivation: 玻利维亚在2023年后出现黄金出口记录骤降与金价上涨并存的异常现象，同时央行（BCB）建立了国内购买和出口管理渠道。需要区分开采、商业化、监管、污染与预测等多个维度，以严谨的因果推断方法识别这一现象的本质。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中断时间序列设计（interrupted time-series）；反事实因果推断；复合政策处理（compound treatment）分析；负对照结果（negative-control outcomes）；制度/体制变迁理论（commercialization regime change）。
AI.method: 使用413个月度黄金出口观测（1992–2026年5月）、3,496条矿产品面板数据；80个中断时间序列设定；时间安慰剂检验；自动断点搜索；两个独立的政策前反事实模型；负对照结果；局部投影法；正交机器学习；体制模型；严格滚动来源预测。并结合DS 5076法令及2026年6-7月BCB规则的法定分析和16条环境污染路径图谱。
AI.findings: （1）所有80个政策序列设定均产生负向的政策后水平系数；（2）两个反事实模型显示，观测的政策后出口约为条件反事实水平的30%；（3）但时间随机化检验p≈0.059，仅在边缘显著；（4）全局最优单断点日期为2012年而非2023年；（5）2023年干预是复合政策序列而非孤立处理；（6）非黄金生产的负对照未再现类似崩塌；（7）2026年6-7月BCB新规在结局样本之后，构成真实的预测分布偏移。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）展示了如何严格区分“开采变化”与“商业化/记录体制变化”——当单一处理假设不成立时（复合政策序列），应避免过度归因；（2）证明了即使时间随机化p值不显著（p≈0.059），结合多重证据（负对照、双反事实、全设定一致性）仍可支持体制/记录变迁的结论；（3）将政策后出台（post-outcome）的法规引入预测语境，提出“真实分布偏移”的概念区分。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为玻利维亚央行黄金购买和出口管理政策的效果评估提供了严谨的方法论框架；（2）澄清“出口骤降”更可能源于商业化/记录体制变迁而非开采崩溃，避免政策误判；（3）系统梳理了16条黄金开采污染路径（汞蒸气、甲基汞、鱼类和人体生物监测、沉积物、浊度、河道变化、森林、生物多样性、职业暴露、尾矿风险），为环境监管提供路径图谱；（4）预测层面提示2026年新规将构成真实分布偏移，影响未来出口预测。

title: Under the Radar: How Predatory Policing Distorts the Reporting of Violence against Women
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley and

detail.title: Under the Radar: How Predatory Policing Distorts the Reporting of Violence against Women
detail.abstract: A fundamental component of citizenship includes seeking protection from crime and violence. How do citizens make such claims to law enforcement when the police themselves are often predatory? The core argument is that police predation (1) discourages citizens from reporting crimes directly to the police while (2) shifting reporting towards intermediated channels. We argue that trust is the mechanism driving this reporting behavior. To test our theory, we focus on the reporting of violence against women (VAW) in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. We build an original database of reports to the police and to an intermediary (an independent hotline), then conduct descriptive and causal tests to show that exposure to police violence redirects reporting from the police to the intermediated hotline. Together, these findings bring together the claim-making and policing literatures to demonstrate that police violence incentivizes citizens to report VAW to alternative channels and, in their absence, to stay silent.

AI.tldr: 本文研究警察掠夺行为如何影响公民报案行为。核心发现是，警察暴行（1）降低公民直接向警方报案的可能性，（2）促使公民转向中介渠道（如独立热线）报案。信任是驱动这一行为的机制。作者基于巴西里约热内卢针对妇女暴力（VAW）的报案数据，通过描述性与因果检验证明，暴露于警察暴力会将报案从警方转向中介热线；若无中介渠道，公民则选择沉默。
AI.research_question: 当警察本身具有掠夺性时，公民如何向执法机关提出保护诉求（报案）？
AI.motivation: 公民权的基本组成部分包括寻求免受犯罪与暴力的保护，但现有文献对警察掠夺行为如何影响公民报案行为缺乏系统研究，特别是在警察自身不可信的情境下公民的诉求表达机制尚不清晰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合"诉求提出"（claim-making）文献与"警务"（policing）文献，以信任为核心机制构建理论框架，论证警察掠夺行为通过侵蚀公民对警察的信任，改变公民的报案渠道选择。
AI.method: 构建原始数据库，收录向警方和独立中介热线（中间机构）报案的数据；运用描述性统计与因果检验方法，分析警察暴力暴露对报案渠道选择的影响。
AI.findings: 警察暴力暴露会促使公民将针对妇女暴力的报案从警方渠道转向中介热线；若缺乏此类中介渠道，公民则倾向于保持沉默。
AI.theory_contributions: 将诉求提出文献与警务文献进行整合，理论贡献在于阐明警察暴力如何通过信任机制重塑公民的报案行为与渠道选择，拓展了对国家-公民互动中暴力与诉求关系的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果对执法改革与受害者支持机制设计具有实践意义，提示政策制定者需重视独立中介报案渠道在警察公信力不足情境下的关键作用，以及缺乏替代渠道时受害者的"沉默"风险。

title: Determinants of Inclusive Development in Africa – Machine Learning Perspective
affiliations: University of Johannesburg, University of Johannesburg, University of Johannesburg and University of Johannesburg

detail.title: Determinants of Inclusive Development in Africa – Machine Learning Perspective
detail.abstract: Across African countries, inclusive development remains limited by persistent inequalities in access to opportunities, services, and economic participation. This study examines the determinants of inclusive development using the Inequality-Adjusted Human Development Index (IHDI) for 41 countries between 2008 and 2020. Leveraging machine learning–based regularisation techniques, we systematically evaluate a broad set of 48 potential drivers, including economic structure, governance, globalization, energy, and social variables. The analysis identifies skills, governance quality, employment, health, and access to clean energy and digital technologies as the most robust predictors of inclusive development. These findings highlight the structural and institutional conditions most strongly associated with broad-based human development, offering evidence-based guidance for policies aimed at reducing exclusion and promoting equitable growth in Africa.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2008-2020年41个非洲国家的数据，通过基于机器学习的正则化技术，系统评估48个潜在驱动因素对包容性发展（以不平等调整人类发展指数IHDI衡量）的影响，识别出技能、治理质量、就业、健康、清洁能源和数字技术获取是最稳健的预测因素。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素决定了非洲国家的包容性发展？具体而言，在48个潜在驱动因素中，哪些是包容性发展（以IHDI衡量）的最稳健预测因子？
AI.motivation: 非洲国家在获取机会、服务和参与经济活动方面存在持续不平等，严重制约了包容性发展。然而，目前缺乏对包容性发展决定因素的系统性、全面性评估，需要识别关键的驱动因素以指导政策制定。
AI.theoretical_framework: 包容性发展理论框架，涵盖经济结构、治理、全球化、能源和社会等多维度因素对不平等调整后人类发展的影响。
AI.method: 使用不平等调整人类发展指数（IHDI）作为因变量，基于2008-2020年41个非洲国家的面板数据，采用机器学习正则化技术（如LASSO等），对48个潜在驱动因素进行系统评估。
AI.findings: 技能、治理质量、就业、健康、清洁能源获取和数字技术获取被识别为包容性发展最稳健的预测因素，揭示了与广泛基础的人类发展最密切相关的结构和制度条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过机器学习方法对非洲包容性发展的多维决定因素进行系统识别，弥补了以往研究仅关注单一或少数因素的局限，为包容性发展理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为非洲国家减少排斥和促进公平增长的政策提供了基于证据的指导，明确指出技能培养、提升治理质量、改善就业、健康保障、清洁能源和数字技术普及等关键政策方向。

title: Soybean Productivity, Land Expansion, Climate, and Biotechnology in Bolivia

detail.title: Soybean Productivity, Land Expansion, Climate, and Biotechnology in Bolivia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, identifiable personal data, animals, clinical interventions, or the collection of primary data requiring ethical approval. The research relies exclusively on publicly available and/or secondary data. Therefore, institutional ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The research was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: We harmonize 113 Bolivian agro-environmental sources to separate soybean yield, cultivated area, and production from 1983/84 through 2025. The 2005/06 authorization of glyphosate-resistant soybean is treated as a legal-availability boundary, not observed farm adoption. Identification is challenged with interrupted time series, ARIMA and state-space counterfactuals, panel fixed effects, event studies, synthetic and factor controls, structural-break searches, placebo dates and crops, leave-one-out tests, specification curves, wild-cluster inference, weather randomization, and causal machine learning. The data do not identify a robust positive aggregate yield discontinuity at the 2005/06 boundary. Growth accounting is clearer: most long-run production growth reflects cultivated-area expansion, while yield growth is modest and volatile. Weather effects weaken under randomization-based inference, and aggregate land-use relations remain associational at the available spatial resolution. Forecasting provides an independent test of model stability. Expanding-window comparisons span structural time-series models, ARIMA, regularized autoregression, SVR, tree ensembles, boosting, Gaussian processes, conformalized quantile regression, and guarded ensembles. Area and production are substantially more forecastable than yield. Forecasts through 2030 therefore retain wide empirical uncertainty bands and are reconciled to the exact production-area-yield identity. The evidence supports strong conclusions about the extensive margin, but much weaker causal conclusions about legalization, adoption, or environmental conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文整合了玻利维亚113个农业-环境数据源，以区分1983/84至2025年间的大豆单产、种植面积和产量。将2005/06年抗草甘膦大豆的获批视为法律可用性的边界而非实际采用。通过多种计量方法未能识别出稳健的正向总体单产间断，增长核算显示大部分长期生产增长来自种植面积扩张而非单产提升，且面积和产量的可预测性远高于单产。
AI.research_question: 玻利维亚大豆合法化（2005/06年抗草甘膦大豆授权）是否导致了单产、种植面积和产量的结构性变化？长期增长的来源是什么？未来可预测性如何？
AI.motivation: 转基因大豆合法化对农业生产和环境影响存在激烈争论，但缺乏严格的多方法因果识别和稳健性检验。本文试图在一个数据有争议且证据不一致的背景下，通过大规模方法论集合来检验政策边界的因果效应。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律可用性边界的准自然实验框架；中断时间序列理论；增长核算（集约边际vs.粗放边际）；预测稳定性作为模型检验工具。
AI.method: 多方法三角验证：中断时间序列、ARIMA和状态空间反事实、面板固定效应、事件研究、合成控制与因子控制、结构突变搜索、安慰剂日期和作物检验、留一检验、规格曲线、野聚类推断、天气随机化、因果机器学习；预测方面使用扩张窗口比较结构时间序列模型、ARIMA、正则化自回归、SVR、树集成、提升、高斯过程、共形分位回归和守备集成模型。
AI.findings: （1）数据未能识别出2005/06边界上稳健的正向总体单产间断；（2）长期生产增长主要来自种植面积扩张，单产增长温和且波动大；（3）随机化推断下天气效应减弱；（4）面积和产量的可预测性远高于单产；（5）到2030年的预测保留较宽的经验不确定性区间。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明在特定背景下，转基因作物合法化并未产生可稳健识别的单产跳跃，挑战了合法化必然带来单产提升的假设；提出"粗放边际强结论、因果结论弱"的证据等级框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供关于转基因合法化效果的多方法稳健性证据；揭示面积扩张（而非单产提升）是玻利维亚大豆增长的主要驱动力，对土地利用和环境保护政策具有直接意义；提供到2030年的大豆面积、产量和单产的不确定性预测。

title: Towards an “Environmental Competition Law”?
affiliations: University Côte d'Azur

detail.title: Towards an “Environmental Competition Law”?
detail.abstract:
Climate change has placed competition law under mounting pressure to contribute to environmental protection, yet the discipline was not originally designed with sustainability in mind. Since 2019, competition authorities across Europe and beyond have progressively integrated environmental considerations into their enforcement priorities, soft-law instruments, and decisional practice — from green exemptions and out-of-market efficiencies tests to a markedly more permissive State aid framework geared towards decarbonization. This paper asks whether these developments amount to the emergence of a genuine “environmental competition law”: a body of law with its own rules, principles, and unequivocal purpose. It argues that they do not, or not yet. What can currently be observed is, at best, an uneven and fragmented evolution — a “soft transformation” in the field of anticompetitive practices, a more far-reaching but still uncodified shift in State aid law — rather than a settled revolution, and one marked by a striking asymmetry: environmental benefits may justify distortions of competition resulting from Member State subsidies, yet no comparable justification currently exists for foreign subsidies pursuing identical climate objectives under the Foreign Subsidies Regulation.

 

The paper then turns to what such a body of law could and should become. It proposes, first, a consolidation of existing developments, including the generalization of the out-of-market efficiencies test, a legislative basis for the green exemption, and an alignment of the Foreign Subsidies Regulation with State aid law so that verifiable climate benefits are no longer treated differently depending on the geographic origin of the funding. Second, it undertakes a reconstruction of the field’s normative foundations, grounding environmental protection as a constitutional “meta-interest” within EU law rather than a mere policy preference internal to competition authorities. On this basis, it develops a three-tier typology — convergence, commensurable divergence, and incommensurable divergence — that determines when, and only when, competition law should depart from the ordinary consumer welfare standard. In the residual category of incommensurable divergence, the paper proposes a “precautionary citizen-consumer standard”, in which the precautionary principle operates as a threshold test for departing from ordinary welfare analysis, while proportionality — drawing on recent case law of the French Cour de cassation reconciling competition law with fundamental rights — provides the technique for reconciling environmental and competitive interests without granting environmental protection automatic supremacy.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨气候危机背景下竞争法是否已演化为真正的"环境竞争法"。作者认为目前仅存在碎片化的"软转型"——反竞争行为领域变化有限，国家援助法领域变化较深远但未法典化，且存在对外国补贴与国内补贴处理不对称的问题。论文提出整合现有发展，并将环境保护重构为欧盟宪法层面的"元利益"，发展出三类类型学（趋同、可通约分歧、不可通约分歧），在不可通约分歧中提出"预防性公民-消费者标准"以平衡环境与竞争利益。
AI.research_question: 气候变化压力下，竞争法是否已出现真正的"环境竞争法"？如果不是，它应当且能够成为什么样的法律体系？
AI.motivation: 自2019年以来，欧洲及更广泛的竞争当局逐步将环境考量纳入执法优先事项、软法工具和裁决实践，但这些发展是否构成一个具有自身规则、原则和明确目的的法律体系尚不清晰；同时外国补贴条例与国内国家援助法在气候目标处理上存在显著不对称。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以欧盟宪法中的"元利益"（meta-interest）理论为规范性基础，结合预防原则（precautionary principle）与比例原则（proportionality）作为分析框架，并借鉴法国最高法院在竞争法与基本权利协调方面的判例法。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（normative doctrinal analysis），对现行竞争法和国家援助法的既有发展进行综合梳理与批判性评估，并提出理论重构与制度设计方案。
AI.findings: （1）目前不存在真正的"环境竞争法"，仅有碎片化的"软转型"；（2）反垄断领域变化有限（如绿色豁免、市场外效率测试），国家援助法领域变化更深远但未法典化；（3）存在显著不对称：成员国补贴可以环境理由正当化竞争扭曲，但外国补贴条例下同等气候目标却缺乏类似理由；（4）提出了三类类型学及"预防性公民-消费者标准"作为不可通约分歧情形下的决策框架。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将环境保护定位为欧盟宪法层面的"元利益"，超越单纯的政策偏好层面，为竞争法环境整合提供规范性根基；（2）提出三层次类型学（趋同、可通约分歧、不可通约分歧），明确竞争法在何时以及仅在何种条件下应偏离普通消费者福利标准；（3）引入"预防性公民-消费者标准"，将预防原则作为偏离福利分析的阈值测试，比例原则作为协调工具，避免环境利益自动优先。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）提出整合现有发展的具体路径：推广市场外效率测试、为绿色豁免提供立法基础、使外国补贴条例与国家援助法对齐；（2）为竞争当局在环境与竞争利益冲突时提供可操作的决策框架；（3）揭示并呼吁解决成员国补贴与外国补贴之间的不对称待遇问题。

title: From Climate Science to Financial Decisions: An Integrated Framework for Translating Climate Risks into Actionable Financial Information
affiliations: Tyche Investments - Climate Consulting Group

detail.title: From Climate Science to Financial Decisions: An Integrated Framework for Translating Climate Risks into Actionable Financial Information
detail.abstract: This study examines how scientific knowledge on climate change can be translated into actionable financial information for financial-sector decision-makers. It addresses the gap between the growing availability of climate information and its effective application in financial decision-making. The study adopts a qualitative, secondary-research-based approach using evidence exclusively from peer-reviewed research. The literature is systematically synthesised through thematic analysis, evidence mapping, comparative analysis and analysis of climatefinancial transmission mechanisms. The study examines physical and transition risks, exposure and vulnerability, financial impacts, financial metrics, climate scenarios and financial decision-making. The analysis shows that climate information does not automatically constitute financial information. Its financial relevance depends on exposure, vulnerability and the mechanisms through which climate risks affect economic activities, businesses and financial assets. The findings further show that financial metrics are necessary to translate climate impacts into decision-relevant information. Physical and transition risks need to be considered together, while scenario analysis provides an important forward-looking perspective under uncertainty. The study develops an integrated climate-to-finance conceptual framework connecting scientific climate knowledge with climate risks, exposure and vulnerability, economic impacts, climate-financial transmission mechanisms, financial impacts, financial metrics and financial decision-making. The framework provides a structured basis for translating climate science into decision-specific financial information.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨如何将气候变化的科学知识转化为金融部门决策者可操作化的金融信息，通过定性二手研究（基于同行评审文献），整合了物理风险与转型风险、暴露与脆弱性、金融影响、金融指标及气候情景分析，构建了一个从气候科学到金融决策的综合概念框架。
AI.research_question: 气候变化科学知识如何被转化为可供金融部门决策者使用的可操作金融信息？
AI.motivation: 气候信息的可获得性日益增长，但其在金融决策中的有效应用存在明显差距，需要弥合气候科学与金融决策之间的鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 气候-金融传导机制分析框架，涵盖物理风险与转型风险、暴露与脆弱性、金融影响与金融指标、气候情景分析等理论概念。
AI.method: 定性二手研究法，基于同行评审文献，通过主题分析、证据映射、比较分析以及气候-金融传导机制分析进行系统性文献综合。
AI.findings: 气候信息并不自动构成金融信息，其金融相关性取决于暴露、脆弱性及气候风险影响经济活动、企业和金融资产的传导机制；金融指标是将气候影响转化为决策相关信息所必需的；物理风险与转型风险需综合考虑；情景分析为不确定性条件下提供重要的前瞻性视角。
AI.theory_contributions: 构建了整合气候科学知识到金融决策的"气候到金融"综合概念框架，连接气候风险、暴露与脆弱性、经济影响、气候-金融传导机制、金融影响、金融指标和金融决策等关键环节。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融部门决策者提供了将气候科学转化为特定决策所需金融信息的结构化基础，有助于提升气候相关金融风险的管理和决策质量。

title: What makes a Bubble Pop?
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: What makes a Bubble Pop?
detail.abstract: The 2020-2021 Pokémon card market experienced an unprecedented surge in prices, attracting investors, collectors and widespread media attention. Many economists have argued that this boom was a speculative bubble where prices were inflated to unsustainable heights because of excessive optimism and expectations of future price increases. This study investigates whether the Pokémon card boom can be classified as a speculative bubble by analyzing the price performance of vintage and modern Pokémon cards over time. Price trends are compared alongside factors such as scarcity, popularity, nostalgia, and PSA population to distinguish cards whose values were primarily supported by fundamental demand from cards driven by speculation. The findings suggest that while speculation significantly inflated many card prices, cards with stronger underlying fundamentals experienced smaller declines and recovered more successfully after the bubble burst, indicating that both speculation and intrinsic value played important roles in determining long-term market performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析2020-2021年宝可梦卡牌市场的价格暴涨现象，区分了投机驱动的价格泡沫与基本面支持的卡牌价值，发现基本面更强的卡牌在泡沫破裂后跌幅更小且恢复更好。
AI.research_question: 2020-2021年宝可梦卡牌市场的暴涨是否可以被归类为投机泡沫？哪些卡牌的价格主要由基本面需求支撑，哪些主要由投机驱动？
AI.motivation: 2020-2021年宝可梦卡牌市场经历了前所未有的价格飙升，吸引了投资者、收藏家和媒体的广泛关注，许多经济学家认为这是一次投机泡沫。有必要通过实证分析来检验这一判断。
AI.theoretical_framework: 投机泡沫理论、基本面价值理论
AI.method: 对比分析复古与现代宝可梦卡牌的价格趋势，结合稀缺性、流行度、怀旧情绪和PSA人口数据（评级卡数量）等指标，区分基本面支持的卡牌与投机驱动的卡牌。
AI.findings: 投机显著推高了许多卡牌的价格，但具有更强基本面的卡牌在泡沫破裂后经历了较小的价格下跌，并且恢复得更成功，表明投机和内在价值都在决定长期市场表现中发挥了重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 通过实证数据验证了投机泡沫理论与基本面价值理论在收藏品市场中的适用性，表明两者并非互斥，而是共同影响长期市场表现。
AI.practical_contributions: 为收藏品投资者提供了区分投机驱动与基本面支持卡牌的分析框架，帮助投资者更好地评估收藏品的长期价值与风险。

title: Adaptive Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Lyapunov-Driven Primal-Dual Control for Fault-Resilient Resource Management in Software-Defined Fog-Edge Infrastructures
affiliations: National University Singapore, University of Tokyo, Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST) - Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology (KAIST), Students and The Chinese University of Hong Kong (CUHK)

detail.title: Adaptive Hierarchical Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning with Lyapunov-Driven Primal-Dual Control for Fault-Resilient Resource Management in Software-Defined Fog-Edge Infrastructures
detail.abstract: Software-defined networking (SDN) fused with fog-edge computing promises near-user intelligence at ultra-low latency, yet contemporary resource managers still collapse under scale, lack enforceable quality-of-service (QoS) bounds, and remain brittle to node crashes and traffic spikes. We present Adaptive-HiDRL, a hierarchical multi-agent deep reinforcement learning architecture that couples graph neural network (GNN) topology encoders, chance-constrained primal-dual optimization, federated Lyapunov drift control with differential privacy, and a digital-twin Transformer forecaster. The system is cast as a constrained Markov decision process (CMDP) whose tail-latency and reliability chance constraints are converted into learnable Lagrange multipliers updated by projected gradient ascent. Centralized training with decentralized execution (CTDE) lets a global SDN meta-controller allocate inter-domain budgets while local agents perform millisecond-scale intra-domain offloading. Extensive discrete-event simulations on Waxman topologies of up to 5 000 nodes demonstrate that Adaptive-HiDRL cuts mean latency by 76 %, energy draw by 63 %, and 99th-percentile latency by a factor of 4.1 relative to the strongest published baselines, while sustaining a 99.4 % task completion ratio under 30 % simultaneous node failures. Ablation and statistical tests confirm that each architectural component contributes measurably to the observed gains. The framework therefore sets a new reference point for scalable, QoS-guaranteed, and failure-resilient orchestration in next-generation distributed edge systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Adaptive-HiDRL，一种结合图神经网络、机会约束原始对偶优化、联邦Lyapunov漂移控制（含差分隐私）与数字孪生Transformer预测器的分层多智能体深度强化学习架构，用于SDN与雾边缘计算融合场景下的资源编排。该架构被建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），通过可学习的Lagrange乘子处理尾延迟与可靠性机会约束，采用集中训练-分散执行（CTDE）范式实现全局SDN元控制器与本地智能体的协同。在多达5000节点的Waxman拓扑仿真中，相对最强基线降低平均延迟76%、能耗63%、99分位延迟4.1倍，并在30%节点同时故障时保持99.4%任务完成率，为可扩展、QoS有保障且抗故障的分布式边缘编排设立了新基准。
AI.research_question: 如何在SDN与雾边缘计算融合的大规模分布式系统中，设计一种可扩展的智能资源编排架构，使其同时满足严格的QoS（服务质量）约束、抵御节点故障与流量突发，并保证系统的高效运行？
AI.motivation: 现有SDN与雾边缘融合系统的资源管理器存在三大缺陷：一是面对大规模节点时性能崩溃（可扩展性不足）；二是缺乏可执行（可强制实施）的QoS边界保障；三是对节点崩溃和流量尖峰缺乏鲁棒性。因此需要一种新的架构来同时解决这三方面挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: ①约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP）——将系统建模为带尾延迟和可靠性机会约束的决策问题；②分层多智能体深度强化学习（HiDRL）——全局与局部两级智能体协作；③图神经网络（GNN）拓扑编码——建模大规模网络拓扑结构；④机会约束的原始对偶优化——将概率约束转化为可学习的Lagrange乘子，通过投影梯度上升更新；⑤联邦Lyapunov漂移控制（含差分隐私）——保证队列稳定的同时保护数据隐私；⑥数字孪生Transformer预测器——对未来流量和系统状态进行预测。
AI.method: 采用集中训练-分散执行（CTDE）范式：全局SDN元控制器负责跨域预算分配，本地智能体执行毫秒级的域内卸载决策。系统被形式化为CMDP，尾延迟与可靠性的机会约束通过转化为可学习的Lagrange乘子（由投影梯度上升更新）来求解。模型融合GNN编码器处理拓扑信息、联邦Lyapunov漂移控制实现队列稳定与隐私保护、Transformer数字孪生进行系统预测。通过大规模离散事件仿真（Waxman拓扑，最高5000节点）验证性能，并辅以消融实验与统计检验确认各组件贡献。
AI.findings: ①在最高5000节点的Waxman拓扑仿真中，Adaptive-HiDRL相对最强公开发表的基线方案降低平均延迟76%、降低能耗63%、99分位延迟降低4.1倍；②在30%节点同时发生故障的极端条件下，仍维持99.4%的任务完成率；③消融实验与统计检验证明每个架构组件（GNN编码、机会约束优化、联邦Lyapunov控制、Transformer预测）都对整体性能增益有可测量的贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: ①首次将CMDP框架与机会约束的原始对偶优化、GNN拓扑编码、联邦Lyapunov漂移控制和Transformer预测相结合，构建统一的SDN边缘资源编排理论框架；②提出将概率性QoS约束转化为可学习Lagrange乘子的可行方法，使约束满足从静态规则变为动态自适应；③通过CTDE分层架构，在理论上弥合了全局优化与局部实时决策之间的尺度鸿沟；④设计了兼具隐私保护（差分隐私）与队列稳定性（Lyapunov漂移）的理论机制，拓展了强化学习在分布式系统中的应用理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: ①为下一代分布式边缘计算系统提供了可扩展、QoS有保障、抗故障的资源编排参考架构，可直接指导实际SDN/雾计算平台的部署设计；②在极端故障场景（30%节点宕机）下仍保持高任务完成率，为工业级容错系统设计提供了实证依据；③组件化的消融验证为工程实践中的模块取舍提供了量化参考，帮助实践者根据资源约束选择关键组件；④低延迟（76%降低）、低能耗（63%降低）的双重收益对实际运维成本节约和绿色计算目标具有直接经济价值。

reference: FRB of Chicago Working Paper No. 2026-15
title: Who Opened Federal Reserve Accounts After the 1980 Monetary Control Act?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago and Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago

detail.title: Who Opened Federal Reserve Accounts After the 1980 Monetary Control Act?

publicationDetails.detailsText: FRB of Chicago Working Paper No. 2026-15
publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Chicago Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Recent debates about Federal Reserve accounts have focused on interpreting the provisions of the 1980 Monetary Control Act (MCA) which expanded account access to 35,000 additional depository institutions. However, these debates have not had the benefit of an empirical foundation on historic account take-up, which we provide here. We find that opening of accounts after 1980 was gradual and concentrated among the largest institutions. These findings are consistent with the expectations of contemporaries that the MCA was not expected or intended to displace the system of correspondent banking that served smaller institutions.

AI.tldr: 本文基于历史数据研究了1980年《货币控制法案》（MCA）后美联储账户的开立情况，发现账户开立是渐进式的且集中于大型机构，这与当时法律制定者的预期一致——MCA并非旨在取代服务小型机构的代理银行体系。
AI.research_question: 1980年《货币控制法案》（MCA）扩大美联储账户准入后，各类存款机构的实际账户开立情况如何？
AI.motivation: 关于美联储账户的近期辩论聚焦于对1980年MCA条款的解读（该法案将账户准入扩大到35,000家额外的存款机构），但这些辩论缺乏基于历史账户开立数据的实证基础，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不涉及特定的正式理论框架，主要基于历史制度分析和实证数据分析，结合当时政策制定者对MCA意图的预期（即不取代代理银行体系）。
AI.method: 历史实证分析方法，利用1980年MCA之后美联储账户开立的历史数据，分析账户开立的时点分布和机构规模分布。
AI.findings: 1980年后美联储账户的开立过程是渐进的，且集中于规模最大的机构。这一模式与当时政策制定者的预期一致，即MCA并未被期望或旨在取代服务于小型机构的代理银行体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 为美联储账户相关的政策辩论提供了首个系统的历史实证基础，实证验证了MCA设计意图与实施效果的匹配性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为当前关于美联储账户准入的辩论提供了历史经验证据，帮助政策制定者更好地理解MCA对代理银行体系和各类存款机构的影响。

title: U.S. Economic Sanctions and the Institutionalization of Iran's Parallel Resistance Economy

detail.title: U.S. Economic Sanctions and the Institutionalization of Iran's Parallel Resistance Economy
detail.abstract: Under sustained secondary sanctions, how do target states with pre-existing military-commercial networks institutionalize dual economic structures, and with what consequences for sanctions effectiveness? This paper develops a dualism pathway: such networks formalize parallel institutions that insulate strategic sectors and elite revenues while imposing efficiency and welfare costs on the formal economy; the paper argues, and traces process evidence consistent with, a decline in the marginal coercive return to sanctions intensity once these institutions are formalized. Three hypotheses are stated in falsifiable terms. Using Iran as the case and the 2025-2026 "Economic Fury" campaign as the principal source of within-case intensity variation, the paper traces the mechanism through OFAC designation text, the fourteen-point Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding, and General Licenses X and X1 (17 June-7 July 2026); reports a real, sourced World Bank time series on Iran's manufacturing share of GDP for the years it is available (2020-2023) rather than the full pre/post-episode window the theory calls for; and examines co-movement between sanctions intensity and two further public proxy series-the Iranian-crude-to-Brent discount and the gap between Iran's preferential (NIMA) and open-market exchange rates. It does not estimate a synthetic control or difference-indifferences model, and no causal point estimate is reported anywhere in the paper. Claims are stated in process-traced and associational language; a candidate instrumental strategy for future causal identification is proposed but not implemented. A similarly sourced Russia comparison (manufacturing share, Urals-Brent discount) bounds external validity. The paper's contribution is to specify, in falsifiable terms, an institutional mechanism converting sanctions pressure into durable dualism, to distinguish it from Lewis's dual-economy model and from the existing resistance-economy literature, and to report what the available public record does and does not show.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在持续次级制裁下，拥有既有军事-商业网络的目标国家如何将双重经济结构制度化，以及这对制裁有效性的影响。作者提出"二元化路径"：此类网络将平行制度正式化，隔离战略部门和精英收入，同时对正规经济施加效率和福利成本；一旦这些制度正式化，制裁强度的边际强制性回报就会下降。论文以伊朗为案例，利用2025-2026年"经济愤怒"运动作为制裁强度的变异来源，通过过程追踪和关联性证据支持论点，但明确未估计因果效应。
AI.research_question: 在持续的次级制裁下，拥有既有军事-商业网络的目标国家如何将双重经济结构制度化？这种制度化对制裁有效性有何后果？
AI.motivation: 现有制裁文献和抵抗经济文献未能充分解释目标国家在长期制裁下如何通过正式化平行制度来适应制裁，以及这种适应如何改变制裁收益递减的机制。作者旨在填补理论空白，提出一个可证伪的机构机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: "二元化路径"（dualism pathway）理论：军事-商业网络正式化平行制度，隔离战略部门与精英收入，同时使正规经济承受效率与福利成本。该理论与刘易斯（Lewis）二元经济模型及现有抵抗经济文献进行区分。
AI.method: 以伊朗为案例的定性过程追踪研究。利用2025-2026年"经济愤怒"运动作为案例内制裁强度变异来源，分析OFAC指定文本、《伊斯兰堡谅解备忘录》14点内容、通用许可证X和X1；报告世界银行制造业占GDP时间序列（2020-2023），分析制裁强度与伊朗原油-Brent折价、NIMA与自由市场汇率差之间的联动。未使用合成控制或双重差分，无因果点估计。
AI.findings: 过程追踪和关联性证据与以下论点一致：平行制度正式化后，制裁强度的边际强制性回报下降。伊朗制造业占GDP份额（2020-2023）、原油折价与汇率差的联动模式与理论预期相符。俄罗斯比较（制造业占比、乌拉尔-Brent折价）为外部效度提供边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个以可证伪形式表述的制度机制，解释制裁压力如何转化为持久的二元经济结构；将其与刘易斯二元经济模型和现有抵抗经济文献明确区分。
AI.practical_contributions: 如实报告了现有公开记录能显示和不能显示的内容，为制裁政策制定者提供了关于制裁强度递减收益的实证考量；并提出未来因果识别的工具变量策略方向。

title: Asset Bubbles, Uncertainty Shocks, and Endogenous Feedback
affiliations: and

detail.title: Asset Bubbles, Uncertainty Shocks, and Endogenous Feedback
detail.abstract: Asset bubbles can create the uncertainty that sustains them. We build an economy in which a gap between an assets market price and the cost of covering its dividends finances project entry, expansion, and risk taking. Those projects generate future uncertainty, which strains investors capacity to bear risk and widens the bubble. This feedback can sustain several levels of bubbles and uncertainty even when shocks do not multiply on their own. Time structure determines the outcome. With a fixed ending date, equilibrium is unique regardless of feedback strength. When projects and uncertainty repeatedly renew, the same mechanism can produce multiple equilibria. Uncertainty shocks do not merely enlarge an existing bubble: by pushing risk beyond investors capacity to bear it, they can cause one to form in the first place. The model identifies stable and unstable outcomes and remains valid in a fully closed economy.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个资产泡沫与不确定性相互强化的经济模型。泡沫产生的融资活动增加了未来不确定性，而更高的不确定性削弱了投资者承担风险的能力，从而进一步扩大泡沫。这种反馈机制在特定时间结构下可以产生多重均衡，不确定性冲击甚至可以"凭空"催生泡沫。
AI.research_question: 资产泡沫与不确定性之间如何形成自我强化的反馈机制？在何种条件下这种反馈会导致多重均衡，以及不确定性冲击如何导致泡沫的形成？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常将不确定性视为影响资产价格的被动因素，而本文试图揭示泡沫本身可以制造不确定性，两者之间存在内生反馈关系。同时，理解这种反馈何时导致多重均衡、何时保持唯一均衡，对资产定价和政策干预具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 资产泡沫理论、不确定性驱动的风险承担理论、理性预期均衡理论
AI.method: 理论建模：构建资产市场价格与其股利覆盖成本之间的缺口驱动项目进入、扩张和风险承担的动态一般均衡模型，分析不同时间结构（固定终止日期 vs. 反复更新）下的均衡存在性与唯一性。
AI.findings: 1）泡沫与不确定性之间存在自我强化的反馈循环；2）当项目与不确定性反复更新时，该机制可产生多重均衡；3）固定终止日期下均衡唯一，不受反馈强度影响；4）不确定性冲击不仅扩大已有泡沫，还能在风险超出投资者承受能力时触发泡沫形成；5）模型在完全封闭经济中依然成立。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了泡沫内生制造不确定性的机制，将不确定性从外生冲击转变为内生变量；区分了时间结构对多重均衡存在性的决定性影响；识别了确定性与不确定性均衡的稳定性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管部门理解泡沫形成机制及不确定性传递路径提供了理论依据；有助于识别何种时间结构下经济更易出现泡沫多重均衡风险；为政策干预时机的选择提供了参考。

title: Materialising Equity in Community-Centric AI Tools: The Case against Technocracy
affiliations: The University of Manchester, The University of Manchester and The University of Manchester - Global Development Institute

detail.title: Materialising Equity in Community-Centric AI Tools: The Case against Technocracy
detail.abstract: This paper responds to calls for more grounded, empirical accounts on what responsible, community-centric AI actually looks like in practice. Using the theoretical framework of advantageous digital incorporation, it examines Commons Connect, a participatory AI tool that is being used by smallholding farmers in rural India to support more equitable planning and distribution of natural resource assets at village levels. Its main message is that steering AI systems towards more equitable outcomes requires an approach that de-centres AI and its affordances, is rooted in strong problem framing, makes its focus on the wider structures of domination and oppression explicit, and demonstrates restraint in implementation.

AI.tldr: 本文回应了关于负责任、以社区为中心的AI在实践中具体表现的呼吁，运用"有利的数字融入"（advantageous digital incorporation）理论框架，考察了印度农村小农使用的参与式AI工具Commons Connect，该工具支持村级自然资源资产的公平规划和分配。核心信息是：引导AI系统走向更公平的结果，需要去中心化AI及其功能，扎根于强有力的问题框架，明确关注更广泛的支配与压迫结构，并在实施中展现克制。
AI.research_question: 负责任、以社区为中心的AI在实践中的具体形态是什么？
AI.motivation: 回应学术界对提供更扎实、更具经验性的负责任AI实践案例的呼吁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 有利的数字融入（advantageous digital incorporation）理论框架
AI.method: 案例研究：对印度农村小农使用的参与式AI工具Commons Connect进行实证考察
AI.findings: 引导AI走向更公平的结果需要：去中心化AI及其功能；扎根于强有力的问题框架；明确关注更广泛的支配与压迫结构；在实施中展现克制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为负责任AI的实践路径提供了基于实证的理论阐述，深化了对社区中心AI如何实现公平结果的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为从业者提供了关于如何设计和实施以公平为导向的参与式AI工具的具体实践指导。

title: The UK-Israel FTA in a Politically Dynamic Era: Economic Rationale, Moral
affiliations: Ariel University - Department of Economics and Business Administration and Ariel University

detail.title: The UK-Israel FTA in a Politically Dynamic Era: Economic Rationale, Moral

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study was approved by Ariel University's Institutional Review Board, approval number AU-SOC-DS-20240531.

detail.abstract: This paper examines post-Brexit UK-Israel trade relations through role theory, focusing on how national role conceptions (NRCs) shape trade policy. Based on official documents, media sources, and interviews, it shows strong mutual incentives to replace the 2019 continuity agreement with an upgraded free trade agreement centered on digital services, innovation, and investment. Negotiations progressed through five rounds between 2022 and 2024, aligning the UK's and Israel's strategic economic roles. However, negotiations were suspended in May 2025 under the Starmer government, reflecting a strategic shift toward an NRC that emphasizes international law. Consequently, talks remain stalled with a resumption deemed highly unlikely, notwithstanding the subsequent ceasefire achieved in late 2025.

AI.tldr: 本文运用角色理论研究英国脱欧后与以色列的贸易关系，考察国家角色概念（NRCs）如何塑造贸易政策。研究显示双方有强烈动机用升级版自贸协定取代2019年延续协议，谈判在2022-2024年间推进了五轮，但2025年5月在斯塔默政府领导下因国家角色转向强调国际法而暂停，谈判停滞且恢复可能性极低。
AI.research_question: 国家角色概念（NRCs）如何塑造英国脱欧后与以色列的贸易政策及谈判进程？
AI.motivation: 理解英国脱欧后与以色列贸易关系演变中，国家身份和角色认知对贸易政策决策的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 角色理论（Role Theory），重点运用国家角色概念（National Role Conceptions, NRCs）分析框架。
AI.method: 基于官方文件、媒体来源和访谈的定性研究。
AI.findings: 1）英以双方有强烈激励以升级版自贸协定取代2019年延续协议，重点聚焦数字服务、创新和投资；2）谈判在2022至2024年间推进了五轮，双方战略经济角色趋于一致；3）2025年5月斯塔默政府因国家角色转向强调国际法而暂停谈判；4）尽管2025年末实现停火，谈判仍停滞且恢复可能性极低。
AI.theory_contributions: 将角色理论应用于国际贸易政策分析，展示了国家角色概念的转变如何直接影响双边贸易谈判的启动、推进与停滞，丰富了角色理论在贸易关系研究中的解释力。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解英国脱欧后贸易政策制定及英以双边关系走向提供实证依据，对预测英国国际贸易谈判策略及中东相关贸易合作前景具有参考价值。

title: When Growth Does Not Guarantee Electrification: Evidence from a developing country in SSA
affiliations: University of Zambia (UNZA) and University of Zambia (UNZA)

detail.title: When Growth Does Not Guarantee Electrification: Evidence from a developing country in SSA

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no competing interests to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable – no human subjects were involved in the study
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this study

detail.abstract: Universal electricity access remains a primary development objective in Sub-Saharan Africa. Conventional economic theory suggests that macroeconomic growth and structural transformation accelerate infrastructure expansion. This study examines whether economic growth translates into short-run electrification in Zambia using annual data from 1990 to 2024. The analysis employs an Autoregressive Distributed Lag (ARDL) bounds testing approach alongside nested short-run dynamic models with Newey-West standard errors. The results provide no evidence of a stable longrun level relationship between electricity access and standard development indicators. In the short run, gross domestic product (GDP) per capita, urbanization, and industrialization do not exhibit a statistically detectable relationship with annual changes in electricity access. Electrification exhibits negative temporal dependence, suggesting partial reversal in annual expansion rates independent of macroeconomic fluctuations. Foreign direct investment displays weak evidence of a negative association with short-run access expansion. These findings suggest that electrification in Zambia follows an independent infrastructure trajectory rather than responding mechanically to economic growth. Policymakers could consider direct, infrastructure-specific financing mechanisms rather than relying on broad economic expansion to deliver universal access.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用赞比亚1990-2024年的年度数据，采用ARDL边界检验和Newey-West标准误的嵌套短期动态模型，发现经济增长、城市化和工业化并未显著转化为短期电气化进程，赞比亚电气化遵循独立的基础设施发展轨迹，而非对宏观经济波动的机械反应。
AI.research_question: 宏观经济增长是否能够转化为撒哈拉以南非洲地区的短期电气化进程？具体聚焦于赞比亚案例。
AI.motivation: 普遍电力接入仍是撒哈拉以南非洲的首要发展目标，传统经济理论认为宏观经济增长与结构转型会加速基础设施扩张，但这一理论假设在电力部门的实证有效性尚待检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统经济发展理论（宏观经济增长与结构转型驱动基础设施扩张）
AI.method: 采用1990-2024年赞比亚年度数据，运用自回归分布滞后（ARDL）边界检验方法，结合Newey-West标准误的嵌套短期动态模型。
AI.findings: （1）电力接入与标准发展指标之间不存在稳定的长期水平关系；（2）短期中，人均GDP、城市化和工业化与电力接入年度变化之间无统计上可检测的关系；（3）电气化表现出负向时间依赖性，即年度扩张率存在部分逆转；（4）外国直接投资与短期接入扩张呈弱负相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统经济理论中"宏观经济增长必然推动基础设施扩张"的假设，提出电气化可能遵循独立的基础设施发展轨迹，而非对经济变量的机械响应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供实证依据，建议采用直接的、基础设施专项融资机制来实现普遍电力接入，而非依赖广泛的经济扩张来自然实现。

title: When Protection Works but the Portfolio Still Lags: Long-Horizon Evidence on Downside Protection, Benchmark-Relative Drawdowns, and Persistent Equity Exposure

detail.title: When Protection Works but the Portfolio Still Lags: Long-Horizon Evidence on Downside Protection, Benchmark-Relative Drawdowns, and Persistent Equity Exposure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study uses publicly available financial and market data and does not involve human participants or identifiable personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: A defensive strategy can meet its downside objective and still lag equity for years. The analysis evaluates both dimensions within the same rolling holding periods. The design is intentionally simple: U.S. equity buy-and-hold, a monthly rebalanced 50/50 equity-cash allocation, and a 12-month defensive trend rule whose position uses only information available through the previous month. The evaluation covers 5-, 10-, 15-, and 20-year periods, treating the signal horizon and blend weights as fixed design choices rather than tuning them to maximize the reported results. In the July 1927-June 2026 French-series sample, the trend rule reduces maximum drawdown in 98.2% of 20-year periods. Among those protected periods, however, 60.3% finish with lower terminal wealth than equity buy-and-hold, and the median longest benchmark-relative underwater period lasts 195 months. Fixed combinations of persistent equity exposure and tactical defense reveal a second distinction: greater persistent equity exposure is associated with substantially shallower benchmark-relative drawdowns, while underwater duration changes much less. The qualitative pattern remains under fixed trading-cost assumptions and in an independent reconstruction using Shiller and FRED data, although the magnitudes differ. The analysis considers realized downside protection together with the benchmark-relative path experienced while obtaining it. These are distinct portfolio-design dimensions and should be assessed separately.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了防御性策略在实现下行保护目标的同时可能长期落后于股票市场的现象。通过简单的50/50股现配置与12个月防御性趋势规则，作者发现该策略在98.2%的20年期间降低了最大回撤，但在60.3%的被保护期间终值低于纯股票买入持有，且基准相对水下期（underwater period）中位数长达195个月。研究强调应将"实现的回撤保护"与"获取保护期间的基准相对路径"作为两个独立的组合设计维度分别评估。
AI.research_question: 防御性策略在提供下行保护的同时，其相对股票基准的路径表现（尤其是水下期长度与终值差距）如何？这两个维度是否应被视为独立的设计考量？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注防御策略是否实现下行保护目标，却忽视了即便实现保护目标，策略仍可能长期落后于股票市场。作者旨在纠正这一评估盲区，强调下行保护与基准相对路径是两个需要分别评估的维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于防御性趋势跟踪策略的资产配置理论，区分"绝对下行风险"与"基准相对绩效"两个独立维度的概念框架。
AI.method: 采用July 1927-June 2026的French-series样本数据，设置三种简单策略（买入持有、50/50股现每月再平衡、12个月防御性趋势规则），在固定信号窗口与权重（不调优）的条件下，评估5/10/15/20年滚动持有期的最大回撤、终值及基准相对水下期时长。另在固定交易成本假设及独立数据集（Shiller和FRED）下进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: 1) 趋势规则在98.2%的20年期间降低了最大回撤；2) 但在60.3%的被保护期间终值低于买入持有；3) 中位数最长基准相对水下期长达195个月；4) 较高的持续股票敞口与更浅的基准相对回撤相关，但对水下期时长影响较小；5) 稳健性检验下定性结论一致，但幅度存在差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了评估防御策略时应区分"实现的下行保护"与"获取保护时的基准相对路径"两个独立维度，填补了现有文献将两者混为一谈的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供了更全面的评估框架：在选择防御策略时，不仅要看回撤保护效果，还须考量策略可能长期跑输基准（中位数达195个月的相对水下期）的实际路径承受，帮助投资者做出更符合自身风险承受能力的组合设计决策。

title: The Oracle Problem in Regulated Tokenization: Institutional Facts and the Limits of Trust Minimization
affiliations: , Masaryk University, Department Finance,  Faculty of Economics and Administration and

detail.title: The Oracle Problem in Regulated Tokenization: Institutional Facts and the Limits of Trust Minimization
detail.abstract: The blockchain oracle problem states that a distributed ledger cannot verify data that originates outside it. The literature has addressed this problem predominantly through trust minimization. Decentralized oracle networks, redundant sources, staking and reputation mechanisms are treated as the canonical remedies. Reliance on a single authoritative source is treated as a design deficiency. This paper argues that the framing rests on an unexamined ontological assumption, and that the assumption fails precisely where tokenization is now moving, namely regulated securities markets. Drawing on Searle's distinction between brute facts and institutional facts, we observe that the oracle literature implicitly treats all off-chain data as brute facts. Temperatures, prices and delivery states exist independently of human agreement. They are therefore approachable through convergent observation by independent parties. Decentralization works because observation scales. Securities reference data are not of this kind. A securities identifier does not exist prior to its conferral by an entity holding recognized competence under ISO 6166 and the delegation arrangements of the Association of National Numbering Agencies. No quantity of independent observers can observe such an identifier into being. We develop the argument in two movements. A structured review of the oracle literature maps how the problem has been formulated, which application domains have been examined and why regulated capital market infrastructure has remained outside its scope. We then examine the Smart Bond Contract pilot of March 2026, in which DZ BANK issued a crypto security under the German Electronic Securities Act on a public blockchain. The architecture is instructive because it combines both fact types within a single transaction. We conclude that for institutional facts the design objective is not trust minimization but legal equivalence. The task is to establish that the on-chain representation carries the normative force of the off-chain constitutive act. We anticipate the objection that distributed consensus itself confers status functions, and we delimit the conditions under which it cannot.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战区块链预言机问题的传统框架，指出该问题隐含了一个未经检验的本体论假设——将所有链下数据视为"原始事实"。然而在受监管的证券市场中，证券参考数据属于"制度性事实"，其存在依赖于权威机构的赋予而非独立观察。文章通过DZ BANK在德国电子证券法下的Smart Bond Contract试点案例，论证对制度性事实的设计目标应从信任最小化转向法律等价性。
AI.research_question: 区块链预言机问题隐含的本体论假设是否在受监管证券市场领域失效？对于制度性事实，预言机设计的正确目标应是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有预言机文献主要依赖信任最小化策略（去中心化预言机网络、冗余来源、质押和声誉机制），并将单一权威来源视为设计缺陷。但代币化正转向受监管的证券市场，该领域的数据性质与文献假设不符，现有框架无法适用。
AI.theoretical_framework: Searle关于原始事实（brute facts）与制度性事实（institutional facts）的区分；ISO 6166及国家编号机构协会（ANNA）的授权安排所构成的法律制度框架。
AI.method: 两段式论证：(1)对预言机文献进行结构化综述，梳理问题表述方式、考察的应用领域及为何受监管资本市场基础设施未被纳入；(2)案例分析——DZ BANK于2026年3月发布的Smart Bond Contract试点，其在公共区块链上依据德国电子证券法（eWpG）发行加密证券。
AI.findings: 预言机文献隐含地将所有链下数据视为原始事实（如温度、价格、交付状态），这些事实独立于人类共识存在，可通过独立观察收敛。但证券标识符并非如此——它在ISO 6166下由具备公认能力的实体赋予后才存在，独立观察者无法通过观察使其产生。DZ BANK的试点架构在同一交易中同时包含两种事实类型。对制度性事实，分布式共识本身无法赋予地位功能。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了预言机文献未言明的本体论预设，将Searle的制度事实理论引入区块链预言机研究，提出"法律等价性"替代"信任最小化"作为制度性事实场景下的设计目标，并界定了分布式共识不能赋予地位功能的条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管证券市场的链上资产设计提供指导原则，说明在数字证券场景中应关注链上表征如何承载链下构成行为的规范效力，而非简单追求数据来源的去中心化。

title: Self-healing Machine Learning Models for Automated Fault Detection and Recovery in IT Systems

detail.title: Self-healing Machine Learning Models for Automated Fault Detection and Recovery in IT Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest. This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author has no personal or financial relationships with any organizations that could have influenced this work.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, animals, or patient data. All data used in this research were obtained from publicly available datasets (BUSI - Breast Ultrasound Images Dataset). Therefore, no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Modern information technology (IT) worlds are increasingly complex, highly interconnected, with many microservices, containers and distributed streams of data, and failure modes that are too specific and numerous for an operation team to keep track of. As a result of this so-complicated operating condition, something new has been sprung on the scene: self-healing machine learning (or ML) models. This review combines data from 55 peer-reviewed and archival papers published mainly during the period 2019-2025 and focuses on a small number of basic autonomic-computing studies, collating them to get a general picture of the current state of the art for selfhealing ML in the field of IT fault management. Based on the Monitor-Analyse-Plan-Execute over a shared Knowledge base (MAPE-K) reference model, the review covers detection algorithms, root-cause localisation techniques, recovery-action selection strategies and datasets and metrics for assessing them. It showed an obvious direction from single model based anomaly detection towards hybrid pipelines of deep sequence model and graph-based causal reasoning/reinforcement learning based closed-loop remediation. These detection metrics (self-reported precision and F1 scores) are typically above 0.85 in controlled benchmarks, while recovery actions are limited by the scarcity of data, lack of explainability for the models' decisions, and/or the risk of completely autonomous execution. A taxonomy of autonomy level in the field of selfhealing systems, and a list of outstanding challenges are introduced, including and not limited to concept drift, cross-domain generalisation, safety validation, and human/human-machine trust calibration. The findings should inform researchers and practitioners to orient them on methodological gaps which most limit the shift from supervised to autonomous self-healing IT operations.

AI.tldr: 本文对2019-2025年间55篇同行评审论文进行系统性综述，基于MAPE-K参考模型，梳理了IT故障管理中自愈机器学习的最新进展，涵盖检测算法、根因定位、恢复策略及评估指标，并指出从单模型异常检测向混合深度序列模型+图因果推理+强化学习闭环修复的演进方向，同时提出自主性水平分类法和待解决挑战。
AI.research_question: 当前IT故障管理领域中自愈机器学习技术的最新研究进展如何？其方法演进路径、评估现状及关键挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 现代IT系统日益复杂（微服务、容器、分布式数据流），故障模式繁多且难以人工跟踪，促使自愈ML模型兴起。现有研究零散，缺乏系统性的综述来整合当前技术状态。
AI.theoretical_framework: MAPE-K（Monitor-Analyse-Plan-Execute over shared Knowledge）参考模型，以及自愈系统自主性水平的分类学。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述（Systematic Literature Review），整合55篇2019-2025年间同行评审论文，按MAPE-K框架对检测算法、根因定位技术、恢复策略选择及数据集/评估指标进行分类分析。
AI.findings: 1) 方法从单模型异常检测转向混合管道（深度序列模型+图因果推理/强化学习闭环修复）；2) 检测指标在受控基准中自报精确率和F1分数通常高于0.85；3) 恢复行动受限于数据稀缺、模型决策缺乏可解释性、完全自主执行的风险；4) 提出自主性水平分类学；5) 指出概念漂移、跨域泛化、安全验证、人机信任校准等关键挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次基于MAPE-K框架系统整合自愈ML在IT故障管理领域的研究脉络，提出自愈系统自主性水平分类学，识别从监督学习向自主自愈转变的方法论缺口。
AI.practical_contributions: 为研究人员和从业者提供当前技术全景图，指明最限制从监督式向自主式自愈IT运维转型的方法论差距，指导未来研究方向和实践部署决策。

title: Trading Scope for Credibility in Difference-in-Differences
affiliations: Ashoka University - Department of Economics and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Trading Scope for Credibility in Difference-in-Differences
detail.abstract: When parallel trends fails for some treated cohorts but not others, the average treatment effect on the treated (ATT) becomes hard to recover. We propose changing the estimand rather than defending it. The credible-subpopulation local ATT (LATT) is the effect for the subpopulation of cohorts whose parallel trends is credible, and it is point-identified under parallel trends for the selected cohorts alone, a weaker requirement that can hold when the ATT's fails. It is estimated by reweighting standard group-time effects toward those cohorts, and paired with honest sensitivity bounds on the residual violation that a pre-trend screen cannot rule out. The method's advantage grows with how informative pre-trends are about post-treatment violations, as simulations confirm. In an application, a significantly positive pooled estimate of the shale boom's effect on local house prices proves to rest on cohorts already trending before onset, and the credible subpopulation reveals no effect.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的估计量——可信子群体局部处理效应（LATT），当平行趋势假设对部分队列成立而对其他队列不成立时，通过改变估计目标而非捍卫平行趋势假设来识别处理效应。该方法在仅有部分队列满足平行趋势的较弱条件下即可点识别，并通过重加权标准组-时间效应实现估计，同时配套敏感性界限以处理前趋势筛查无法排除的残余违背。
AI.research_question: 当平行趋势假设对某些处理队列成立但对其他队列不成立时，如何可靠地估计处理效应？
AI.motivation: 标准的双重差分方法依赖于平行趋势假设对所有处理队列都成立，但在实际应用中这一假设常常对部分队列失效，导致平均处理效应（ATT）难以识别。作者提议改变估计目标（estimand）而非捍卫一个可能失败的假设。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重差分（DID）识别框架；平行趋势假设；组-时间效应（group-time effects）；局部处理效应（local ATT）概念。
AI.method: 提出可信子群体局部ATT（LATT）估计量：仅基于平行趋势可信的队列子群体进行点识别；通过重加权标准组-时间效应实现对选定队列的估计；配合敏感性界限分析，用于量化前趋势筛查无法排除的残余违背；通过蒙特卡洛模拟验证方法性能。
AI.findings: 模拟研究表明，前趋势信息对处理后违背的预测力越强，该方法相对传统方法的优势越大；在页岩气繁荣对当地房价影响的实证应用中，原本显著为正的汇总估计被发现依赖于在处理开始前已存在趋势的队列，而可信子群体估计揭示并无效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为DID文献提供了新的识别策略：当平行趋势仅对部分子群体成立时，通过改变估计目标而非加强假设来获得可识别的因果参数；将前趋势筛查与敏感性分析系统性地结合到估计框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究者提供了一种更稳健的处理效应估计方法，当传统的平行趋势假设对部分队列不成立时仍可获得有意义的结果，并在页岩气政策评估案例中展示了其实用价值。

title: The Price of an Arc: Rerouting and the Incidence of Shipping Pollution
affiliations: National University of Singapore (NUS), Department of Economics

detail.title: The Price of an Arc: Rerouting and the Incidence of Shipping Pollution

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no conflict of interest to declare.
declarations.ethicsApproval: N.A.
declarations.funderStatement: I have no funder information to declare.

detail.abstract: Environmental instruments price damage only when the source has a fixed address, and a ship chooses its address voyage by voyage. When the Red Sea closed in December 2023, the same goods sailed 4,133 nautical miles farther around the Cape. I solve both corridors on an ocean grid and read the diversion in satellite columns over 53 countries' coasts. A standard deviation of corridor exposure raises city nitrogen dioxide by 2-3.5 percent, arriving on the wind, and moves exposure off 81 million people on the estimation coasts onto 37 million who earn two fifths as much. A tonne of fuel on the Red Sea arc delivers 3.7 times the exposure it delivers on the Cape arc, yet every fuel-scaled instrument prices the pair at 0.7. I derive the efficient ratio of arc exposure charges, which does not depend on what exposure is worth, and carry it to twenty-eight passages. The same calculation applies to any emitter that chooses among routes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了航运排放定价的偏差问题。当2023年12月红海关闭时，同一批货物改道绕行好望角，航程增加4,133海里。研究发现，通过卫星柱观测，走廊暴露度的标准差提高会使城市二氧化氮增加2-3.5%；红海弧线上每吨燃料产生的暴露量是开普弧线的3.7倍，但所有按燃料规模定价的工具将两者定价为0.7。作者推导出弧线暴露收费的效率比率，该比率不依赖于暴露的价值，并将其应用于28条航道。
AI.research_question: 当排放源（船舶）可以在不同航线之间选择时，现有按燃料规模定价的环境工具能否正确反映不同航线造成的真实环境危害差异？
AI.motivation: 现有环境工具（如碳税、燃料税）按燃料消耗量定价，但同一吨燃料在不同航线（红海vs开普弧）上产生的污染暴露量差异巨大（3.7倍），而现行定价却将其等同对待（比率0.7），导致定价扭曲，需要更精确的基于路线的差异化定价。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学中的污染定价理论、外部性内部化理论、最优碳税/排放收费理论，以及效率比率的推导框架（不依赖暴露价值估计）。
AI.method: 利用2023年12月红海关闭作为自然实验，在海洋网格上求解两条走廊（红海航线与开普航线），结合53个国家海岸的卫星氮氧化物柱观测数据，识别航运排放暴露的因果效应；推导弧线暴露收费的效率比率并将其推广至28条航道。
AI.findings: (1) 走廊暴露度的标准差提高使城市二氧化氮增加2-3.5%，且影响随风传播；(2) 暴露人口从沿海8,100万人转移到收入仅为前者五分之二的3,700万人，即污染负担向低收入群体转移；(3) 红海弧线每吨燃料的暴露量是开普弧线的3.7倍，但现行燃料定价将其比率定为0.7，严重低估红海航线危害；(4) 推导出效率比率不依赖于暴露价值估计，可直接应用于28条航道。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 证明了在排放源可自由选择路线的情况下，按燃料规模统一定价会导致系统性定价偏差，扩展了环境定价理论；(2) 提出了一种不依赖污染损害价值估计的效率定价比率推导方法；(3) 将路线选择纳入污染外部性分析框架，为移动污染源的差异化定价提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为国际航运排放定价改革提供实证依据，建议对不同航线实施差异化环境收费；(2) 揭示了现行定价机制导致污染向低收入国家/人群转移的分配不公问题；(3) 提供了可直接应用于28条主要航道的具体收费调整方案；(4) 方法可推广到任何可自主选择路线的排放者（如公路运输、航空等）的定价优化。

title: Code is not Law: The Congruence Dilemma and the Limits of Legality in AI-based Public Administration
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title: Code is not Law: The Congruence Dilemma and the Limits of Legality in AI-based Public Administration
detail.abstract: The premise that encoding a rule in software is a way of administering it now underwrites much of the digital state. Critics mainly contest it by disputing whether algorithmic systems are accurate, fair or legitimate enough to bear it, a framing that concedes the decisive ground by treating law and code as competing technologies for one task. This article argues instead that regulation and legality are different properties, and that competence at the first entails nothing about capacity for the second. Reconstructing legality through Fuller's desiderata, we locate the distinctive failure at the eighth, congruence between declared rule and official action, and specify it as a congruence dilemma. Where an external declared norm survives, the system enacts rather than states its operative rule, so divergence must be reconstructed by investigation rather than observed by comparison; where computational implementation progressively becomes the de facto specification of a delegated standard, there is nothing left for administration to be incongruent with. Crucially, the resulting failure is not an inability to detect incongruence-Robodebt was detected repeatedly and continued anyway-but the severance of detection from correction, which automation achieves by making detected incongruence cheap to perpetuate at scale. We then show that generative AI introduces a distinct failure we call the specification illusion: a natural-language system prompt can institutionally impersonate a promulgated rule while possessing none of a promulgated rule's authoritative priority over implementation. We accept that determinism, formal runtime constraint and trajectory auditing are all technically achievable, and argue that this sharpens rather than weakens the thesis, because technical conformance is neither necessary nor sufficient for legal bindingness. We conclude by specifying contestability as a four-part institutional requirement-separation (as a binding legal envelope), record, adjudicative remedy and propagation-and assess the EU, Canadian, US and Australian instruments against it.

AI.tldr: 本文论证法律与代码是两种不同的属性，编码规则的能力不代表其具备合法性的能力。作者通过富勒的法治要件重构合法性，指出算法治理的核心失败在于第八个要件（宣布的规则与官方行为之间的一致性），并将其具体化为"一致性困境"。此外，生成式AI引入了"规范幻觉"这一独特失败——自然语言系统提示可以在制度上冒充颁布的规则，却不具备颁布规则对实现施加的权威优先性。文章最后将可争议性界定为四部分制度要求（隔离、记录、裁决救济与传播），并据此评估欧盟、加拿大、美国和澳大利亚的相关工具。
AI.research_question: 为什么将规则编码为软件（算法系统）不足以使其具有合法性和可治理性？算法治理的独特失败机制是什么，以及什么样的制度条件才能使算法治理具备可争议性？
AI.motivation: 现有对数字化国家的批评主要围绕算法系统的准确性、公平性或正当性是否足以承载规则执行，这种框架将法律与代码视为完成同一任务的竞争性技术，从而在前提上让出了关键阵地。作者认为需要从根本上区分"规制"与"合法性"是不同属性，胜任前者并不意味着具备后者。
AI.theoretical_framework: 富勒（Fuller）的合法性八项要件中的第八项——宣布的规则与官方行为之间的一致性（congruence）；以及"一致性困境"（congruence dilemma）与"规范幻觉"（specification illusion）两个原创概念。
AI.method: 规范性/理论性论证方法：通过富勒的法治理论框架重构算法治理的合法性失败，并以Robodebt（澳大利亚自动债务追讨系统）作为实证案例，辅以对欧盟、加拿大、美国和澳大利亚的治理工具进行制度比较评估。
AI.findings: （1）算法治理的独特失败不在于无法检测不一致（Robodebt被反复检测却仍继续运行），而在于自动化将检测与纠正分离，使已检测到的不一致得以大规模廉价延续；（2）生成式AI引入"规范幻觉"：自然语言系统提示可制度性冒充颁布规则而不具备其权威优先性；（3）技术确定性、正式运行时约束和轨迹审计虽在技术上可实现，但这反而强化了本文论点，因为技术符合性既非法律约束力的必要条件也非充分条件。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将"规制"与"合法性"概念进行明确区分，挑战了将法律与代码视为竞争性技术的主流框架；（2）通过富勒第八要件将算法治理失败精确化为"一致性困境"，提供了新的诊断概念；（3）提出"规范幻觉"概念，识别了生成式AI带来的新型制度失败；（4）提出将"可争议性"操作化为四部分制度要求，为算法治理研究提供了规范性评价标准。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为政策制定者提供了评估算法治理工具（欧盟、加拿大、美国、澳大利亚）的制度框架；（2）指出仅追求技术符合性（如形式运行时约束、审计）不足以赋予算法系统合法性，需配套隔离、记录、裁决救济与传播等制度安排；（3）为应对Robodebt类系统失败提供了诊断与纠正的制度化路径。

title: The Bankability of Power Purchase Agreements in Nigeria's Transitioning Electricity Market
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Bankability of Power Purchase Agreements in Nigeria's Transitioning Electricity Market
detail.abstract: This article assesses the bankability of Power Purchase Agreements (PPAs) in Nigeria across two distinct market regimes: the Nigerian Bulk Electricity Trading Plc (NBET) single-buyer model that governed the sector from privatisation in 2013, and the bilateral trading framework inaugurated by NERC Order No NERC/2024/058 of 25 July 2024, issued pursuant to section 7(2) of the Electricity Act 2023. Bankability, as used in this article, denotes the capacity of a PPA to support project finance on commercial terms, a function of three conditions: efficient risk allocation, enforceable payment obligations against creditworthy counterparties, and credible security mechanisms that would actually pay out in a default scenario. The article applies this three-part test to the single-buyer framework and finds that while the framework was structurally coherent in design, each condition was systematically undermined in practice by institutional insolvency, accumulated payment defaults, and an enforcement gap that contract drafting alone could not cure. It then carries the analysis forward into the ongoing transition to bilateral trading and argues that the transition, while structurally necessary, relocates rather than resolves the underlying problem: the credit risk that NBET absorbed imperfectly has been redistributed to distribution companies whose existing financial positions were already precarious, and four consecutive quarters of NERC performance data since the bilateral trading Order confirm that those positions have not improved. Drawing on comparative analysis of Ghana and Kenya, the article closes by identifying the specific sequencing of fiscal, institutional, and regulatory conditions without which the bilateral model cannot deliver bankable PPAs, and assesses the realistic prospects of those conditions being achieved.

AI.tldr: 本文运用三部分可融资性测试（风险分配、可执行的支付义务、可信的安全机制），评估尼日利亚购电协议在单一买方模式与双边交易框架两种市场体制下的可融资性，发现单一买方模式在制度上存在系统性缺陷，而向双边交易的过渡只是转移而非解决了信用风险问题，并借助加纳和肯尼亚的比较分析提出实现可融资购电协议所需的条件序列。
AI.research_question: 在尼日利亚从单一买方模式向双边交易框架转型的背景下，购电协议的可融资性条件是什么？这两个体制下的可融资性分别面临哪些结构性障碍？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚电力行业经历了2013年私有化和2024年NERC双边交易命令的两次重大制度转型，但购电协议的可融资性始终是制约项目融资和电力投资的关键问题。需要系统评估两种体制下的制度缺陷，为改革路径提供分析依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可融资性三条件框架：高效的风险分配、针对有信用能力对手方的可执行支付义务、以及能在违约情景下真正支付的可信安全机制。
AI.method: 三部分可融资性测试法的规范性法律分析，结合尼日利亚NERC实际绩效数据的实证考察，以及加纳和肯尼亚的比较制度分析。
AI.findings: 1. 单一买方模式在制度设计上结构连贯，但实践中三个条件均被系统性侵蚀——机构破产、积累的支付违约和执行缺口使合同起草无法补救。2. 双边交易框架虽在结构上必要，但将信用风险从NBET转移至财务状况本已脆弱的配电公司，NERC连续四个季度的绩效数据证明这些公司财务状况未见改善。3. 加纳和肯尼亚的比较经验表明，若无特定的财政、制度和监管条件序列，双边模式无法产生可融资的购电协议。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将可融资性操作化为三个可检验条件的分析框架，并将其应用于电力市场制度转型的比较分析，揭示了"风险转移不等于风险解决"的制度逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为尼日利亚电力监管机构、政策制定者和项目融资方提供了具体的制度诊断和改革条件清单，明确了双边交易从"结构性必要"走向"实质性可行"所需的财政、制度和监管前提。

title:
Legal and Ideological Citizenship
Africans at the Crossroads of Global Trends and Tensions

detail.title:
Legal and Ideological Citizenship
Africans at the Crossroads of Global Trends and Tensions

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This is a sole-authored paper. The project responded to the Call for Papers by the African Association for Rhetoric (AAR). The paper was presented at the African Association for Rhetoric (AAR) 2026 conference (July 4, 2026).

detail.abstract: Modern constitutional democracies typically vest sovereignty in "the people," as reflected in standard preambular formulations such as "We the people." A survey of 52 of Africa's 54 states confirms similar sovereign attributions, expressed through diverse constitutional and democratic configurations. Yet in many African contexts, citizens rarely assert this sovereign status in everyday interactions with political representatives and state institutions, even in states with relatively active civil societies, such as Nigeria. Persistent inequality, weak service delivery, internal displacement, and statelessness raise critical questions about the gap between constitutional and lived citizenship on the continent. This paper examines African citizenship from legal, ideological, and rhetorical perspectives and argues that the rhetorical perspective is not one lens among three but the analytical home of the other two.
